| Physical deletion | Exceptional administrative action | Normally prohibited | Governed by retention and legal authority |

| Operation | Normal UX | Agent duty | Completion gate |

| Move | Request destination | Check ownership, permission change and broken references | Source and destination permit the move |
| Share | Name recipient, purpose and duration | Apply minimum scope and expiry where needed | Sharing policy and required approval pass |

6. Agent or bounded service performs the Microsoft 365 effect.

- Normal formal publication passes through Agent verification.
- Agent outage must not block reading or drafting.
- A bounded break-glass process may allow exceptional formal action.
- Every break-glass action must be reconciled after Agent recovery.

## Purpose

Produce a downstream active-only final report showing all required repos in the expanded universe are active or have explicit blocking findings.

## Post-merge state

After attached PRs merge:
- governance/adrs/ops/ui selected universe is represented in the final report.
- all participating repos/packages are organization-active or produce blocking findings.
- governance-only closure can no longer be mistaken for organization closure.

## Completion audit impact

Contributes to:
- `downstreamAudit`: downstream repos participate.
- `finalGateAudit`: expanded universe has zero blocking findings or explicit valid waivers.
- `completionCertificate.activeRepoCount` and `activePackageCount`.

## Merge blockers

Do not merge child PRs when:
- downstream local cutover issues are incomplete.
- final report excludes required downstream repos.
- blocking findings remain unowned or hidden.
- waiver coverage is broad, stale, or missing expiry/digest.

## Required evidence

- expanded universe final report digest.
- active row counts by repo and package.
- blocking finding count and waiver references if any.
- PR comment stating whether organization closure is achieved or still blocked.

## Boundary

This issue closes expanded-universe reporting. It does not alter downstream repos directly.

## Purpose

Produce a downstream active-only final report showing all required repos in the expanded universe are active or have explicit blocking findings.

## Post-merge state

After attached PRs merge:
- governance/adrs/ops/ui selected universe is represented in the final report.
- all participating repos/packages are organization-active or produce blocking findings.
- governance-only closure can no longer be mistaken for organization closure.

## Completion audit impact

Contributes to:
- `downstreamAudit`: downstream repos participate.
- `finalGateAudit`: expanded universe has zero blocking findings or explicit valid waivers.
- `completionCertificate.activeRepoCount` and `activePackageCount`.

## Merge blockers

Do not merge child PRs when:
- downstream local cutover issues are incomplete.
- final report excludes required downstream repos.
- blocking findings remain unowned or hidden.
- waiver coverage is broad, stale, or missing expiry/digest.

## Required evidence

- expanded universe final report digest.
- active row counts by repo and package.
- blocking finding count and waiver references if any.
- PR comment stating whether organization closure is achieved or still blocked.

## Boundary

This issue closes expanded-universe reporting. It does not alter downstream repos directly.

{"body":"recordId: `HQ-VERIFIED-RESOURCE-INVOCATION-V1`

## Authority

- Parent latest-writer decision: roccho-dev/adrs#211 comment `4978001609`.
- Accepted gap and closure authority: roccho-dev/adrs#222.
- roccho-dev/adrs#220 remains unchanged and independently closable.

## Scope

Add one second operation form under the existing `local-tool` target:

```text
selected hq.local-tool.v1 resource
  + ordered non-secret argv[]
  -> existing instruction.v1 and accepted ledger
  -> approval_required/held until exact digest-bound approval
  -> existing managed worker
  -> existing verified binding and direct executor
  -> existing result.v1
```

Finite named actions remain unchanged and remain the promotion target for repeated typed operations.

## Required implementation

1. Extend one selected local-tool resource with a bounded invocation policy; allow a resource to expose invocation without declaring a per-subcommand action.
2. Accept a strict resource invocation payload containing only tool ID, tool version, and ordered argv.
3. Reject empty argv, empty args, excessive arg count/bytes, and resource-policy authority-escape options before provider preparation.
4. Treat missing approval as held: append policy evidence and accepted evidence, start zero process, emit no terminal blocked result, and permit the same queued run to become runnable after a later exact approval.
5. Keep stale/mismatched approval, invalid payload, policy rejection, unknown resource, stale binding, and executable tampering terminally non-green with zero process start.
6. Reuse the existing local-tool preparer, verified binding registry, direct executor, empty environment, timeout/output bounds, provider evidence, recovery, redaction, cancellation, and result vocabulary.
7. Add deterministic AWS-shaped multi-subcommand proof data and destructive tests. Physical restricted-AWS evidence remains required before adrs#222 closure.

## Fixed exclusions

No shell or command string; executable path; PATH/cwd/shim/plugin/filesystem discovery; queue-owned environment/credential/profile/account/config selection; stdin; PTY/TUI; interactive authentication; generic SSH/OCI; workflow graph; second queue/worker/executor/result; automatic agent submit; automatic finite-action promotion.

## Merge gates

- one resource registration supports at least three distinct argv vectors with zero per-subcommand action/command definitions;
- missing approval is durable held work and starts zero process;
- exact approval resumes the same queued run and executes once;
- denied option, stale approval, unknown resource, binding mismatch, digest tamper, and shell punctuation destructive cases pass;
- existing finite local-tool tests remain green;
- repository Linux and Windows CI pass at the exact final head;
- PR is mergeable, non-draft, has no unresolved review thread, and its final diff creates no parallel runtime.

## Closure relation

Closing this issue and merging its implementation PR are necessary but not sufficient to close adrs#222. adrs#222 additionally requires the restricted AWS physical multi-subcommand evidence and final authority readback."}

request.text:
{"body":"## 背景・目的

既存の coding 主力は Codex / Claude Code、安価な coding-model pool 候補は OpenCode Go（[ADRS #530](https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/issues/530)）。
そこへ、役割が異なる二つの既存FOSSを**必要な時だけ使える**ようにしておきたい。

| 道具 | 使いたい能力 | 非目的 |
|---|---|---|
| Ollama | local / cloud LLM inference。Goの補助・代替候補 | 新model router、daemon常駐、契約代行 |
| Ollaya | local System One決定（分類・選択・点数、TypeSafe互換） | Jev退役、独自判断core、学習・蒸留 |

Ollayaは [ops PR #441](https://github.com/roccho-org/ops/pull/441) にCPU artifact replay PASS、[ops PR #443](https://github.com/roccho-org/ops/pull/443) にWinnow CPU評価（35/36、p50 33.748s）という先行証拠がある。速いモデルを無条件で保証しない。

参照: [ADRS #530](https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/issues/530) / [ADRS #520](https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/issues/520) / [ADRS #465](https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/issues/465) / [ADRS #443](https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/issues/443)。

## repo責務と最小構成

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  subgraph WIN["windows / oci/dev"]
    N["pinned Nix profile"]
    OL["ollama CLI + local runtime"]
    AY["ollaya CLI + local System One runtime"]
    N --> OL
    N --> AY
  end
  subgraph External["任意の外部入力"]
    EN["envs: Ollama Cloud key（別Issue）"]
    M["Ollaya model registry（初回pull）"]
  end
  EN -. "認証済み時のみ" .-> OL
  M -. "使用時のみ" .-> AY
```

**windowsは実行可能なbinとOCI境界だけ所有**する。API key、契約・請求、provider固有判断契約、model選択の意味を所有しない。

## 完成条件（現地配置とsourceを区別）

1. 既存の固定Nixpkgs / exact release pinで、oci/devのprofileから `ollama` と `ollaya` が呼べる。実行時latestを勝手に入れない。
2. CPU-only、起動時daemon 0、port公開 0、model自動download 0。現在のPi/Jev/gh-auth/envs設定の意味を変えない。
3. CLIの版・helpと、非秘密のlocal-only実行入口をCIで検査する。少なくとも配布物として呼べることを実証する。
4. Ollayaは既存`/v1/systemone`を使う。新しいSystem One adapter/評価基盤を作らない。local `127.0.0.1:11435`のみ、公開portなし。
5. Ollama localは `127.0.0.1:11434`のみ。Cloud keyはenvs経由の別境界で扱い、CLI製品に平文を入れない。
6. exact-head CI / protected PR review / normal merge / canonical CIでsourceを閉じ、実環境のimage更新・モデル初回pull・Cloud実通信は別のreadbackとして残す。

## 破壊条件

- ① Go用`pi_auth_command`を変更する ② keyをGit、log、argvに置く ③ 自動でservice/daemonを起動する
- ④ local APIを`0.0.0.0`へ出す ⑤ 自動model pullや巨大modelのimage同梱 ⑥ GPU依存をデフォルト化
- ⑦ Jevのaccepted判断をOllayaの結果で上書きする ⑧ CPUモデルの速度未確認を即時PASSとする
- ⑨ 同じ provider adapter をopsとwindowsで二重開発 ⑩ CIsのfixture PASSをlive利用PASSと呼ぶ
- ⑪ /nix store再作成時に鍵やモデルを不可逆消失させる ⑫ 偽のCloud key疎通を成功として記録する

## Source PR

[PR roccho-dev/windows#66](https://github.com/roccho-dev/windows/pull/66)（Draft）— 既存OCI profileへCLIを追加。model storeは既存work volume、実key・実provider応答は別gate。

## Scope

最小source PRは`oci/dev`のprofile/依存と必要なら同じ既存proofだけ。独立provider/router framework、envs secretの新authority、opsのJev代替判断は追加しない。

**提案であり本Issue起案だけで実model配置・subscription・provider effect・mergeを承認済みとみなさない。**
"}

Parent: #99

## Purpose

Turn the merged workspace, approval, and redaction contracts into one mandatory worker execution sequence. Safety must constrain the real path, not remain an independently tested package.

## Contribution to parent

| generation | contribution |
|---:|---|
| scope | Integrates F-lane safety into C/D worker and adapter execution. |
| product | Gives every target one shared safety path. |
| system | Prevents dispatch or durable logging from bypassing approval and redaction. |
| organization | Removes adapter-owner discretion over common safety. |
| business/meta | Reduces incident, handoff, and technical-DD risk. |

Directly closes parent acceptance criteria:

- validation precedes approval, redaction, durable append, and dispatch;
- approval-required work never reaches an adapter without exact approval;
- secret fixtures do not survive in durable policy/result records.

## Required execution order

```text
read
-> validate instruction.v1
-> evaluate digest-bound approval policy
-> redact policy evidence
-> durable policy/validation append
-> dispatch only when may_dispatch=true
-> redact transient adapter output/completion/error
-> durable result.v1 append
-> session.v1 projection
```

No concrete adapter may reorder or bypass this sequence.

## Scope

- compose `internal/workersafety` into the worker processing path;
- bind policy decision to exact canonical instruction digest;
- redact all durable policy, stdout, stderr, error, final metadata, and final text/path records where applicable;
- pass only approved validated requests to registry/adapter;
- fail closed when policy or redaction fails;
- preserve canonical `validation.v1` and `result.v1` as durable contracts.

## Non-scope

- full DLP;
- credential vault implementation;
- UI approval workflow;
- OS sandbox;
- target-specific permission models.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Worker invokes validation before policy.
- [ ] Worker invokes policy before registry lookup or adapter execution.
- [ ] `require_approval` without exact current instruction-digest approval produces durable blocked evidence and zero adapter calls.
- [ ] Stale or mismatched approval produces zero adapter calls.
- [ ] A safe approved fixture reaches a fake adapter exactly once.
- [ ] Policy evidence is redacted before durable append.
- [ ] Adapter stdout, stderr, final answer, error, and metadata are redacted before `result.v1` append.
- [ ] Known secret fixture plaintext is absent from every durable file and proof artifact.
- [ ] Redaction or policy internal failure fails closed and produces no dispatch.
- [ ] Adapter cannot override the worker-owned policy decision or canonical lifecycle fields.
- [ ] Restart/readback preserves the same blocked/completed projection.

## Destructive cases

The issue is not complete if any succeeds:

1. registry lookup or adapter call occurs before policy;
2. adapter runs when approval is missing, stale, or digest-mismatched;
3. secret plaintext reaches durable JSONL or final artifact;
4. redaction failure falls back to unredacted append;
5. adapter supplies its own approval or risk result;
6. policy result is stored only as terminal text;
7. blocked work creates a completed session;
8. one target bypasses the common path.

## Evidence

- fake adapter call-count tests;
- allow, block, pending, stale, and digest-mismatch fixtures;
- known-secret durable-tree absence scan;
- exact canonical `result.v1` output fixtures;
- restart/session projection proof;
- Linux and Windows worker CI.

## Dependencies

- #41-#51
- #75-#77
- #100

Blocks:

- #52-#66 concrete adapter merge quality
- #81-#83 integrated proof
- parent #99 closure

## Merge condition

Merge only when safety is mandatory in the real common worker path and negative tests prove no adapter or durable append can bypass it.

## Purpose

Emit actionable blocking findings for required repo packet problems before org join can mark a repo active.

Parent phase issue: #80

## Scope

This is an issue for a future governance implementation PR. Do not open or implement the PR from this issue alone.

## Requirements

- Consume D1 required repo universe output.
- Consume D2 packet registry/transport output.
- Emit finding for required repo missing packet.
- Emit finding for missing packet source.
- Emit finding for packet fetch/read failure.
- Emit finding for unpinned packet source.
- Emit finding for malformed packet.
- Emit finding for unsupported schema version.
- Emit finding for stale packet/sourceRev according to freshness rule.
- Emit finding for missing producer provenance.
- Emit finding for producerRepo mismatch.
- Emit finding for producerRev mismatch.
- Emit finding for packetDigest/outputDigest mismatch where available.
- Findings must include `repoId`, `expected`, `actual`, `delta`, `diagnosticClass`, `likelyOwner`, `nextAction`, and relevant digests/refs.
- Findings must be deterministic and stable sorted.
- Findings must not claim final admission by themselves.

## Done when

- Clean fixture emits no blocking packet findings.
- Missing packet fixture emits stable actionable finding.
- Stale packet fixture emits stable actionable finding.
- Malformed packet fixture emits stable actionable finding.
- Invalid producer metadata fixture emits stable actionable finding.
- CLI/check returns nonzero for blocking dirty fixtures when run in strict finding mode.

## Not done when

- Missing/stale/malformed packets are warning-only.
- Findings are prose-only or lack nextAction.
- Missing packet can be skipped because repo is unreachable.
- Finding order is nondeterministic.
- PR claims final gate, branch protection, downstream rollout, or organization-active admission.

## Evidence required in child PR

- Finding emitter/check path.
- Clean fixture path.
- Missing packet fixture path.
- Stale packet fixture path.
- Malformed packet fixture path.
- Invalid provenance metadata fixture path.
- Example finding JSONL/report output.
- Check/selftest command.

## Child PR comment template

```text
Child PR: governance#<number>
Phase issue: #80 / D3

## Purpose
Require explicit approval or blocking behavior for potentially destructive worker actions.

## Scope-to-meta contribution
| generation | contribution |
|---|---|
| scope | Keeps editor-selected rows from becoming unsafe auto-execution. |
| product | Makes execution policy explicit. |
| system/org | Supports safe human-in-the-loop boundaries. |
| business/meta | Reduces operational risk for agent factory use. |

## Scope
- Define `policy.allow_auto`, `policy.require_approval`, and blocked behavior.
- Add examples for safe auto-run and dangerous blocked rows.

## Non-scope
- Full permission server.
- UI approval workflow.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Dangerous operations can be represented as blocked/pending approval.
- [ ] Worker does not execute approval-required rows automatically.
- [ ] Policy result is stored as JSONL event.

## Breaking cases
- [ ] Destructive row executes because it came from Vim/hq.
- [ ] Approval state exists only in free text.

## Evidence
- Policy fixtures.
- Tests.

## Merge condition
Merge only when dangerous work cannot auto-run without explicit policy approval.

## 目的・位置付け

Own / Rent / 各Providerの実体、配置先、任せる仕事、依存を一枚で俯瞰するための**読取用全体図**。配置の重複、移行費用、運用負荷を減らし、低コストで継続改善できる開発工場と顧客向け基盤を作る。

**状態：現状調査＋設計案。実装・実機採用・Provider契約の採択を意味しない。**
確認基準：2026-10-19 JST。ここに配置・秘密・認証・契約・稼働の第二正本を作らない。

| 既存Issue | 所有する内容 | このIssueとの境界 |
|---|---|---|
| [resources #1](https://github.com/roccho-dev/resources/issues/1) | Host識別、contains / manages、任意wrapの宣言と整合性 | Host relationの実装・検証は#1 |
| [ADRS #630](https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/issues/630) | Host relationの意味・admission | 意味の変更はしない |
| [resources #25](https://github.com/roccho-dev/resources/issues/25) | Windows repoからresourcesへの移管・閉包 | 移行・archiveの証拠は#25 |
| [resources #10](https://github.com/roccho-dev/resources/issues/10)、[#52](https://github.com/roccho-dev/resources/issues/52) | NixOS上OCI、Windows own/rent OCIの個別受入 | 配備済み・稼働成功とは推定しない |

- selftest/check command and expected exit codes.
- CI/check proving destructive cases fail as intended.
- PR comment linking this issue and listing covered negative cases.

## Boundary

## Purpose

Add positive and destructive receipt fixtures so missing, stale, wrong-decision, wrong-assertion, and malformed receipts cannot pass as evidence.

## Post-merge state

After attached PRs merge:
- valid receipts pass fixture validation.
- missing/stale/wrong digest receipts fail in strict fixture mode.
- final join phases can rely on receipt fixtures as regression seeds.

## Completion audit impact

Contributes to:
- `receiptAudit`: destructive coverage for receipt validity.
- `toolSelftestAudit`: receipt verifier regression coverage.
- `completionCertificate.receiptFixtureDigest`.

## Merge blockers

Do not merge child PRs when:
- only happy path receipts are tested.
- stale decisionDigest or assertionDigest can still pass.
- missing receipt is downgraded to warning only.
- fixture output lacks expected exit code or finding class.

## Required evidence

- fixture paths for clean, missing, stale, wrong-decision, wrong-assertion, and malformed receipt cases.
- selftest/check command and expected exit codes.
- CI/check proving destructive cases fail as intended.
- PR comment linking this issue and listing covered negative cases.

## Boundary

This issue closes receipt fixture coverage only. It does not close final report compilation or branch protection.

- `receiptAudit`: destructive coverage for receipt validity.
- `toolSelftestAudit`: receipt verifier regression coverage.
- `completionCertificate.receiptFixtureDigest`.

## Merge blockers

Do not merge child PRs when:
- only happy path receipts are tested.
- stale decisionDigest or assertionDigest can still pass.
- missing receipt is downgraded to warning only.
- fixture output lacks expected exit code or finding class.

- fixture paths for clean, missing, stale, wrong-decision, wrong-assertion, and malformed receipt cases.
- selftest/check command and expected exit codes.
- CI/check proving destructive cases fail as intended.
- PR comment linking this issue and listing covered negative cases.

## Boundary

This issue closes receipt fixture coverage only. It does not close final report compilation or branch protection.

## Purpose

Define `edits` as the local/dev control plane for Vim, hq, local queue, local worker, and repo adapters.

## Completion state

This is complete when future PRs can attach to `edits` without ambiguity about repo responsibility, local-only state, generated evidence, or dependency direction.

- Document `edits` as the local/dev operation surface, not the canonical model authority.

- Allow only one-way dependency from `edits` to `ui`, contracts, and source repos.
- Forbid `ui`, contracts, or source repos from depending on `edits`.
- Define how a temporary `contracts-poc` can later split into a contracts repo.

## Suggested PRs

1. Add README/docs boundary.
2. Add minimal directories and `.gitignore` for `.local/`.
3. Add PR/issue operation notes for attached work.

- [ ] README says `edits` is a local/dev control plane.
- [ ] README says `edits` is not the accepted model authority.
- [ ] Local queue is explicitly not state store or authority.
- [ ] `.local/queue.jsonl`, `.local/receipt.jsonl`, `.local/current-target.json`, `.local/current-projection.json` are gitignored.
- [ ] Committed examples live under `examples/`, not `.local/`.
- [ ] Dependency direction is documented as `edits -> ui/contracts/source repos` only.
- [ ] Generated HTML, preview, and projection are evidence only.

## Non-scope

- hq implementation.
- UI renderer changes.
- cue validation implementation.
- accepted ledger operation.

{"body":"Parent: #99

## Purpose

Build one mixed-target run ledger from canonical durable evidence so recent shell, Herdr, Codex, and Claude work can be inspected without target-specific hunting.

## Corrected evidence boundary

The ledger is rebuilt from valid durable `instruction.v1` and `result.v1` rows. `session.v1` and the ledger are projections only.

The former wording "event/session rows" was insufficient because `op` and `cwd` originate in the linked instruction, while a stored session row must never become authority.

## Purpose lineage

| generation | purpose | contribution | relation |
|---:|---|---|---|
| G0 scope | Produce one recent-run ledger. | Reduces canonical instruction/result evidence into mixed-target rows. | direct |
| G1 correctness | Never invent a healthy run from incomplete or invalid evidence. | Requires linked instruction identity and valid result lifecycle. | direct |
| G2 boundary | Keep read models non-authoritative. | No ledger or session row can overwrite source evidence. | direct |
| G3 product | Remove per-target session hunting. | One row shape covers sh, Herdr, Codex, and Claude. | direct |
| G4 system | Rebuild state after restart. | Ledger is a deterministic reduction of durable JSONL. | direct |
| G5 organization | Give humans and agents one reviewable operation view. | Handoff no longer depends on target UI knowledge. | direct |
| G6 business | Lower supervision cost for parallel agent execution. | Recent work is reviewable from one surface. | direct |
| G7 transfer | Let a new owner reconstruct run history. | Stable fields, fixtures, and tests expose the evidence chain. | indirect |
| G8 due diligence | Make execution claims reproducible. | Mixed-target and invalid-evidence cases are mechanically checked. | indirect |
| G9 asset value | Preserve a small extensible runtime without another database. | Existing append-only JSONL remains sufficient. | indirect |
| G10 meta | Increase company value and saleability. | Lower hidden-state and handoff risk improves transferability. | indirect |

## Scope

- Build a transient `worker.ledger.v1` read model from valid `instruction.v1` and `result.v1` rows.
- Reuse canonical `session.v1` lifecycle reduction.
- Include run id, instruction id, target, op, status, cwd, started time, last event time/kind, native session id, summary, final path, and structured error where available.
- Sort recent runs by `last_event_at`, newest first.
- Preserve one row per run/attempt; never collapse retry/replay history.
- Return non-green diagnostics for invalid or unlinked evidence.

## Non-scope

- Persisting the ledger as authority.
- Browser UI.
- Live target discovery.
- Adapter execution, approval, retry, claim, or endpoint placement.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Mixed sh/Herdr/Codex/Claude runs appear in one list.
- [ ] queued/running/completed/failed/blocked/timeout/cancelled are clear.
- [ ] Native session refs, final paths, and errors appear when present.
- [ ] `op` and `cwd` come from linked canonical instruction evidence, not defaults invented by observation.
- [ ] Newest run ordering is deterministic.
- [ ] Deleting stored projection data and rebuilding produces the same ledger.
- [ ] Invalid lifecycle or missing instruction evidence cannot produce a healthy ledger row.
- [ ] Ledger output performs zero durable writes and zero adapter calls.

## Destructive cases

The issue is not complete if any succeeds:

1. a stored session row overrides instruction/result evidence;
2. observation fills missing op/target/cwd with target-specific defaults;
3. invalid lifecycle appears green;
4. a target requires live CLI discovery for basic history;
5. retry/replay attempts are collapsed into one row;
6. ledger generation mutates durable state;
7. endpoint location changes ledger meaning.

## Dependencies

Foundation:

- #36-#48
- #75

Integrated validation:

- #100-#102
- #52-#66
- #81-#84
- #98 for managed lifecycle/crash states

## Evidence

- Mixed-target pure projection test.
- Newest-first ordering test.
- Missing/invalid instruction and lifecycle negatives.
- Binary-level JSON ledger artifact on Linux; Windows build and command test.
- Architecture readback proving the ledger is disposable.

## Merge condition

Merge only when one deterministic, non-authoritative ledger explains recent runs across targets from canonical durable evidence and cannot dispatch or mutate execution state."}

Parent: #99

## Purpose

Build one mixed-target run ledger from canonical durable evidence so recent shell, Herdr, Codex, and Claude work can be inspected without target-specific hunting.

## Corrected evidence boundary

The ledger is rebuilt from valid durable `instruction.v1` and `result.v1` rows. `session.v1` and the ledger are projections only.

The former wording "event/session rows" was insufficient because `op` and `cwd` originate in the linked instruction, while a stored session row must never become authority.

## Purpose lineage

| generation | purpose | contribution | relation |
|---:|---|---|---|
| G0 scope | Produce one recent-run ledger. | Reduces canonical instruction/result evidence into mixed-target rows. | direct |
| G1 correctness | Never invent a healthy run from incomplete or invalid evidence. | Requires linked instruction identity and valid result lifecycle. | direct |
| G2 boundary | Keep read models non-authoritative. | No ledger or session row can overwrite source evidence. | direct |
| G3 product | Remove per-target session hunting. | One row shape covers sh, Herdr, Codex, and Claude. | direct |
| G4 system | Rebuild state after restart. | Ledger is a deterministic reduction of durable JSONL. | direct |
| G5 organization | Give humans and agents one reviewable operation view. | Handoff no longer depends on target UI knowledge. | direct |
| G6 business | Lower supervision cost for parallel agent execution. | Recent work is reviewable from one surface. | direct |
| G7 transfer | Let a new owner reconstruct run history. | Stable fields, fixtures, and tests expose the evidence chain. | indirect |
| G8 due diligence | Make execution claims reproducible. | Mixed-target and invalid-evidence cases are mechanically checked. | indirect |
| G9 asset value | Preserve a small extensible runtime without another database. | Existing append-only JSONL remains sufficient. | indirect |
| G10 meta | Increase company value and saleability. | Lower hidden-state and handoff risk improves transferability. | indirect |

## Scope

- Build a transient `worker.ledger.v1` read model from valid `instruction.v1` and `result.v1` rows.
- Reuse canonical `session.v1` lifecycle reduction.
- Include run id, instruction id, target, op, status, cwd, started time, last event time/kind, native session id, summary, final path, and structured error where available.
- Sort recent runs by `last_event_at`, newest first.
- Preserve one row per run/attempt; never collapse retry/replay history.
- Return non-green diagnostics for invalid or unlinked evidence.

## Non-scope

- Persisting the ledger as authority.
- Browser UI.
- Live target discovery.
- Adapter execution, approval, retry, claim, or endpoint placement.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Mixed sh/Herdr/Codex/Claude runs appear in one list.
- [ ] queued/running/completed/failed/blocked/timeout/cancelled are clear.
- [ ] Native session refs, final paths, and errors appear when present.
- [ ] `op` and `cwd` come from linked canonical instruction evidence, not defaults invented by observation.
- [ ] Newest run ordering is deterministic.
- [ ] Deleting stored projection data and rebuilding produces the same ledger.
- [ ] Invalid lifecycle or missing instruction evidence cannot produce a healthy ledger row.
- [ ] Ledger output performs zero durable writes and zero adapter calls.

## Destructive cases

The issue is not complete if any succeeds:

1. a stored session row overrides instruction/result evidence;
2. observation fills missing op/target/cwd with target-specific defaults;
3. invalid lifecycle appears green;
4. a target requires live CLI discovery for basic history;
5. retry/replay attempts are collapsed into one row;
6. ledger generation mutates durable state;
7. endpoint location changes ledger meaning.

## Dependencies

Foundation:

- #36-#48
- #75

Integrated validation:

- #100-#102
- #52-#66
- #81-#84
- #98 for managed lifecycle/crash states

## Evidence

- Mixed-target pure projection test.
- Newest-first ordering test.
- Missing/invalid instruction and lifecycle negatives.
- Binary-level JSON ledger artifact on Linux; Windows build and command test.
- Architecture readback proving the ledger is disposable.

## Merge condition

Merge only when one deterministic, non-authoritative ledger explains recent runs across targets from canonical durable evidence and cannot dispatch or mutate execution state.

Decide whether it contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract: a rule, expected or acceptable condition, responsibility, functional capability, input/output mapping, interface purpose, or condition or limitation of use. A stated expected-outcome caption or interface text declaring an action's purpose can qualify. No formal specification label, generality, adoption, implementation, must-word or future tense is required. Distinguish the role of the relationship being stated. Declaring what a function does or what condition applies counts; merely describing what happened, is happening, used to happen or regularly happens in observed execution does not by itself declare a specification. A performed configuration, measured value, comparison or causal explanation does not supply an unstated applicable contract. These are role distinctions, not rules excluding particular headings, formats, tenses or words: a report may also contain a genuine specification, and an ordinary capability statement can declare one without requesting a change. Read each statement in context; one qualifying declaration anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when used to declare the specification, but not when displayed only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'This dial sets the sampling interval' declares a function; 'I turned the dial and the reading changed' alone reports an observation. A request or a subject's goal alone does not establish this specification role. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. It declares the relationship itself; merely reporting a performed action, observed configuration or value, observed result, or a causal explanation of an observed event does not by itself establish that role. A genuine declaration still counts inside a report, quotation or template when the body uses it to declare that relationship.
options.no: The complete body contains no statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; observations elsewhere do not cancel a genuine declaration.

request.instruction: Read only the complete literal body, including HTML comments, tables, formulas and templates. Decide whether it contains at least one genuine request for an action, answer, submission, improvement or remedy, or explicitly presents an action or state as a subject's intended goal or need. Count indirect requests and actual conditional reporting or submission directions, including directions carried by a template or HTML comment whether or not the requested information has been supplied. No addressee, stated reason, fully identified final goal, solution, adoption or implementation is required. Distinguish a relationship presented as a target or request from wording that only locates the circumstances of a reported event or explains a necessary response to it. An incident, inability, missing feature, risk, complaint, category or recipient mention alone does not declare the desired opposite or request its correction. Merely explaining what was necessary to obtain an observed result or work around it does not by itself declare an intended goal. Do not exclude a genuine goal or request merely because it appears within a report or a subordinate clause; do not infer one solely from modality, tense, a heading, mention, imperative form or question mark. A specification or expected caption alone does not establish this request or subject-goal role. One qualifying statement anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when the body uses it to make an actual request or goal declaration, but not when shown only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'I need a cost estimate before ordering the materials' declares a goal or need; 'The estimate arrived late, so I postponed the order' alone reports an event and response. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. This includes actual reporting or submission directions before the requested information is supplied. Merely naming a category or recipient, reporting an incident or inability, or explaining a necessary workaround does not itself establish this role.
options.no: The complete body contains no genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; a report or subordinate clause does not cancel an actual request or goal.

## Purpose

Open a parent tracking issue for the remaining UI retirement and PR governance follow-up work.

This parent exists to prevent the same failure pattern from recurring: PRs must not proceed with unclear scope, weak completion criteria, or ambiguous merge quality.

## Highest objective

High-value company build and eventual sale.

## Meta objective

Reduce future human cost by keeping `ui.git` free of false positives, tombstones, parallel retired implementations, and unreviewable merge decisions.

## Scope

- Track all child issues opened from the remaining-task table.
- Keep future PRs issue-led.
- Preserve the appendix table below as the scope/meta reference for all child issues.
- Do not implement code in this parent issue.

## Non-scope

- No implementation.
- No merge approval.
- No PR creation from this parent alone.

## Completion criteria

- All child issues from the appendix are opened.
- Each child issue states scope, direct purpose, upper purpose, meta purpose, highest objective, completion criteria, and non-scope.
- Future PRs reference their issue before implementation and merge judgment.

## Appendix: scope to meta table

| # | issue候補 | 実務スコープ | 直接目的 | 上位目的 | メタ目的 | 最上位目的 | 非スコープ |
|---:|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 全issueの親issue | 以後のPRをissue起点に統制する | 無視・解釈ズレ・勝手mergeを防ぐ | PRごとの目的達成を検査可能にする | 将来の人間コストを増やさない | 高価値法人構築と売却 | 実装作業 |
| 1 | #78 draft解除・merge判断 | #78のmerge可否確認 | 退役物理削除PRを正しくmerge判断する | 退役不備を閉じる | repoを残骸で汚さない | 高価値法人構築と売却 | 自動merge |
| 2 | #78 merge後の退役物理削除確認 | default branchで物理不在確認 | `packages/purpose-atlas-preview` 残存をゼロにする | 退役完了を事実で閉じる | 二重実装コストを消す | 高価値法人構築と売却 | 新UI設計 |
| 3 | #78 merge後CI再確認 | merge後commitのCI確認 | merge後もgreenを保証する | 退役完了の証跡を残す | CI信頼性を保つ | 高価値法人構築と売却 | CI設計変更 |
| 4 | PRはissue起点の運用明文化 | PR前にissueを必須にする | 指示意図をPR本文だけに閉じ込めない | スコープ逸脱を減らす | 組織的判断品質を上げる | 高価値法人構築と売却 | 過去PR修正 |
| 5 | issueテンプレート作成 | issue作成時の型を作る | 目的・範囲・完了条件を固定する | 判断の再現性を上げる | 意思決定を型化する | 高価値法人構築と売却 | 複雑なworkflow導入 |
| 6 | PRテンプレート作成 | PR本文の必須項目を作る | issue対応・非スコープ・merge条件を明示する | merge判断の抜けを減らす | レビュー負荷を下げる | 高価値法人構築と売却 | PR自動生成 |
| 7 | 無視防止チェック追加 | issueなし/merge条件なしを止める | 低品質PRを入口で止める | 指示漏れを構造で防ぐ | 人間レビュー依存を減らす | 高価値法人構築と売却 | 過去名guard |
| 8 | #75/#76/#78後処理棚卸し | 3PRの整合確認 | 偽陽性削除・退役・物理削除の一貫性を見る | repo状態を現在形へ揃える | 残骸コストを消す | 高価値法人構築と売却 | 新機能追加 |

Open a parent tracking issue for the remaining UI retirement and PR governance follow-up work.

This parent exists to prevent the same failure pattern from recurring: PRs must not proceed with unclear scope, weak completion criteria, or ambiguous merge quality.

## Highest objective

High-value company build and eventual sale.

## Meta objective

- No implementation.
- No merge approval.
- No PR creation from this parent alone.

request.instructions:
body内の各文を、望ましい状態の宣言と、実際に起きたことの報告に分けて読んでください。EとOは同時にyesでも構いません。Eは文書の主題や多数決ではなく存在判定です。具体的な要求文・完成条件・目標文が一文でもあれば、残りが全部作業報告でもE=yesです。例えば「利用者に完了を通知すること」は期待ですが、「利用者に通知した」は実施報告であり期待ではありません。Goal・Acceptanceという見出しそのものは期待文ではなく、その下に過去の実施報告しかなければE=noです。表・数式・役割が完成状態の対応を定義する場合も期待です。Oでは実測の引用・確認状況一覧・本文内HTMLコメントの作業メモも数えますが、架空の試験入力・条件付きの例は数えません。許容を表す「〜でもよい」や仮定・可能性だけを述べる文は、現状の報告ではありません。例えば「点検は後日でもよい」は許容条件ですが、「点検はまだしていない」は現在の状態の報告です。O=yesにするには、本文が現実にそうだと主張している箇所が必要です。与えられたbody全体だけを対象に判断し、そこにない現状を推測しないでください。
本問はEだけ：本文が実現すべき状態を一つでも宣言しているか。完成状態の表・責務・式も宣言である。Goal等の見出しだけでYesにしない。本文にそのような期待がなければNo。実施済みと書いてあるだけなら期待ではない。

{"body":"## Status and authority

```text
record: UI_VERSION_FIXED_INVOCATION_RED_001
status: CANON_TDD_RED_SPEC_OPEN__IMPLEMENTATION_NOT_STARTED
parent: roccho-dev/ui#190
decision: roccho-dev/adrs#347
downstream: roccho-dev/ops#327
sequence: 1/7

opening_authorizes_merge: false
opening_authorizes_provider_effect: false
accepted_meaning_authority: false
production_cutover_authorized: false
```

This Issue defines the first independently mergeable behavior slice under `ui#190`. It is opened as a specification and RED target only. It creates no branch or PR and may be rebased onto the exact current UI head when implementation starts.

## Expected effect

One exact public semantic state and one exact UI projection/runtime tuple produce one stable, provider-independent invocation identity and one stable Release-root-relative CSR invocation reference.

```text
exact semantic state
+ exact projection profile
+ exact Artifact Shell kernel
+ exact capability id/version/engine
+ exact invocation schema/codec
+ exact projection intent
→ invocation_id
→ <exact-runtime-relative-path>#invoke=<canonical-payload>
```

The same exact tuple builds byte-identically. A change to any version-bearing element creates a new invocation. Ops can deploy the resulting Release without re-encoding it.

## Completed behavior

1. The existing `artifact-invocation/2` contract remains the only invocation request model.
2. The existing `url-module` remains the only canonical codec.
3. Artifact Shell remains the only browser runtime/composition root.
4. The builder accepts exact semantic input, exact projection profile, exact content-addressed runtime/kernel, exact capability, and exact intent.
5. It emits a stable `invocation_id` and Release-root-relative invocation reference.
6. Provider hostname, mutable deployment ID, credentials, and `latest` are absent from the version identity and canonical reference.
7. Two clean runs from the same exact inputs emit byte-identical request bytes, `invocation_id`, URL fragment, and generated manifest fields.
8. Changing semantic state, profile, kernel, capability version/engine, invocation schema, or projection intent changes the invocation identity and reference.
9. Small public-safe inputs may use inline transport.
10. Inputs that fail the measured URL roundtrip gate use immutable relative URL plus expected digest.
11. Inline and external transport of the same canonical state/profile produce the same semantic output digest.
12. Direct navigation in a fresh browser decodes the reference and reports the expected request, input, kernel, capability, and semantic output identities.
13. Refresh and a second fresh browser load reproduce the same semantic output.
14. No new runtime, codec, request schema family, provider adapter, database, or server is introduced.

## Kent Beck Canon TDD RED contract

Before production implementation, add the smallest fixed tests through the existing public package/runtime boundaries. The initial RED commit or first PR commit must show that the existing implementation fails only because the following behavior is absent, not because fixtures, imports, or the repository baseline are broken.

Required Canon REDs:

1. `same_exact_tuple_is_byte_identical` — two clean builds must produce equal invocation bytes, identity, and reference.
2. `semantic_change_creates_new_version` — one semantic value change must change the identity/reference.
3. `profile_change_creates_new_version_without_changing_state_identity`.
4. `kernel_change_creates_new_version`.
5. `capability_change_creates_new_version`.
6. `schema_or_codec_change_creates_new_version`.
7. `projection_intent_change_creates_new_version`.
8. `provider_origin_is_not_part_of_invocation_identity` — two local origins must retain the same invocation identity.
9. `mutable_latest_is_rejected_for_canonical_reference`.
10. `inline_roundtrip_is_canonical` — encode/decode/re-encode is byte-identical.
11. `external_input_requires_immutable_relative_ref_and_digest`.
12. `inline_external_semantic_output_parity`.
13. `fresh_browser_reports_exact_expected_identities`.
14. `refresh_and_second_context_reproduce_output`.
15. `secret_or_credential_bearing_url_is_rejected`.
16. `redirect_or_digest_mismatch_fails_before_render`.
17. `partial_or_empty_render_cannot_report_success`.
18. `no_second_codec_runtime_or_request_model_is_added`.

Each RED must have one named expected failure reason. A test that fails because a file is missing, the fixture is malformed, Chromium cannot start, or the existing baseline is Red is not an accepted Canon RED.

## Merge permission

Merge is permitted only when all are true:

- every fixed Canon RED is Green through the real public boundary;
- the tests existed and demonstrated the intended RED before the production change that makes them Green;
- no required test was deleted, skipped, marked flaky/xfail, weakened, or changed to assert implementation details;
- the same exact inputs still build byte-identically twice;
- all existing `artifact-invocation`, `url-module`, Artifact Shell, Semantic Map, browser, and repository checks remain Green;
- the exact PR head commit/tree and the tested artifact/receipt identities are recorded;
- generated outputs remain `authority:false`;
- no provider deployment, public-selection, accepted-meaning, effect, or production-cutover claim is made.

## Likely ownership surface

Prefer extending existing owners only:

```text
packages/artifact-invocation/**
packages/url-module/**
apps/artifact-shell/**
existing artifact-runtime/browser checks
```

A new package or workflow requires a demonstrated responsibility that cannot fit an existing owner.

## Non-goals

```text
provider deployment
absolute public hostname selection
remote provider readback
URL index aggregation
legacy URL import
current/latest alias mutation
new public decision JSONL
new codec or runtime
```

## Done

Close only when a fresh reviewer can start from the exact tested UI revision, build the same exact tuple twice, obtain the same provider-independent invocation identity/reference, change each version-bearing input and obtain a new version, open both inline and external forms in fresh Chromium, and read back matching semantic/runtime identities with the entire existing UI suite Green."}

## Status and authority

```text
record: UI_VERSION_FIXED_INVOCATION_RED_001
status: CANON_TDD_RED_SPEC_OPEN__IMPLEMENTATION_NOT_STARTED
parent: roccho-dev/ui#190
decision: roccho-dev/adrs#347
downstream: roccho-dev/ops#327
sequence: 1/7

opening_authorizes_merge: false
opening_authorizes_provider_effect: false
accepted_meaning_authority: false
production_cutover_authorized: false
```

This Issue defines the first independently mergeable behavior slice under `ui#190`. It is opened as a specification and RED target only. It creates no branch or PR and may be rebased onto the exact current UI head when implementation starts.

## Expected effect

One exact public semantic state and one exact UI projection/runtime tuple produce one stable, provider-independent invocation identity and one stable Release-root-relative CSR invocation reference.

```text
exact semantic state
+ exact projection profile
+ exact Artifact Shell kernel
+ exact capability id/version/engine
+ exact invocation schema/codec
+ exact projection intent
→ invocation_id
→ <exact-runtime-relative-path>#invoke=<canonical-payload>
```

The same exact tuple builds byte-identically. A change to any version-bearing element creates a new invocation. Ops can deploy the resulting Release without re-encoding it.

## Completed behavior

1. The existing `artifact-invocation/2` contract remains the only invocation request model.
2. The existing `url-module` remains the only canonical codec.
3. Artifact Shell remains the only browser runtime/composition root.
4. The builder accepts exact semantic input, exact projection profile, exact content-addressed runtime/kernel, exact capability, and exact intent.
5. It emits a stable `invocation_id` and Release-root-relative invocation reference.
6. Provider hostname, mutable deployment ID, credentials, and `latest` are absent from the version identity and canonical reference.
7. Two clean runs from the same exact inputs emit byte-identical request bytes, `invocation_id`, URL fragment, and generated manifest fields.
8. Changing semantic state, profile, kernel, capability version/engine, invocation schema, or projection intent changes the invocation identity and reference.
9. Small public-safe inputs may use inline transport.
10. Inputs that fail the measured URL roundtrip gate use immutable relative URL plus expected digest.
11. Inline and external transport of the same canonical state/profile produce the same semantic output digest.
12. Direct navigation in a fresh browser decodes the reference and reports the expected request, input, kernel, capability, and semantic output identities.
13. Refresh and a second fresh browser load reproduce the same semantic output.
14. No new runtime, codec, request schema family, provider adapter, database, or server is introduced.

## Kent Beck Canon TDD RED contract

Before production implementation, add the smallest fixed tests through the existing public package/runtime boundaries. The initial RED commit or first PR commit must show that the existing implementation fails only because the following behavior is absent, not because fixtures, imports, or the repository baseline are broken.

Required Canon REDs:

1. `same_exact_tuple_is_byte_identical` — two clean builds must produce equal invocation bytes, identity, and reference.
2. `semantic_change_creates_new_version` — one semantic value change must change the identity/reference.
3. `profile_change_creates_new_version_without_changing_state_identity`.
4. `kernel_change_creates_new_version`.
5. `capability_change_creates_new_version`.
6. `schema_or_codec_change_creates_new_version`.
7. `projection_intent_change_creates_new_version`.
8. `provider_origin_is_not_part_of_invocation_identity` — two local origins must retain the same invocation identity.
9. `mutable_latest_is_rejected_for_canonical_reference`.
10. `inline_roundtrip_is_canonical` — encode/decode/re-encode is byte-identical.
11. `external_input_requires_immutable_relative_ref_and_digest`.
12. `inline_external_semantic_output_parity`.
13. `fresh_browser_reports_exact_expected_identities`.
14. `refresh_and_second_context_reproduce_output`.
15. `secret_or_credential_bearing_url_is_rejected`.
16. `redirect_or_digest_mismatch_fails_before_render`.
17. `partial_or_empty_render_cannot_report_success`.
18. `no_second_codec_runtime_or_request_model_is_added`.

Run Codex in non-interactive mode from validated JSONL rows and persist thread/session id, events, and final answer.

## Scope-to-meta contribution
| generation | contribution |
|---|---|
| scope | Proves non-TUI agent execution path. |
| product | Adds Codex as a worker adapter, not an `hq` feature. |
| system/org | Allows agent answers to be read later from logs. |
| business/meta | Adds automated coding-agent factory capability. |

## Scope
- Invoke Codex exec-equivalent command from adapter boundary.
- Capture JSON/event output, final answer path, exit code, and thread id when available.

## Non-scope
- Codex resume.
- Herdr wrapping.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Valid Codex exec fixture produces started/completed or failed events.
- [ ] Final answer is persisted outside terminal scrollback.
- [ ] Thread/session id is stored when available.

## Breaking cases
- [ ] Codex response is only visible on stdout.
- [ ] Worker cannot connect run id to native thread id.

## Evidence
- Adapter test or stubbed fixture if real Codex is unavailable in CI.
- Event log sample.

## Merge condition
Merge only when Codex non-interactive execution is durable and adapter-owned."}

# edits内のHQ依存廃棄とVim側の全面移行 — ADRS #481 / #484 edits内のHQ依存を全面廃棄し、editsを[#481](https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/issues/481)・[#484](https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/issues/484)のVim側consumerへ全面移行する。対象はedits内の実装・依存・配布経路に限り、hqリポジトリ本体には触れない。完成状態にHQ互換経路・旧機構・legacy proofの島を残さない。 この本文は、当初のPython LSP / Jev / subprocess / Herdr案と「HQ保持・別途退役判断」の前提を失効させる。旧#70/#118およびhq#158は履歴・移行先確認の参照であり、旧機構を残す要件ではない。意味の正本は#481/#484。Issueは実行時の接続契約ではない。 ## 完成条件と責務 現在起動中のwindows-own OCI内で通常のVimが動き、このNocttyから呼び出せること。その同じVimで次の実往復を証明する。 ```text Goal / 確認済current / 未採用Working → 明示completion（Ctrl-X Ctrl-U） → Voiceと同じ生成・Jev評価経路のfresh ranked Proposal Set → Human選択 → native Working編集・保存・Undo ├─ 再completion → 最新Workingで同じ取得・評価経路へ └─ 明示的な採用依頼 → 外部Judge / Prove / Admit → 正本と照合したauthoritative current → fresh Vimで同じcurrent ``` 入力後の再提案は今回必須。毎文字の自動popupは必須にせず、通常編集から明示completionする。新しいWorkingで実評価された結果が同じ列でも、取得・評価baseとの対応で判定する。 Vim側は文脈・Working snapshotの受渡し、候補identity/order/provenanceを保つ表示、native選択・編集・Undo、明示request、current表示だけを持つ。選択・保存・Undo・起動は採用ではない。 Candidate生成、順位付け、Jev評価、accepted eventの生成・保存、意味reducer、実行は共通ownerの機構を消費する。Vim内へ複製しない。pre-Admitの採用依頼とpost-Admitの永続化を分離し、Vimは採用済みeventを自作しない。 新Python LSP/service/runtime、意味worker、独自queue、Herdr launcherを作らない。必要な最小transportは公開された実契約に従う。LSPやjob/channel等の標準能力を先に必須化・全面禁止しない。 ## 小さく美しい完成dirtree ```text edits/ ├─ .gitattributes ├─ .gitignore ├─ README.md ├─ .github/workflows/vim.yml ├─ packages/vim/ │ ├─ plugin/edits.vim │ ├─ autoload/edits.vim │ └─ tests/surface.vim ├─ proofs/vim-nix/ │ ├─ flake.nix │ └─ flake.lock └─ docs/operations/vim-nix-local-first.md ``` pluginは入口とnative補完hook、autoloadは公開bindingの消費・snapshot保護・current表示、testsはnative操作の制御検証。唯一のpackageなので使い方・責務はroot READMEへ集約する。 単一の小さなflakeへ既存exact Vim定義、native runtime二ファイルのpackage、必要なcheckをまとめる。既存nixpkgs/Vim pinを保持し、HQ・旧LSP client・Go・Herdr・image生成のinputs/exportsを撤去する。native packageはreview対象のcurrent headから二ファイルだけを取り、旧editsSourceのbfdac8df固定sourceを流用しない。標準packから普通のVimが読み込み、新launcherやOCI再createを要件にしない。適用前に既存pack・設定・aliasの衝突を確認する。 このtreeは設計。公開契約に基づき不要leafを減らす場合も、追加が必要な場合も最小性を再反証する。ファイル数自体は品質目標にしない。 ## 全面撤去するもの edits内のHQ plugin/autoload・Hq alias・queue/local worker・operationCatalog用core/client/service ports・service/mux wrappers・ops-adapter・独自completion/ranker・旧provider metadata・placeholder、旧HQ/LSP/Go/Python/Herdr/OCI-image proof・pack/release tools・旧workflowを撤去する。古い運用文書も現行経路として残さない。 最終tracked treeの全leafを上の役割へ対応させ、旧経路・依存・workflowからの復活を検査する。HQという単語の不在ではなく、旧機構が到達可能でないことを検査する。廃棄理由と正確な歴史checkpointは記載できる。Git履歴は保持する。段階途中の残置は「移行途中」であり、全面廃棄完了とはしない。実sourceの撤去は対象・preimage・参照を確認して小さな差分で進め、共有home、保存済みstate、認証、共有Nix storeの一括削除へ拡張しない。 ## apps側との整合 appsはweb consumer、editsはnative Vim consumer。appsのapp-domain/graph/localStorage/legacy ApplyをVimへコピーしない。 - [PR45](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/pull/45)はsource/artifact-shapeの局所成果。 - [PR47](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/pull/47)はcontextual checker。source/CIと実Jev結果は別。訂正HTTP400は2026-10-31までUser保留で、未解決を維持する。 - [PR48](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/pull/48)はmerge済みのcamera/Undo/Discard局所修正。controlled検証は実Jev・Accepted/currentの証拠ではない。 - [apps#46](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46)のAccepted/current統合は別系列で進行中。進捗は実体の読戻しで更新し、着手指示を完成として扱わない。 現時点で今回使える共通ranked Proposal・採用依頼・current読戻しの接続一式は未特定。必要なのはexact owner/contract版、到達可能binding、文脈・Working・generation・Proposal識別、採用結果・競合・unknownの照合保証、consumer-ready current。Vimが仮protocolや擬似authorityで補わない。binding不足とappsの実Jev失敗は別の残件である。 ## 完成を担保する検証 - [ ] 現OCI・exact Vim・Noctty・TTY、および通常起動で実際に読み込んだsource/bytesを照合する。 - [x] edits内の現行tracked tree、runtime closure、imports、commands、inputs/exports、workflowにHQ・旧機構の残置／fallback／別経路がない（[PR #123](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/pull/123)）。 - [ ] 実Nocttyで候補順・identity、Human選択、Unicode編集・保存・一Undoを観測し、採用されないことを確認する。 - [ ] 応答待ち中の編集を古いsnapshotで上書きせず、Workingを保つ。 - [ ] 公開contractに基づく制御試験で拒否・競合・unknownを成功表示せず、Working/前Acceptedを保持し、盲目的retryをしない。 - [ ] 本物の共通候補から明示request、外部採用・正本照合、fresh Vimのcurrentまで実証する。queued/HTTP200/fixture/local JSONLで代替しない。 - [ ] 同じloaded implementationで異なる二つの文脈・候補を扱い、専用意味処理なしの一般性を示す。 - [ ] 共通Decision owner/契約/実接続を追跡し、apps側の実consumer・正本証拠と照合する。同じJevを呼ぶだけ、sourceの類似、controlled replayだけで共通性PASSにしない。 制御試験、実Vim往復、一般性、共通性は別判定。Vim単体が動いても共通性未証明なら総合未完。apps側の新実装・全gate・保留400再試行を、このVim作業へ自動追加しない。 ## 小さな工程と現在の区切り 完成条件・tree・撤去範囲・検証の三者合意 → 公開bindingの独立確認 → 最小差分を再反証 → Wの段階移行とRの独立検証・是正 → 現OCIで通常load・実Noctty操作・実採用往復 → 同じhead/loaded bytesで一般性・共通性・全撤去を照合する。 bindingに依存しないnative機構・既存定義の簡約・旧source整理は、具体範囲を固定して進められる。未提供wireが必要な接続内容は供給後に実装し、placeholder/Fake PASSで埋めない。 fixture投影の完了区切りは[PR #122](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/pull/122)のfixture補完proof。三者が本文と最終headを合意し、`578b3b8`のCI成功後にmergeした（merge `58f0ced`）。設定可能なファイル入口と非authorityの表示用viewから、候補順・opaque handle・表示内容をnative補完へ保って投影し、人が選べることを制御実証した。既存UI/fixture bytesは独立native TTY検証済みで、壊れた旧試験器のPASSは除外している。 edits内のHQ依存廃棄は[PR #123](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/pull/123)で完了した。三者が完成tree・本文・検証結果へ合意し、head `225c9ad` の[CI成功](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/actions/runs/37157725804/job/111304539716)と独立検証後にmergeした（merge `7bb72aa`、tree `0bf152d`）。旧394ファイルを撤去し、現行treeは9ファイル。UI/fixture二ファイル、stock Vim定義、nixpkgs/Vim pinは維持した。実Nix評価・build・fixture checkと既存Vim出力の同一性、実runtime closureに旧consumer依存がないことを確認済み。Git履歴・歴史refs・既存Releaseを保持し、hqリポジトリ本体と起動中OCIの既存設定・home/state・認証・共有Nix storeには触れていない。 明示completionの内部取得口は[PR #124](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/pull/124)で完了した（merge `542e882`、[canonical CI成功](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/actions/runs/37166186245)）。最新Working全行・opaque context/currentを設定した同期取得関数へ渡し、内部表示viewの検査・非破壊投影・取得中変更と失敗時の保全を独立制御検証した。これは内部受渡しのproofであり、実shared候補やJevによる再評価の証拠ではない。 次の工程はVim上のHuman UXに集中する。[PR #124の新コメント](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/pull/124#issuecomment-5975284148)と[#481の統合図](https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/issues/481#issuecomment-5975283930)が示すsurface境界を保ち、まず既存107行・repoの9ファイルを変えずに試す。普通のbufferにGoalとCurrentの例を示し、書く → 明示completion → 候補比較・取消 → 書き直す → 再completion → 別候補の比較・選択 → 普通のWorking編集を一続きで観測する。二つの登録Workingに、事前に手で用意した二組の候補を返す試用であり、実Jev再評価・shared候補・Admitの証拠には数えない。候補の違いとCurrentとの関係が理解できるか、書き直し後の再取得が分かるか、選択・取消・Undoから普通の編集へ自然に戻れるかをHuman評価とする。必要なUX差分だけを観測に基づいて小さく進める。 {"body":"# edits内のHQ依存廃棄とVim側の全面移行 — ADRS #481 / #484 edits内のHQ依存を全面廃棄し、editsを[#481](https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/issues/481)・[#484](https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/issues/484)のVim側consumerへ全面移行する。対象はedits内の実装・依存・配布経路に限り、hqリポジトリ本体には触れない。完成状態にHQ互換経路・旧機構・legacy proofの島を残さない。 この本文は、当初のPython LSP / Jev / subprocess / Herdr案と「HQ保持・別途退役判断」の前提を失効させる。旧#70/#118およびhq#158は履歴・移行先確認の参照であり、旧機構を残す要件ではない。意味の正本は#481/#484。Issueは実行時の接続契約ではない。 ## 完成条件と責務 現在起動中のwindows-own OCI内で通常のVimが動き、このNocttyから呼び出せること。その同じVimで次の実往復を証明する。 ```text Goal / 確認済current / 未採用Working → 明示completion（Ctrl-X Ctrl-U） → Voiceと同じ生成・Jev評価経路のfresh ranked Proposal Set → Human選択 → native Working編集・保存・Undo ├─ 再completion → 最新Workingで同じ取得・評価経路へ └─ 明示的な採用依頼 → 外部Judge / Prove / Admit → 正本と照合したauthoritative current → fresh Vimで同じcurrent ``` 入力後の再提案は今回必須。毎文字の自動popupは必須にせず、通常編集から明示completionする。新しいWorkingで実評価された結果が同じ列でも、取得・評価baseとの対応で判定する。 Vim側は文脈・Working snapshotの受渡し、候補identity/order/provenanceを保つ表示、native選択・編集・Undo、明示request、current表示だけを持つ。選択・保存・Undo・起動は採用ではない。 Candidate生成、順位付け、Jev評価、accepted eventの生成・保存、意味reducer、実行は共通ownerの機構を消費する。Vim内へ複製しない。pre-Admitの採用依頼とpost-Admitの永続化を分離し、Vimは採用済みeventを自作しない。 新Python LSP/service/runtime、意味worker、独自queue、Herdr launcherを作らない。必要な最小transportは公開された実契約に従う。LSPやjob/channel等の標準能力を先に必須化・全面禁止しない。 ## 小さく美しい完成dirtree ```text edits/ ├─ .gitattributes ├─ .gitignore ├─ README.md ├─ .github/workflows/vim.yml ├─ packages/vim/ │ ├─ plugin/edits.vim │ ├─ autoload/edits.vim │ └─ tests/surface.vim ├─ proofs/vim-nix/ │ ├─ flake.nix │ └─ flake.lock └─ docs/operations/vim-nix-local-first.md ``` pluginは入口とnative補完hook、autoloadは公開bindingの消費・snapshot保護・current表示、testsはnative操作の制御検証。唯一のpackageなので使い方・責務はroot READMEへ集約する。 単一の小さなflakeへ既存exact Vim定義、native runtime二ファイルのpackage、必要なcheckをまとめる。既存nixpkgs/Vim pinを保持し、HQ・旧LSP client・Go・Herdr・image生成のinputs/exportsを撤去する。native packageはreview対象のcurrent headから二ファイルだけを取り、旧editsSourceのbfdac8df固定sourceを流用しない。標準packから普通のVimが読み込み、新launcherやOCI再createを要件にしない。適用前に既存pack・設定・aliasの衝突を確認する。 このtreeは設計。公開契約に基づき不要leafを減らす場合も、追加が必要な場合も最小性を再反証する。ファイル数自体は品質目標にしない。 ## 全面撤去するもの edits内のHQ plugin/autoload・Hq alias・queue/local worker・operationCatalog用core/client/service ports・service/mux wrappers・ops-adapter・独自completion/ranker・旧provider metadata・placeholder、旧HQ/LSP/Go/Python/Herdr/OCI-image proof・pack/release tools・旧workflowを撤去する。古い運用文書も現行経路として残さない。 最終tracked treeの全leafを上の役割へ対応させ、旧経路・依存・workflowからの復活を検査する。HQという単語の不在ではなく、旧機構が到達可能でないことを検査する。廃棄理由と正確な歴史checkpointは記載できる。Git履歴は保持する。段階途中の残置は「移行途中」であり、全面廃棄完了とはしない。実sourceの撤去は対象・preimage・参照を確認して小さな差分で進め、共有home、保存済みstate、認証、共有Nix storeの一括削除へ拡張しない。 ## apps側との整合 appsはweb consumer、editsはnative Vim consumer。appsのapp-domain/graph/localStorage/legacy ApplyをVimへコピーしない。 - [PR45](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/pull/45)はsource/artifact-shapeの局所成果。 - [PR47](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/pull/47)はcontextual checker。source/CIと実Jev結果は別。訂正HTTP400は2026-10-31までUser保留で、未解決を維持する。 - [PR48](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/pull/48)はmerge済みのcamera/Undo/Discard局所修正。controlled検証は実Jev・Accepted/currentの証拠ではない。 - [apps#46](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46)のAccepted/current統合は別系列で進行中。進捗は実体の読戻しで更新し、着手指示を完成として扱わない。 現時点で今回使える共通ranked Proposal・採用依頼・current読戻しの接続一式は未特定。必要なのはexact owner/contract版、到達可能binding、文脈・Working・generation・Proposal識別、採用結果・競合・unknownの照合保証、consumer-ready current。Vimが仮protocolや擬似authorityで補わない。binding不足とappsの実Jev失敗は別の残件である。 ## 完成を担保する検証 - [ ] 現OCI・exact Vim・Noctty・TTY、および通常起動で実際に読み込んだsource/bytesを照合する。 - [x] edits内の現行tracked tree、runtime closure、imports、commands、inputs/exports、workflowにHQ・旧機構の残置／fallback／別経路がない（[PR #123](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/pull/123)）。 - [ ] 実Nocttyで候補順・identity、Human選択、Unicode編集・保存・一Undoを観測し、採用されないことを確認する。 - [ ] 応答待ち中の編集を古いsnapshotで上書きせず、Workingを保つ。 - [ ] 公開contractに基づく制御試験で拒否・競合・unknownを成功表示せず、Working/前Acceptedを保持し、盲目的retryをしない。 - [ ] 本物の共通候補から明示request、外部採用・正本照合、fresh Vimのcurrentまで実証する。queued/HTTP200/fixture/local JSONLで代替しない。 - [ ] 同じloaded implementationで異なる二つの文脈・候補を扱い、専用意味処理なしの一般性を示す。 - [ ] 共通Decision owner/契約/実接続を追跡し、apps側の実consumer・正本証拠と照合する。同じJevを呼ぶだけ、sourceの類似、controlled replayだけで共通性PASSにしない。 制御試験、実Vim往復、一般性、共通性は別判定。Vim単体が動いても共通性未証明なら総合未完。apps側の新実装・全gate・保留400再試行を、このVim作業へ自動追加しない。 ## 小さな工程と現在の区切り 完成条件・tree・撤去範囲・検証の三者合意 → 公開bindingの独立確認 → 最小差分を再反証 → Wの段階移行とRの独立検証・是正 → 現OCIで通常load・実Noctty操作・実採用往復 → 同じhead/loaded bytesで一般性・共通性・全撤去を照合する。 bindingに依存しないnative機構・既存定義の簡約・旧source整理は、具体範囲を固定して進められる。未提供wireが必要な接続内容は供給後に実装し、placeholder/Fake PASSで埋めない。 fixture投影の完了区切りは[PR #122](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/pull/122)のfixture補完proof。三者が本文と最終headを合意し、`578b3b8`のCI成功後にmergeした（merge `58f0ced`）。設定可能なファイル入口と非authorityの表示用viewから、候補順・opaque handle・表示内容をnative補完へ保って投影し、人が選べることを制御実証した。既存UI/fixture bytesは独立native TTY検証済みで、壊れた旧試験器のPASSは除外している。 edits内のHQ依存廃棄は[PR #123](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/pull/123)で完了した。三者が完成tree・本文・検証結果へ合意し、head `225c9ad` の[CI成功](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/actions/runs/37157725804/job/111304539716)と独立検証後にmergeした（merge → 明示completion → 候補比較・取消 → 書き直す → 再completion → 別候補の比較・選択 → 普通のWorking編集を一続きで観測する。二つの登録Workingに、事前に手で用意した二組の候補を返す試用であり、実Jev再評価・shared候補・Admitの証拠には数えない。候補の違いとCurrentとの関係が理解できるか、書き直し後の再取得が分かるか、選択・取消・Undoから普通の編集へ自然に戻れるかをHuman評価とする。必要なUX差分だけを観測に基づいて小さく進める。 body内の各文を、望ましい状態の宣言と、実際に起きたことの報告に分けて読んでください。EとOは同時にyesでも構いません。Eは文書の主題や多数決ではなく存在判定です。具体的な要求文・完成条件・目標文が一文でもあれば、残りが全部作業報告でもE=yesです。例えば「利用者に完了を通知すること」は期待ですが、「利用者に通知した」は実施報告であり期待ではありません。Goal・Acceptanceという見出しそのものは期待文ではなく、その下に過去の実施報告しかなければE=noです。表・数式・役割が完成状態の対応を定義する場合も期待です。Oでは実測の引用・確認状況一覧・本文内HTMLコメントの作業メモも数えますが、架空の試験入力・条件付きの例は数えません。許容を表す「〜でもよい」や仮定・可能性だけを述べる文は、現状の報告ではありません。例えば「点検は後日でもよい」は許容条件ですが、「点検はまだしていない」は現在の状態の報告です。O=yesにするには、本文が現実にそうだと主張している箇所が必要です。与えられたbody全体だけを対象に判断し、そこにない現状を推測しないでください。
本問はEだけ：本文が実現すべき状態を一つでも宣言しているか。完成状態の表・責務・式も宣言である。Goal等の見出しだけでYesにしない。本文にそのような期待がなければNo。実施済みと書いてあるだけなら期待ではない。

state.body:
# edits内のHQ依存廃棄とVim側の全面移行 — ADRS #481 / #484 edits内のHQ依存を全面廃棄し、editsを[#481](https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/issues/481)・[#484](https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/issues/484)のVim側consumerへ全面移行する。対象はedits内の実装・依存・配布経路に限り、hqリポジトリ本体には触れない。完成状態にHQ互換経路・旧機構・legacy proofの島を残さない。 この本文は、当初のPython LSP / Jev / subprocess / Herdr案と「HQ保持・別途退役判断」の前提を失効させる。旧#70/#118およびhq#158は履歴・移行先確認の参照であり、旧機構を残す要件ではない。意味の正本は#481/#484。Issueは実行時の接続契約ではない。 ## 完成条件と責務 現在起動中のwindows-own OCI内で通常のVimが動き、このNocttyから呼び出せること。その同じVimで次の実往復を証明する。 ```text Goal / 確認済current / 未採用Working → 明示completion（Ctrl-X Ctrl-U） → Voiceと同じ生成・Jev評価経路のfresh ranked Proposal Set → Human選択 → native Working編集・保存・Undo ├─ 再completion → 最新Workingで同じ取得・評価経路へ └─ 明示的な採用依頼 → 外部Judge / Prove / Admit → 正本と照合したauthoritative current → fresh Vimで同じcurrent ``` 入力後の再提案は今回必須。毎文字の自動popupは必須にせず、通常編集から明示completionする。新しいWorkingで実評価された結果が同じ列でも、取得・評価baseとの対応で判定する。 Vim側は文脈・Working snapshotの受渡し、候補identity/order/provenanceを保つ表示、native選択・編集・Undo、明示request、current表示だけを持つ。選択・保存・Undo・起動は採用ではない。 Candidate生成、順位付け、Jev評価、accepted eventの生成・保存、意味reducer、実行は共通ownerの機構を消費する。Vim内へ複製しない。pre-Admitの採用依頼とpost-Admitの永続化を分離し、Vimは採用済みeventを自作しない。 新Python LSP/service/runtime、意味worker、独自queue、Herdr launcherを作らない。必要な最小transportは公開された実契約に従う。LSPやjob/channel等の標準能力を先に必須化・全面禁止しない。 ## 小さく美しい完成dirtree ```text edits/ ├─ .gitattributes ├─ .gitignore ├─ README.md ├─ .github/workflows/vim.yml ├─ packages/vim/ │ ├─ plugin/edits.vim │ ├─ autoload/edits.vim │ └─ tests/surface.vim ├─ proofs/vim-nix/ │ ├─ flake.nix │ └─ flake.lock └─ docs/operations/vim-nix-local-first.md ``` pluginは入口とnative補完hook、autoloadは公開bindingの消費・snapshot保護・current表示、testsはnative操作の制御検証。唯一のpackageなので使い方・責務はroot READMEへ集約する。 単一の小さなflakeへ既存exact Vim定義、native runtime二ファイルのpackage、必要なcheckをまとめる。既存nixpkgs/Vim pinを保持し、HQ・旧LSP client・Go・Herdr・image生成のinputs/exportsを撤去する。native packageはreview対象のcurrent headから二ファイルだけを取り、旧editsSourceのbfdac8df固定sourceを流用しない。標準packから普通のVimが読み込み、新launcherやOCI再createを要件にしない。適用前に既存pack・設定・aliasの衝突を確認する。 このtreeは設計。公開契約に基づき不要leafを減らす場合も、追加が必要な場合も最小性を再反証する。ファイル数自体は品質目標にしない。 ## 全面撤去するもの edits内のHQ plugin/autoload・Hq alias・queue/local worker・operationCatalog用core/client/service ports・service/mux wrappers・ops-adapter・独自completion/ranker・旧provider metadata・placeholder、旧HQ/LSP/Go/Python/Herdr/OCI-image proof・pack/release tools・旧workflowを撤去する。古い運用文書も現行経路として残さない。 最終tracked treeの全leafを上の役割へ対応させ、旧経路・依存・workflowからの復活を検査する。HQという単語の不在ではなく、旧機構が到達可能でないことを検査する。廃棄理由と正確な歴史checkpointは記載できる。Git履歴は保持する。段階途中の残置は「移行途中」であり、全面廃棄完了とはしない。実sourceの撤去は対象・preimage・参照を確認して小さな差分で進め、共有home、保存済みstate、認証、共有Nix storeの一括削除へ拡張しない。 ## apps側との整合 appsはweb consumer、editsはnative Vim consumer。appsのapp-domain/graph/localStorage/legacy ApplyをVimへコピーしない。 - [PR45](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/pull/45)はsource/artifact-shapeの局所成果。 - [PR47](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/pull/47)はcontextual checker。source/CIと実Jev結果は別。訂正HTTP400は2026-10-31までUser保留で、未解決を維持する。 - [PR48](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/pull/48)はmerge済みのcamera/Undo/Discard局所修正。controlled検証は実Jev・Accepted/currentの証拠ではない。 - [apps#46](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/issues/46)のAccepted/current統合は別系列で進行中。進捗は実体の読戻しで更新し、着手指示を完成として扱わない。 現時点で今回使える共通ranked Proposal・採用依頼・current読戻しの接続一式は未特定。必要なのはexact owner/contract版、到達可能binding、文脈・Working・generation・Proposal識別、採用結果・競合・unknownの照合保証、consumer-ready current。Vimが仮protocolや擬似authorityで補わない。binding不足とappsの実Jev失敗は別の残件である。 ## 完成を担保する検証 - [ ] 現OCI・exact Vim・Noctty・TTY、および通常起動で実際に読み込んだsource/bytesを照合する。 - [x] edits内の現行tracked tree、runtime closure、imports、commands、inputs/exports、workflowにHQ・旧機構の残置／fallback／別経路がない（[PR #123](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/pull/123)）。 - [ ] 実Nocttyで候補順・identity、Human選択、Unicode編集・保存・一Undoを観測し、採用されないことを確認する。 - [ ] 応答待ち中の編集を古いsnapshotで上書きせず、Workingを保つ。 - [ ] 公開contractに基づく制御試験で拒否・競合・unknownを成功表示せず、Working/前Acceptedを保持し、盲目的retryをしない。 - [ ] 本物の共通候補から明示request、外部採用・正本照合、fresh Vimのcurrentまで実証する。queued/HTTP200/fixture/local JSONLで代替しない。 - [ ] 同じloaded implementationで異なる二つの文脈・候補を扱い、専用意味処理なしの一般性を示す。 - [ ] 共通Decision owner/契約/実接続を追跡し、apps側の実consumer・正本証拠と照合する。同じJevを呼ぶだけ、sourceの類似、controlled replayだけで共通性PASSにしない。 制御試験、実Vim往復、一般性、共通性は別判定。Vim単体が動いても共通性未証明なら総合未完。apps側の新実装・全gate・保留400再試行を、このVim作業へ自動追加しない。 ## 小さな工程と現在の区切り 完成条件・tree・撤去範囲・検証の三者合意 → 公開bindingの独立確認 → 最小差分を再反証 → Wの段階移行とRの独立検証・是正 → 現OCIで通常load・実Noctty操作・実採用往復 → 同じhead/loaded bytesで一般性・共通性・全撤去を照合する。 bindingに依存しないnative機構・既存定義の簡約・旧source整理は、具体範囲を固定して進められる。未提供wireが必要な接続内容は供給後に実装し、placeholder/Fake PASSで埋めない。 fixture投影の完了区切りは[PR #122](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/pull/122)のfixture補完proof。三者が本文と最終headを合意し、`578b3b8`のCI成功後にmergeした（merge `58f0ced`）。設定可能なファイル入口と非authorityの表示用viewから、候補順・opaque handle・表示内容をnative補完へ保って投影し、人が選べることを制御実証した。既存UI/fixture bytesは独立native TTY検証済みで、壊れた旧試験器のPASSは除外している。 edits内のHQ依存廃棄は[PR #123](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/pull/123)で完了した。三者が完成tree・本文・検証結果へ合意し、head `225c9ad` の[CI成功](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/actions/runs/37157725804/job/111304539716)と独立検証後にmergeした（merge `7bb72aa`、tree `0bf152d`）。旧394ファイルを撤去し、現行treeは9ファイル。UI/fixture二ファイル、stock Vim定義、nixpkgs/Vim pinは維持した。実Nix評価・build・fixture checkと既存Vim出力の同一性、実runtime closureに旧consumer依存がないことを確認済み。Git履歴・歴史refs・既存Releaseを保持し、hqリポジトリ本体と起動中OCIの既存設定・home/state・認証・共有Nix storeには触れていない。 明示completionの内部取得口は[PR #124](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/pull/124)で完了した（merge `542e882`、[canonical CI成功](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/actions/runs/37166186245)）。最新Working全行・opaque context/currentを設定した同期取得関数へ渡し、内部表示viewの検査・非破壊投影・取得中変更と失敗時の保全を独立制御検証した。これは内部受渡しのproofであり、実shared候補やJevによる再評価の証拠ではない。 次の工程はVim上のHuman UXに集中する。[PR #124の新コメント](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/pull/124#issuecomment-5975284148)と[#481の統合図](https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/issues/481#issuecomment-5975283930)が示すsurface境界を保ち、まず既存107行・repoの9ファイルを変えずに試す。普通のbufferにGoalとCurrentの例を示し、書く → 明示completion → 候補比較・取消 → 書き直す → 再completion → 別候補の比較・選択 → 普通のWorking編集を一続きで観測する。二つの登録Workingに、事前に手で用意した二組の候補を返す試用であり、実Jev再評価・shared候補・Admitの証拠には数えない。候補の違いとCurrentとの関係が理解できるか、書き直し後の再取得が分かるか、選択・取消・Undoから普通の編集へ自然に戻れるかをHuman評価とする。必要なUX差分だけを観測に基づいて小さく進める。 公開共有取得口は、ownerから公開されるまでTODOとして保留する。[apps PR #54](https://github.com/roccho-dev/apps/pull/54)のGoal入力型・Choiceと、Voice/Vimが同じ評価済み候補列を消費する公開取得口は別の進捗である。公開後にowner/ref/型版/入口、Working対応、元の順序・handle・provenance・表示投影・評価baseを既存取得口へ結ぶ。実共有候補・実採用往復・共通Decision機構への全面移行は未完で、Issueはopenを維持する。edits内のHQ依存廃棄は完了した。 ## 全体構成と現在の状態 以下は[#481の統合図](https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/issues/481#issuecomment-5975283930)、[#484](https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/issues/484)、[#506](https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/issues/506)の責務を、現在のVim実装と未完の接続へ対応づけた図。破線は公開待ち・後続の接続であり、実装・実証済みを意味しない。 ```mermaid flowchart TD N["Noctty → OCI内のstock Vim
起動・TTYのcheckpoint確認済み"] I["Readline代替の入力UX
期待を書く・修正・候補/必要な引数入力
要調整・未検証"] W["未採用Working
Humanの希望"] Q["明示completion
Ctrl-X Ctrl-U"] subgraph V["Vim側core — PR #124の限定完了"] B["最新Working＋読取文脈のsnapshot
設定した取得関数へ一回渡す / view検査・前後guard"] P["native投影
順序・元handle・取得baseを保持"] end F["手置fixture応答
非authority / 制御proof"] T["Vim/Voice共用の公開取得口
owner公開までTODO"] C["外部の共通Candidate / Jev / rank
既存意味機構を消費"] M["native候補popup"] H["Humanが比較・選択・取消"] E["Workingを普通に編集 / Undo"] O["Voice側surface / policy"] K["明示Commit request
後続境界"] A["外部Judge / Prove / Admit"] S["外部owner / Voice側保存adapter
Admit済events → GitHub ref / localhost→actual local FS
保存・readback"] D["共通ownerのreduce結果 / confirmed current
Workingとは別"] N --> I --> W --> Q --> B B --> F --> B B --> P B -. "snapshot要求" .-> T T -. "公開ownerへ" .-> C C -. "評価済み列 / 投影 / base対応" .-> T T -. "公開後の返view / base対応" .-> B T -. "同じ評価済み候補列" .-> O P --> M --> H --> E --> W O -. "Voice自身のWorkingから取得" .-> T E -.-> K -.-> A -.-> S O -. "明示Commit" .-> K S -. "確認事実 / partial・unknownを区別" .-> D D -. "取得context / Working自動変更なし" .-> B D -. "読取context / Working自動変更なし" .-> O ``` Vim側coreの限定完了は、最新snapshotの受渡し、設定可能な同期取得口、表示view検査・native投影、元候補handle/baseの保持と古い応答からの保全である（[PR #124](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/pull/124)）。[PR #122](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/pull/122)のfixture補完proofと、[PR #123](https://github.com/roccho-dev/edits/pull/123)のedits内HQ依存廃棄も完了した。外部の共通意味core全体や、Voiceと同じ実候補のVim消費を完了したという意味ではない。 入力UXをReadline代替として一続きで確認する要求の認識が不足していた。意図的な保留ではなく、現在は要調整・未検証である。Humanはまだ試用しておらず、現画面の三つの見出しの意図が伝わっていない。普通のbufferを「この例では、APIはOCIの中、DBは外にあります。」と空の入力行の二行へ簡約する案に合意したが、これは未反映・未試験の提案である。書く → 明示completion → 比較・取消 → 書き直す → 再completion → 選択 → 自由編集を実際に理解して使えるかを次に確認する。毎文字の自動popupや新しいLSP機構を完了条件へ足さない。 公開共有取得口はTODOを維持する。手置fixtureによる入力・表示・選択の制御結果は、実Jev再評価や同Voice候補列の証拠ではない。選択・編集・save・Undoは未採用Workingの操作であり、明示Commit、外部Admit、GH ref/実FS保存、confirmed currentからのVoice↔Vim往復は後続の未完gateである。片側確認・unknownを全保存成功へ昇格しない。Issueはopenを維持する。

## Purpose

Governance itself must adopt the same gov-produced packet path as downstream repos. This issue removes the exception that governance could validate others without proving its own packet through the same producer surface.

## Post-merge state

After attached PRs merge:
- governance exposes a self gov-package-output packet through the shared producer path.
- governance is not treated as a special handwritten packet exception.
- the packet participates as an input candidate for later org/final joins.

## Completion audit impact

Contributes to:
- `producerAudit`: governance packet is gov-produced, not hand-authored.
- `repoUniverseAudit`: governance participates as a required repo.
- `completionCertificate.govSelfPacketDigest`.

## Merge blockers

Do not merge child PRs when:
- they claim final gate or branch protection authority.
- they bypass the reusable producer from Phase C.
- they only add docs without a packet/check surface.
- they weaken provenance or input-lock requirements.

## Required evidence

- changed file paths for the self packet/check exposure.
- generated packet or fixture showing governance self output.
- CI/check result proving the self packet path runs.
- issue/PR comment linking this issue and stating the post-merge invariant.

## Boundary

This issue closes self-adoption only. It does not close final join, strict gate, branch protection, or downstream rollout.

## Purpose

ui packageの外部利用境界を `packages.${system}.<package-id>` のconsumer-ready artifactへ統一する。

appsはui repo内部pathをcheckout/copyせず、exact revision + Nix package artifactだけを利用する。

## Initial required artifacts

少なくともappsが現在配信に利用する次の3能力をconsumer-ready artifactとして公開する。

- `ui-ir`
- `a2ui-browser`
- `semantic-map`

1 attrへ集約する必要はない。原則としてpackage単位の正規outputとする。

期待形:

```text
nix build .#ui-ir

`semantic-map` artifactは現行packageとして必要なmaxGraph runtimeを含み、resultだけからreal browserでmaxGraph描画まで再現可能であること。

既存 `control-ui` はこれら3能力の正規artifact境界とはしない。

## General rule

```text
package source
→ provider-owned build
→ packages.${system}.<package-id>
→ $out = consumer-ready artifact
```

## Non-goals

- apps専用bundleを正規境界にしない
- provider内部layoutを外部契約にしない
- control-ui変更を要求しない
- 既存attrの改名を要求しない
- 将来commitでのattr名互換性を要求しない

実装PRのexact commitで必要artifactについて:

```text
nix build .#<attr>
→ success
→ result = static distribution可能なdirectory tree
```

さらに `semantic-map` について:

```text
result only
→ semantic-map runtime
→ renderer-maxgraph / maxGraph
→ real browser render PASS
```

appsはそのexact commitをflake inputとしてpinし、resultだけをconsume可能であること。

{"body":"## Purpose

Keep the Vim/hq `model.*` and `agent.*` command vocabulary in `edits` as the editor-facing surface.

## Scope

- Preserve command templates for `model.*` and `agent.*`.
- Document that command templates describe editor actions, not runtime ownership.
- Ensure each command maps to an ops-valid queue kind.
- Keep command completion and human confirmation as the edits-owned value.

## Done

- Command vocabulary remains discoverable from the editor surface.
- `model.*` commands declare model-commit queue intent.
- `agent.*` commands declare agent-task queue intent.
- Docs point to ops for validation/worker/admission ownership.

## Scope-achievement declaration

This issue is complete only when all of the following are true:

- Purpose lineage: directly supports human editor confirmation before queue append; supports repo split by keeping vocabulary in `edits` and runtime in `ops`.
- Core/port/adapter: command vocabulary is editor core data; command lookup is a pure port-facing operation; Vim/hq integration is adapter-only.
- Pure/effect split: command template validation is pure; editor display, local files, and Vim integration are side-effect adapters.

## Scope

- Preserve command templates for `model.*` and `agent.*`.

- `model.*` commands declare model-commit queue intent.
- `agent.*` commands declare agent-task queue intent.
- Docs point to ops for validation/worker/admission ownership.

- Purpose lineage: directly supports human editor confirmation before queue append; supports repo split by keeping vocabulary in `edits` and runtime in `ops`.

- Do not implement ops validator here.
- Do not process queue rows here.
- Do not run agents here.

- Boundary check passes.

- #49

## 目的・背景

#171対応のPR #201は、ユーザーの明示的な許可により、CI失敗2件を残したまま今回限りの例外として`proposals`へマージした（merge: `6622f9887d65ea0c297c4b7c35ee5ef21030a89d`）。例外は失敗をPASSに変更するものでも、今後の検査緩和を認めるものでもない。

本Issueで残ったCI修復だけを扱い、通常の検査で安全に変更を進められる状態へ戻す。描画自由度・再compileの拡張は#205のまま分離する。

## 確認済みの失敗

対象PR head: `b84a1b2ee8056020eed2218d5b2e775ef5725116`

| CI | 失敗ステップ | 実行記録 |
|---|---|---|
| A2UI adapter artifacts | Run complete UI checks | [run 33803033829](https://github.com/roccho-dev/ui/actions/runs/33803033829/job/100806820137) |
| Nix Flake Check | Run flake check without lock mutation | [run 33803033331](https://github.com/roccho-dev/ui/actions/runs/33803033331/job/100806819077) |

## 完了条件

- [ ] 各失敗の最初の原因ログ、再現対象commit、原因と修正を記録する。既に解消済みなら該当修正と検証証拠を示す。
- [ ] 同一の修正headで上記2つのCIが実行され成功し、通常実行対象の後続検査・成果物生成も完了する。`Semantic Map gesture-review join`の成功も維持し、commitと実行URLを残す。
- [ ] 検査削除・skip追加・判定緩和・失敗無視・保護設定変更でGreenにしない。失敗検出を保つ既存テスト、または必要最小限の再発防止テストで確認する。

非対象：#205の機能追加、広範な整理、新しいCI基盤、#171の完了条件変更。今回の例外マージ許可は後続PRへ引き継がない。

## 目的・背景

#171対応のPR #201は、ユーザーの明示的な許可により、CI失敗2件を残したまま今回限りの例外として`proposals`へマージした（merge: `6622f9887d65ea0c297c4b7c35ee5ef21030a89d`）。例外は失敗をPASSに変更するものでも、今後の検査緩和を認めるものでもない。

本Issueで残ったCI修復だけを扱い、通常の検査で安全に変更を進められる状態へ戻す。描画自由度・再compileの拡張は#205のまま分離する。

## 確認済みの失敗

対象PR head: `b84a1b2ee8056020eed2218d5b2e775ef5725116`

| CI | 失敗ステップ | 実行記録 |
|---|---|---|
| A2UI adapter artifacts | Run complete UI checks | [run 33803033829](https://github.com/roccho-dev/ui/actions/runs/33803033829/job/100806820137) |
| Nix Flake Check | Run flake check without lock mutation | [run 33803033331](https://github.com/roccho-dev/ui/actions/runs/33803033331/job/100806819077) |

失敗ステップまで確認済み。根本原因、2件の原因が共通か、#201起因か既存問題かは未確定。現在の`proposals`での再現とログから切り分け、原因に必要な最小変更だけを行う。

## 完了条件

- [ ] 各失敗の最初の原因ログ、再現対象commit、原因と修正を記録する。既に解消済みなら該当修正と検証証拠を示す。
- [ ] 同一の修正headで上記2つのCIが実行され成功し、通常実行対象の後続検査・成果物生成も完了する。`Semantic Map gesture-review join`の成功も維持し、commitと実行URLを残す。

{"body":"## Purpose

Make Vim autocomplete produce confirmed queue rows for modeling changes and agent requests.

## Completion state

This is complete when `model.*` commands generate `hq.modelCommitQueued.v1`, `agent.*` commands generate `hq.agentTaskQueued.v1`, and both pass through PlanDraft confirmation.

## Scope

- Add `model.*` command vocabulary.
- Add `agent.*` command vocabulary.
- Convert command -> PlanDraft -> queue row.
- Inject current `targetRef` into queue rows when available.
- Keep confirm-before-side-effect boundary.
- Show detail, meaning, and resulting queue kind in completion candidates.

## Minimum commands

`model.addSchema`, `model.addField`, `model.addEdge`, `model.deprecateField`, `model.addProjection`, `model.changeLodRule`, `agent.inspect`, `agent.proposeModel`, `agent.fixProjection`, `agent.addTest`, `agent.explainEdge`, `agent.findEvidence`.

## Done checklist

- [ ] `model.*` completions appear in Vim/hq.
- [ ] `agent.*` completions appear in Vim/hq.
- [ ] `model.*` accept writes `hq.modelCommitQueued.v1`.
- [ ] `agent.*` accept writes `hq.agentTaskQueued.v1`.
- [ ] Current `targetRef` is included when available.
- [ ] Missing targetRef is explicit and valid.
- [ ] Confirm-before-side-effect is preserved.
- [ ] Unknown commands produce diagnostics.
- [ ] Vocabulary is represented in a sample world.

## Non-scope

- Free-form JSONL editor.
- Direct accepted ledger append.
- Complete LSP protocol implementation."}

Make the `hq` boundary machine-checkable so execution adapter logic cannot drift into the compiler packages.

## Scope-to-meta contribution
| generation | contribution |
|---|---|
| scope | Prevents `hq` from becoming `hq -> herdr/codex/claude/sh`. |

| system | Forces execution into JSONL worker/adapters. |
| org | Reduces unclear ownership between editor, compiler, and runner. |
| business/meta | Lowers maintenance and due-diligence risk. |

- Add a guard that fails if forbidden execution imports or hard-coded adapter identifiers appear in `hq` core packages.
- Guard at least `internal/core`, `internal/hq`, and `cmd/hq` where appropriate.

- Blocking worker packages from using execution APIs.
- Implementing adapter policy.

- [ ] `hq` core dispatches to a named external tool.

- Guard script.
- Negative fixture or test proving the guard fails.

## Merge condition
Merge only when external execution creep is mechanically blocked for `hq`.
