Windows消去・初回登録"] I --> SBOOT["USBなしでBIOSからSSDのNixOSのみ起動"] SBOOT --> H["ログイン不要の管理経路"] C["意図したMesh内の既存クライアント"] --> H H --> V["認可SSH・必要な代表agent実利用"] D["同じ非秘密の宣言"] --> R["rebuild"] --> H S["必要状態・有効な認証"] --> H B["電源投入・通常再起動・通常再接続"] --> H X["失効・鍵/状態喪失"] --> F["復旧主体・保管物/正規再登録"] F --> Q["認証と状態を復旧・実利用で確認"] --> S ``` ## host / repoの関係 以下は導入・運用の役割図。破線はこれから成立させる関係であり、実接続や配備成功を表さない。G6I3は現在USBを準備するWindows host、NixOSのインストール先はVersaPro。USBをG6I3に挿しただけではVersaProへの導入は始まらない。初回ネットワークはUSB boot後のLinuxがG6I3からのSSHと必要な取得先へ接続できることを指す。有線LANそのものは必須ではないが、手元コマンドに依存せず接続できる方式を準備する。SSHは初回から必須で、VersaProの手元画面・キーボードでインストールする経路は完成形に含めない。envsは#14が定める既存の接続・secret配置責務を指し、現在のrepository locatorは実装前に再確認する。 ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph REPO["リポジトリの責務"] A["adrs
採択済み規約・責任境界"] W["windows
OS・package定義 / CI
VersaPro定義はこれから"] E["envsの既存責務
接続登録・secret配置"] A --> W A --> E end subgraph HOST["物理ホスト"] G["G6I3 / このWindows host
USB準備・遠隔管理"] V["VersaPro / own′
NixOS常設の導入対象"] T["PC7337 / 別rent
Windows + 既存OCI"] end O["NixOS標準installerを基に
公開鍵SSH・初回接続を準備"] U["I-O DATA 8GB USB
修正版1.59GB全量一致
正常ポートcold boot / 自動SSH PASS"] M["Cloudflare Mesh内の
既存クライアント"] O -. 取得して準備 .-> G G -->|修正USB準備・全量一致| U U -->|正常ポートで修正版cold boot PASS| V W -. 必要な定義・package / rebuild .-> V W -->|既存OCIの配布| T E -. 採用経路を確認して登録・配置 .-> V E -->|既存接続・配置の責務| T G -->|修正版自動Wi-Fi / strict SSH PASS| V M -. 要求する認可SSH / 接続方式未確認 .-> V ``` ## 小ささと未確認 要件の4点補完は構成部品を増やさず会話依存を減らす、という3者の設計合意。実装の小ささ・美しさは未証明で、宣言・保存物・権限・起動依存・手作業・初回/通常/復旧の運用分岐の総量と実利用で評価する。専用ISO、disko/nixos-anywhere、OCI追加、二重connector、追加helper、恒久台帳、固定ファイル数を先に必須化しない。現行の共通package profileは再利用候補であり、物理NixOSの完成定義が既にあるとは扱わない。 実機でBIOSによるUSB起動、USB Wi-Fi認識・接続、G6I3からのホスト鍵固定・公開鍵認証SSHを確認済み。未確認は常設SSDへの導入・通常起動、蓋/suspend・停電後自動power-on、NixOSで必要なMesh到達性を満たす接続/登録方式、必要状態と復旧用保管、8GBの実負荷。端末age鍵を使うか・どこへ復旧用保管するかも未採択。 ## 次の段階と作用境界 I-O DATA製8GB（作成hostでF:「UBUNTU」だった媒体）は、User許可後にWindowsから直接書込みし、1,589,706,752 bytesの全量読み戻し一致を確認済み。D:「EXTERNAL」500GBは対象外。当初はF7起動一覧で全USBポートを試してもUSBが表示されなかったが、その後、Userの実機写真で `versapro-installer` のUSB起動を確認した。設定領域 `NIXOSCONF` の通常mountは `/dev/sdb3: Can't open blockdev` で失敗し、Userの手元で読み取り専用loop mountを実行して `/run/bootstrap` へのmountに成功した。続けて初回Wi-Fi profileを生成・接続し、LANアドレス `192.168.0.104` を取得した。その後G6I3から、準備したホスト鍵を固定したstrict SSHと既存管理鍵による公開鍵認証でrootログインに成功した。実機はBIOS boot、RAM 7.7GiB、内蔵SSDは223.6GiBで既存NTFS領域が残っている。実機SSHから、設定領域のby-label deviceへ `ro,loop,nosuid,nodev,noexec,umask=0077` を指定する標準mountを一時的な別mountpointで検証し、成功・ファイル存在を確認して解除した。元のSSH用mountと接続は維持した。ローカルinstaller宣言へ `loop` optionを追加し、Nix構文検査が通過した。2026-10-09に同じUSBがG6I3へ戻された。`loop`と`noCheck=true`を実宣言へ反映した新ISOの生成は正常完了し、P/R/Wが実生成物・起動構造・設定分離・書込用イメージを確認した。識別済みUSBへ1,589,706,752 bytesを書込み、全量読み戻ししたが比較は不一致となった。独立した読み取り照合で360 bytes/15か所の差分を確認し、USB私用設定領域は全量一致、差分は公開起動領域と末尾領域に限定された。2026-10-11に実adapterの64KiB転送上限とGUID一覧に出ないUSB領域の対応を確認し、既存writerへ上限内direct I/Oと実partition binding・2領域lock/dismountを組み込んだ。修正宣言・ISO・私用イメージは再生成せず、Rが実sourceを独立評価した後、同じUSBへ1,589,706,752 bytesを書込み・全量照合し、差分0/処理exit 0を確認、Rも媒体checkpoint PASSとした（[実結果と修正ループ](https://github.com/roccho-dev/resources/issues/58#issuecomment-6249432717)）。UserがWi-Fiアダプタを正常な本体ポートへ、電源OFF状態で差し替えて電源ONした後、192.168.0.103へP/Rが既存管理鍵と固定USBホスト鍵によるstrict SSHで独立接続した。修正版pg1、設定領域の自動ro/loop mount、Wi-Fi/NM/sshd、設定生成成功を実確認し、RはUSB修正jobをMissing=[]で受入した。手元Linux入力は不要だった。正常なポート配置での起動を使用条件として記録し、追加再起動・再build・kernel変更は不要。これはUSB live/bootstrapの完成であり、常設SSDの導入・GitHub常設flake・Mesh等の完成へ広げない。SSD消去・インストールは未実施。USB HDDは既に起動順位1位で、順位の再変更や書込方法の再質問を次工程にしない。標準installerの起動後に手元で鍵配置/password設定を要求する構成では今回のSSH前提を満たさないため、標準NixOS installerの機能を使い、公開鍵認証・sshd・初回自動ネットワークを必要最小限で準備する。管理者SSH秘密鍵・provider資格情報はUSB起動環境へ混入させない。USB起動専用SSHホスト秘密鍵の私用設定領域への保存は2026-10-09にUserが明示許可した。その後、対象を特定したUSB書込み、VersaProでのUSB boot、G6I3からのstrict SSH到達、SSH経由の実disk/NIC/boot確認、最小NixOS定義の実装・評価、インストールと初回登録/認証、rebuild/再起動/遠隔実利用の確認へ進む。各作用の許可と実証を分け、今回の図の保存をUSB消去、実機初期化、秘密移送、設定変更、VPS停止のGOにしない。 ## 次工程の設計協議（2026-10-09） Pと継続中のVersaPro設計担当A/Bが相互反証し、[工程・組成・復旧の結論とMermaid](https://github.com/roccho-dev/resources/issues/58#issuecomment-6249432642)に収束した。現SSHで宣言/最小systemを準備し、SSD消去前にだけ修正USBの実cold boot→手元Linux操作0のstrict SSHを確認する。対象SSD・BIOS boot・必要保全・対象作用許可を確認後、標準install→恒久公開host鍵pin→USBなしSSD単独boot→同source rebuild/再起動と必要状態/認証/代表agentの継続を実証する。Meshは別受入とする。 組織の役割契約は存在する。2026-10-09のUser明示許可により、既存A=/root/versapro_minimal_designを継続W、B=/root/versapro_operabilityを独立Rへそのまま割り当てた。当該scopeのCodex代替はUser許可済みで、P=/rootが調整Dを兼務する。W/Rの直接反証とPの最終補正を経て、[完成tree・数式・有限検証一覧・復旧表・閉包プロセス](https://github.com/roccho-dev/resources/issues/58#issuecomment-6249432678)の全節に3者合意した。未解消の設計反証は0。USB修正の限定scopeについて、必要なsource/admission・controlの実在担当/限定job登録を[adrs PR #612](https://github.com/roccho-dev/adrs/pull/612)のexact complete commit `9d77544a2ad45b12bc2bd2b30da83ee1e643bc96`へ保存した。同版をP/R/Wが全graph・entry SQL・原文readbackで独立確認し、Pが同版GOを出した。これは当該USBの生成・識別付き更新・読み戻し・実cold boot確認の作用に限定し、SSD消去/install・merge・VPS停止や全完成状態の採択/実機受入へ広げない。小ささは一組の宣言・標準機能・最小状態/分岐で評価し、実装の美しさは実source・実機証拠まで未判定。 ## 合意根拠 [3者の最終結論](https://github.com/roccho-dev/resources/issues/58#issuecomment-6249432484) / [Aの最終結論](https://github.com/roccho-dev/resources/issues/58#issuecomment-6249432438) / [Bの最終結論](https://github.com/roccho-dev/resources/issues/58#issuecomment-6249432388)。 本文は合意済み完成状態の参照先、コメントは主張・反証の根拠として残す。3者議論後のUser追加指定「SSH前提・手元端末に依存しない」は上の接続と次段階へ反映した。実装・実機受入・VPS代替の最終採否は未完了。 関連: roccho-dev/resources#52（別rentを含むNix開発環境・認証）、#14（Cloudflare接続）。 SSH起動条件の根拠：[NixOS公式manual](https://nixos.org/manual/nixos/stable/)はinstallerのsshdが有効でも、loginには公開鍵配置またはpassword設定が必要と説明する。今回の手元操作不要条件では、その公開鍵と初回接続をUSB準備段階で成立させる。

## Problem

The current auto-complete CI proves candidate-contract behavior, LSP boundary behavior, and adapter boundaries, but it does not produce a visual UX artifact.

This caused a naming/quality mismatch:

- `golden` was used for a logical candidate contract gate.
- No screenshot or visual artifact was produced.
- Therefore we cannot claim the Japanese input UX was visually reproduced from CI evidence.

## Goal

Add CI-visible UX evidence for the golden Japanese completion state.

The fix should:

- rename or clarify the existing golden as candidate-contract / logical golden
- generate a visual artifact representing the golden state
- verify that the artifact contains the expected candidates
- upload the artifact from GitHub Actions
- keep the existing logic/LSP/Vim/Helix boundary gates

## Expected visual state

The artifact must show at least:

```text
raw buffer: houji
preedit: ほうじ
candidates:
  1. houjinScore [normal]
  2. houjinRepository [normal]
  3. houjinbaikyakuPlan [normal]
  4. 法人 [jp-dict]
  5. 法人売却 [jp-dict]
```

## Non-goal

This issue does not require a full GUI editor screenshot. A deterministic CI-generated visual artifact is acceptable if it is explicitly named as visual evidence and checked in CI.

## Done when

- PR references this issue.
- CI generates a visual artifact under `packages/auto-complete/artifacts/`.
- CI checks the artifact includes `houjinScore`, `法人`, and `法人売却`.
- CI uploads the artifact.
- Existing candidate/LSP/Vim/Helix checks still pass.

## Purpose

Add a governance-side non-blocking readback path for `roccho-dev/console` README projection receipt.

This issue should let governance observe whether `console` projects ADRS-defined repository purpose and boundary, without making `console` part of selected real package closure and without treating README, deployed dashboards, screenshots, GitHub Projects, or generated artifacts as authority.

## Context

Upstream work:

- `roccho-dev/console#1` defines the initial console repository purpose issue.
- `roccho-dev/adrs#187` should define the ADRS-side console README projection contract.

This governance issue should wait for ADRS meaning input and console README receipt input before claiming any readback result.

## Expected PR

Suggested PR title:

```text
Observe console README projection receipt
```

Suggested branch:

```text
proposal/observe-console-readme-projection-260704
```

## Expected files

Exact file names may change to fit existing governance layout, but the PR should add or update a small, explicit readback surface such as:

- `docs/readme-projection/console-observation-260704.md`
- `docs/readme-projection/consoleReadmeProjectionReceipt.jsonl`
- `docs/gov-package-output/console-observed.jsonl`
- `docs/final-scope-purpose-join/console-nonblocking-note.md`

## Required behavior

Governance should classify `console` as:

- observed only;
- non-blocking;
- non-authority;
- not selected real package closure scope;
- not final active admission;
- not branch protection / ruleset cutover evidence by itself.

## Inputs to observe

The readback should be based on accepted or clearly preview-marked sources:

- ADRS console README projection contract from `roccho-dev/adrs#187` once available.
- `roccho-dev/console#1` as the originating repo purpose issue.
- Follow-up `console` README projection PR and its receipt rows once available.

If sources are still proposal-preview, the governance row must say so and must not mark the result accepted.

## Non-goals

This issue must not:

- add `console` to required repo universe;
- add `console` to selected real package closure scope;
- make `console` final join blocking;
- change branch protection or rulesets;
- require GitHub Projects for correctness;
- make README, dashboard output, screenshots, generated artifacts, or GitHub Projects authority;
- claim final governance admission for `console`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Governance has a small readback note or row for `console` README projection.
- [ ] The readback links ADRS meaning input, console README projection input, and projection receipt input.
- [ ] The readback is explicitly non-blocking unless a future accepted scope says otherwise.
- [ ] The readback distinguishes `proposal-preview` from `accepted` mode.
- [ ] No final gate, selected closure, branch protection, or organization-active claim is introduced.
- [ ] The output can be consumed by future final-scope reports as observation only.

## Merge blockers

Do not merge a PR for this issue until at least one of the following is true:

1. ADRS `console` README projection contract has been accepted, and `console` has emitted a matching README projection receipt; or
2. the PR is explicitly marked proposal-preview / blocked / non-final and does not claim accepted readback.

## Closure statement expected

When closing, the PR should state:

> governance observes `console` README projection as non-blocking evidence only; `console` is not admitted to selected closure or final gate authority by this work.

## Scope-to-meta contribution
| generation | contribution |
|---|---|
| scope | Prevents invalid JSONL rows from reaching adapters. |
| product | Converts contract into executable quality gate. |

| business/meta | Reduces accidental execution and due-diligence risk. |

- Validate required fields, known version, known target, payload type, timestamps, and id format.
- Return structured validation errors.

- Deep target-specific policy.
- Execution.

- [ ] Valid fixtures pass.

- [ ] Unknown targets are rejected, never executed by fallback.

- [ ] Missing id/version/target passes.
- [ ] Unknown target is treated as shell.
- [ ] Validation errors are only printed as free text.

## Evidence
- Validator tests.
- Fixture matrix.

## Merge condition
Merge only when execution cannot begin until row contract validation succeeds.

## Purpose

Expand the org join universe beyond governance/adrs to downstream repos after their local adoption and cutover evidence exists.

## Post-merge state

After attached PRs merge:
- selected universe includes downstream repos according to accepted ADRS required repo rules.
- packet registry includes downstream packet sources, revisions, and digests.
- missing downstream participation becomes visible to final report.

## Completion audit impact

Contributes to:
- `repoUniverseAudit`: downstream repos included.
- `packetRegistryDigest`: downstream packet sources pinned.
- `completionCertificate.requiredRepoUniverseDigest`.

## Merge blockers

Do not merge child PRs when:
- downstream repos lack local adoption/cutover evidence.
- universe expansion is hardcoded outside ADRS required repo inputs.
- packet sources are unpinned or stale.
- downstream missing packets are warning-only.

## Required evidence

- universe input diff or ADRS-derived selection output.
- packet registry entries for downstream repos.
- org join report showing downstream rows.
- PR comment listing included repoIds and dependency evidence.

## Boundary

This issue expands org universe only. It does not force downstream local checks by itself.

## Purpose

Integrate README and package README projection findings into the final report so reader-facing documentation can be checked as ADRS projection evidence instead of informal human convention.

## Post-merge state

After attached PRs merge:
- README projection findings appear in the final report.
- required README and package README surfaces can block when they drift from accepted ADRS projection.
- README remains non-authority evidence, never an independent source of truth.

## Completion audit impact

Contributes to:
- `readmeAudit`: required surfaces have no drift.
- `readmeProjectionDigestSet`: evidence included in completion certificate.
- `finalReport.readmeProjection` section.

## Merge blockers

Do not merge child PRs when:
- README is treated as authority instead of ADRS projection.
- README drift is only reported as optional artifact text.
- required surfaces are omitted from the report.
- findings lack expected, actual, delta, or nextAction.

## Required evidence

- README projection integration path.
- fixture with clean README projection.
- fixture with required README drift producing a finding.
- CI/check proving drift integration runs.

## Boundary

This issue closes README drift integration only. It does not close strict gate or cutover.

{"body":"## Purpose

Add a governance verifier for gov-package-output producer provenance so packets cannot pass by declaring matching-looking provenance fields by hand.

Parent phase issue: #79

## Scope

This is an issue for a future governance implementation PR. Do not open or implement the PR from this issue alone.

## Requirements

- Read `govPackageOutputProducer.v1` provenance fields from produced packets or adjacent producer records.
- Treat packet-internal provenance fields as claims to verify, not proof by themselves.
- Verify `producerRepo` equals the accepted producer repo or accepted ADRS exception.
- Verify `producerRev` against the declared governance input revision.
- Verify `producerDigest` against the producer implementation closure or accepted equivalent.
- Verify `outputDigest` against the actual generated packet content.
- Verify `packetDigest` when distinct from `outputDigest`.
- Verify `inputLockDigest` is present and points to declared input closure.
- Fail closed on missing source inputs.
- Fail closed on malformed provenance.
- Fail closed on fake matching-looking provenance.
- Emit actionable findings with expected/actual/delta/likelyOwner/nextAction.
- Preserve governance as verifier/projection only, not meaning authority.

## Done when

- A future PR adds a verifier entrypoint or check for producer provenance.
- Clean gov-produced packet fixture passes.
- Fake hand-written provenance fixture fails.
- Missing source input fixture fails.
- Wrong `outputDigest` fixture fails.
- Failure output is actionable and machine-readable.

## Not done when

- A packet can pass by declaring `producerRepo=roccho-dev/governance` by hand.
- Verifier trusts provenance fields without recomputing or externally verifying closure.
- Verification failures are warning-only after strict mode applies.
- PR claims branch protection, downstream rollout, or final gate cutover.

## Evidence required in child PR

- Verifier/check path.
- Clean fixture path.
- Fake provenance fixture path.
- Missing source input fixture path.
- Wrong digest fixture path.
- Example finding output with expected/actual/delta/nextAction.

## Child PR comment template

## Purpose

Add a governance verifier for gov-package-output producer provenance so packets cannot pass by declaring matching-looking provenance fields by hand.

Parent phase issue: #79

## Scope

This is an issue for a future governance implementation PR. Do not open or implement the PR from this issue alone.

## Requirements

- Read `govPackageOutputProducer.v1` provenance fields from produced packets or adjacent producer records.
- Treat packet-internal provenance fields as claims to verify, not proof by themselves.
- Verify `producerRepo` equals the accepted producer repo or accepted ADRS exception.
- Verify `producerRev` against the declared governance input revision.
- Verify `producerDigest` against the producer implementation closure or accepted equivalent.
- Verify `outputDigest` against the actual generated packet content.
- Verify `packetDigest` when distinct from `outputDigest`.
- Verify `inputLockDigest` is present and points to declared input closure.
- Fail closed on missing source inputs.
- Fail closed on malformed provenance.
- Fail closed on fake matching-looking provenance.
- Emit actionable findings with expected/actual/delta/likelyOwner/nextAction.
- Preserve governance as verifier/projection only, not meaning authority.

## Done when

- A future PR adds a verifier entrypoint or check for producer provenance.
- Clean gov-produced packet fixture passes.
- Fake hand-written provenance fixture fails.
- Missing source input fixture fails.
- Wrong `outputDigest` fixture fails.
- Failure output is actionable and machine-readable.

- A packet can pass by declaring `producerRepo=roccho-dev/governance` by hand.
- Verifier trusts provenance fields without recomputing or externally verifying closure.
- Verification failures are warning-only after strict mode applies.
- PR claims branch protection, downstream rollout, or final gate cutover.

## Purpose

Fix `edits` as the editor/human-confirmation surface and queue-writer boundary for the editor-to-queue-to-ui flow.

## Scope

- Document that `edits` owns Vim/hq command vocabulary, completion surface, human confirm, targetRef consumption, and queue row writing.
- Document that `edits` does not own worker runtime, admission, accepted ledger, projection authority, or UI rendering.
- Add a boundary check that prevents docs/packages from presenting `edits` as the primary worker/admission/runtime owner.

## Done

- README/docs clearly state: `edits = editor surface + queue writer`.
- Existing local/dev proof remains allowed only as proof/legacy evidence, not canonical runtime ownership.
- Forbidden ownership claims fail in CI.

## Scope-achievement declaration

This issue is complete only when all of the following are true:

- Purpose lineage: directly supports `editor -> queue -> ui`; directly supports clean `edits/ops/ui` repo ownership; indirectly supports sale-ready explainability.
- Core/port/adapter: this issue defines the boundary for `edits` core, ports, and adapters, but does not add runtime ownership.
- Pure/effect split: `edits` pure layer is command/targetRef interpretation; `edits` side-effect layer is editor/file queue-writing adapters only.
- False-positive exclusion: a check must fail if `edits` is described as owning worker, admission, accepted ledger, projection authority, or UI renderer.
- False-negative exclusion: a check must allow explicit non-authority mentions for docs/proof-only legacy references.
- Authority boundary: queue rows written from `edits` are intent only; no accepted authority is created in `edits`.
- Repo cleanliness: no `edits` package may become the canonical runtime, admission, ledger, projection, or renderer package.

## Non-goals

- Do not move code in this issue.
- Do not delete the existing local worker proof.
- Do not implement ops runtime here.

## Checks

- Boundary doc/static check passes.
- Existing hq modeling queue tests still pass.

## Why this matters

This keeps the human operation surface small and prevents editor code from becoming the queue runtime or authority layer.

request.text:
{"body":"## Goal

Make green CI mean the actual goal is present:

```text
JSONL source -> stateless core/port adapter pipeline -> executable purpose-visualization HTML -> headless runtime screenshots -> uploaded evidence artifacts
```

The target is not a static contract-only replacement, not a CI table, and not absence of the retired preview package. The target is the runnable purpose visualization that can be opened as HTML and proven by runtime screenshots.

## Highest objective

High-value company build and eventual sale.

## Meta objective

Avoid false-positive green CI. CI must prove the artifact that matters to a future buyer/operator: the visible, runnable, reproducible purpose visualization generated from the intended JSONL/stateless architecture.

## Corrected interpretation

The earlier CI direction was too deletion-centered:

```text
retired preview package is absent
```

The corrected direction is:

```text
current purpose visualization HTML is generated from JSONL through a stateless adapter/core-port path, executable, screenshot-tested, and uploaded
```

## Stage policy

This issue is split into two stages.

| stage | purpose | may merge? | closes this issue? |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Stage A | restore executable HTML + runtime screenshots + artifact uploads | yes, if CI/artifacts are green | no |
| Stage B | replace direct HTML generation with JSONL -> stateless adapter -> core/port lib pipeline | yes, after Stage A | yes |

## Current PR handling

PR #102 may be treated as a Stage A recovery PR if all of these are true:

- It builds runnable purpose-visualization HTML.
- It executes that HTML in a headless browser.
- It uploads `purpose-visualization-html`, `purpose-visualization-screenshots`, and `purpose-visualization-evidence`.
- It does not revive `packages/purpose-atlas-preview` as a package.
- It does not claim generated artifacts are authority.
- It does not claim the adapter/core-port architecture is complete.

PR #102 must not be the final closure of this issue unless it also satisfies Stage B. Its PR body should use `Refs #95`, not `Closes #95`, unless Stage B is included in the same PR.

## Practical scope

- Remove or demote CI/checks whose only useful effect is proving absence of the retired preview package, tombstone markers, old names, or completed governance handoff state.
- Keep or add CI only when it proves the current executable visualization artifact or prevents issue-less/approval-less PR drift.
- Add or preserve a deterministic command to build runnable HTML.
- Add or preserve a deterministic command to run headless smoke tests and screenshots.
- Upload the HTML, screenshots, and evidence as CI artifacts.
- Route final artifact generation through JSONL and stateless `core-port` adapter/port library rather than a standalone hand-written HTML template.

## Non-scope

- Do not revive the old retired package as an unbounded parallel implementation.
- Do not keep CI only because it already exists.
- Do not preserve absence checks as the main proof of success.
- Do not add history reducers, tombstone ledgers, or old-name-only guards.
- Do not treat generated artifacts as authority.
- Do not merge automatically from this issue.

## Required output artifacts

| artifact | required contents |
|---|---|
| `purpose-visualization-html` | runnable HTML, required JS/CSS/assets if any, source surface/data used to render |
| `purpose-visualization-screenshots` | PNG screenshots from headless runtime execution |
| `purpose-visualization-evidence` | manifest with commit SHA, build command, screenshot command, output paths, source digests, and smoke tokens found |

## Required screenshots

| screenshot | required visible evidence |
|---|---|
| overview | purpose visualization loads without blank screen or fatal runtime error |
| closure | `Purpose closure object` or equivalent closure section is visible |
| selected gap | selected gap / gap detail is visible |
| work order | work order section is visible |
| receipt | receipt section is visible |
| residual | residual next input or residual section is visible |

## Stage A acceptance criteria

Stage A is enough for a recovery merge but not enough to close this issue.

- CI builds executable HTML.
- CI runs the HTML in a headless browser.
- CI captures runtime screenshots.
- CI uploads HTML, screenshot, and evidence artifacts.
- Smoke fails on blank page, missing required tokens, fatal console/page errors, or missing screenshots.
- PR body clearly states that adapter/core-port routing remains a follow-up if not implemented.

## Stage B final acceptance criteria

This issue closes only when all Stage A criteria remain true and these architecture criteria are also true:

- Build path imports and uses `core-port` or its adapter/port exports instead of bypassing them with a standalone HTML-only generator.
- Purpose visualization generation uses the current adapter descriptor, such as `purposeAtlasHtmlBox`, or an equivalent stateless adapter registered under `core-port`.
- The adapter descriptor is checked to be stateless, e.g. `ownsState:false`.
- Input JSONL source digests match the JSONL sources bundled into the artifact.
- The generated HTML/evidence records the adapter/core-port path used to produce it.
- A bypass guard fails if purpose visualization HTML is generated without going through the stateless adapter/core-port path.
- HTML/screenshots/evidence artifacts remain present and equal-or-better than Stage A.

## CI to delete or demote

| check class | required action | reason |
|---|---|---|
| retired package absence as main proof | delete/demote | absence does not prove the visualization exists |
| `purpose-atlas-preview-html` absence as main proof | delete/demote | absence check caused the wrong target to be protected |
| future marker / tombstone / old-name-only guard | delete | protects historical memory, not current user-visible value |
| completed handoff/audit-only CI | delete/demote | should not stay as permanent product CI |
| duplicate workflow coverage | consolidate | fewer CI surfaces reduce review cost |

If a deletion is unsafe, the PR must explain why the check protects a current executable artifact rather than historical absence.

## CI to keep or define

| CI | reason |
|---|---|
| `purpose-visualization-artifact` | builds runnable visualization and uploads HTML/screenshots/evidence |
| `purpose-visualization-smoke` or equivalent job step | executes generated HTML and captures screenshots |
| `core-port` / adapter contract checks | only if they directly protect the final artifact pipeline |
| PR governance | prevents issue-less PRs, missing scope, missing merge conditions, and missing human approval |

These may be one workflow with separate jobs if that is simpler. Every remaining CI job must map to one of the required purposes above.

## Merge-blocking conditions for final closure

- No executable HTML artifact.
- No runtime screenshot artifact.
- Screenshot generated from a static mock rather than executing HTML.
- CI only proves absence/deletion rather than visible artifact presence.
- Direct HTML generation is treated as final architecture.
- Missing stateless adapter/core-port route.
- Missing JSONL source digest evidence.
- Missing PR governance fields or missing human approval.
- Any workflow failure.

## References

- Refs #78: previous PR removed the residual preview package, which is not sufficient for the true goal.
- Refs #79: parent governance issue.
- Refs #82: post-merge CI evidence remained incomplete for #78.
- Refs #94: governance PR made issue-first process available, but did not create the required executable visualization artifact.
- Refs #102: candidate Stage A recovery PR for executable HTML/screenshots/evidence.

## Closure statement

This issue closes only when the repo's green CI means: the current purpose visualization is generated from JSONL through a stateless adapter/core-port path, can be opened as runnable HTML, screenshots are produced from runtime execution, and those artifacts are available from CI."}

{"body":"## Goal

Make green CI mean the actual goal is present:

```text
JSONL source -> stateless core/port adapter pipeline -> executable purpose-visualization HTML -> headless runtime screenshots -> uploaded evidence artifacts
```

The target is not a static contract-only replacement, not a CI table, and not absence of the retired preview package. The target is the runnable purpose visualization that can be opened as HTML and proven by runtime screenshots.

## Highest objective

High-value company build and eventual sale.

## Meta objective

Avoid false-positive green CI. CI must prove the artifact that matters to a future buyer/operator: the visible, runnable, reproducible purpose visualization generated from the intended JSONL/stateless architecture.

## Corrected interpretation

The earlier CI direction was too deletion-centered:

```text
retired preview package is absent
```

The corrected direction is:

```text
current purpose visualization HTML is generated from JSONL through a stateless adapter/core-port path, executable, screenshot-tested, and uploaded
```

## Stage policy

This issue is split into two stages.

| stage | purpose | may merge? | closes this issue? |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Stage A | restore executable HTML + runtime screenshots + artifact uploads | yes, if CI/artifacts are green | no |
| Stage B | replace direct HTML generation with JSONL -> stateless adapter -> core/port lib pipeline | yes, after Stage A | yes |

## Current PR handling

PR #102 may be treated as a Stage A recovery PR if all of these are true:

- It builds runnable purpose-visualization HTML.
- It executes that HTML in a headless browser.
- It uploads `purpose-visualization-html`, `purpose-visualization-screenshots`, and `purpose-visualization-evidence`.
- It does not revive `packages/purpose-atlas-preview` as a package.
- It does not claim generated artifacts are authority.
- It does not claim the adapter/core-port architecture is complete.

PR #102 must not be the final closure of this issue unless it also satisfies Stage B. Its PR body should use `Refs #95`, not `Closes #95`, unless Stage B is included in the same PR.

## Practical scope

- Remove or demote CI/checks whose only useful effect is proving absence of the retired preview package, tombstone markers, old names, or completed governance handoff state.
- Keep or add CI only when it proves the current executable visualization artifact or prevents issue-less/approval-less PR drift.
- Add or preserve a deterministic command to build runnable HTML.
- Add or preserve a deterministic command to run headless smoke tests and screenshots.
- Upload the HTML, screenshots, and evidence as CI artifacts.
- Route final artifact generation through JSONL and stateless `core-port` adapter/port library rather than a standalone hand-written HTML template.

## Non-scope

- Do not revive the old retired package as an unbounded parallel implementation.
- Do not keep CI only because it already exists.
- Do not preserve absence checks as the main proof of success.
- Do not add history reducers, tombstone ledgers, or old-name-only guards.
- Do not treat generated artifacts as authority.
- Do not merge automatically from this issue.

## Required output artifacts

| artifact | required contents |
|---|---|
| `purpose-visualization-html` | runnable HTML, required JS/CSS/assets if any, source surface/data used to render |
| `purpose-visualization-screenshots` | PNG screenshots from headless runtime execution |
| `purpose-visualization-evidence` | manifest with commit SHA, build command, screenshot command, output paths, source digests, and smoke tokens found |

## Required screenshots

| screenshot | required visible evidence |
|---|---|
| overview | purpose visualization loads without blank screen or fatal runtime error |
| closure | `Purpose closure object` or equivalent closure section is visible |
| selected gap | selected gap / gap detail is visible |
| work order | work order section is visible |
| receipt | receipt section is visible |
| residual | residual next input or residual section is visible |

## Stage A acceptance criteria

Stage A is enough for a recovery merge but not enough to close this issue.

- CI builds executable HTML.
- CI runs the HTML in a headless browser.
- CI captures runtime screenshots.
- CI uploads HTML, screenshot, and evidence artifacts.
- Smoke fails on blank page, missing required tokens, fatal console/page errors, or missing screenshots.
- PR body clearly states that adapter/core-port routing remains a follow-up if not implemented.

## Stage B final acceptance criteria

This issue closes only when all Stage A criteria remain true and these architecture criteria are also true:

- Build path imports and uses `core-port` or its adapter/port exports instead of bypassing them with a standalone HTML-only generator.
- Purpose visualization generation uses the current adapter descriptor, such as `purposeAtlasHtmlBox`, or an equivalent stateless adapter registered under `core-port`.
- The adapter descriptor is checked to be stateless, e.g. `ownsState:false`.
- Input JSONL source digests match the JSONL sources bundled into the artifact.
- The generated HTML/evidence records the adapter/core-port path used to produce it.
- A bypass guard fails if purpose visualization HTML is generated without going through the stateless adapter/core-port path.
- HTML/screenshots/evidence artifacts remain present and equal-or-better than Stage A.

## CI to delete or demote

| check class | required action | reason |
|---|---|---|
| retired package absence as main proof | delete/demote | absence does not prove the visualization exists |
| `purpose-atlas-preview-html` absence as main proof | delete/demote | absence check caused the wrong target to be protected |
| future marker / tombstone / old-name-only guard | delete | protects historical memory, not current user-visible value |
| completed handoff/audit-only CI | delete/demote | should not stay as permanent product CI |
| duplicate workflow coverage | consolidate | fewer CI surfaces reduce review cost |

If a deletion is unsafe, the PR must explain why the check protects a current executable artifact rather than historical absence.

## CI to keep or define

| CI | reason |
|---|---|
| `purpose-visualization-artifact` | builds runnable visualization and uploads HTML/screenshots/evidence |
| `purpose-visualization-smoke` or equivalent job step | executes generated HTML and captures screenshots |
| `core-port` / adapter contract checks | only if they directly protect the final artifact pipeline |
| PR governance | prevents issue-less PRs, missing scope, missing merge conditions, and missing human approval |

These may be one workflow with separate jobs if that is simpler. Every remaining CI job must map to one of the required purposes above.

## Merge-blocking conditions for final closure

- No executable HTML artifact.
- No runtime screenshot artifact.
- Screenshot generated from a static mock rather than executing HTML.
- CI only proves absence/deletion rather than visible artifact presence.
- Direct HTML generation is treated as final architecture.
- Missing stateless adapter/core-port route.
- Missing JSONL source digest evidence.
- Missing PR governance fields or missing human approval.
- Any workflow failure.

## References

- Refs #78: previous PR removed the residual preview package, which is not sufficient for the true goal.
- Refs #79: parent governance issue.
- Refs #82: post-merge CI evidence remained incomplete for #78.
- Refs #94: governance PR made issue-first process available, but did not create the required executable visualization artifact.
- Refs #102: candidate Stage A recovery PR for executable HTML/screenshots/evidence.

## Closure statement

This issue closes only when the repo's green CI means: the current purpose visualization is generated from JSONL through a stateless adapter/core-port path, can be opened as runnable HTML, screenshots are produced from runtime execution, and those artifacts are available from CI."}

body内の各文を、望ましい状態の宣言と、実際に起きたことの報告に分けて読んでください。EとOは同時にyesでも構いません。Eは文書の主題や多数決ではなく存在判定です。具体的な要求文・完成条件・目標文が一文でもあれば、残りが全部作業報告でもE=yesです。例えば「利用者に完了を通知すること」は期待ですが、「利用者に通知した」は実施報告であり期待ではありません。Goal・Acceptanceという見出しそのものは期待文ではなく、その下に過去の実施報告しかなければE=noです。表・数式・役割が完成状態の対応を定義する場合も期待です。Oでは実測の引用・確認状況一覧・本文内HTMLコメントの作業メモも数えますが、架空の試験入力・条件付きの例は数えません。許容を表す「〜でもよい」や仮定・可能性だけを述べる文は、現状の報告ではありません。例えば「点検は後日でもよい」は許容条件ですが、「点検はまだしていない」は現在の状態の報告です。O=yesにするには、本文が現実にそうだと主張している箇所が必要です。与えられたbody全体だけを対象に判断し、そこにない現状を推測しないでください。
本問はEだけ：本文が実現すべき状態を一つでも宣言しているか。完成状態の表・責務・式も宣言である。Goal等の見出しだけでYesにしない。本文にそのような期待がなければNo。実施済みと書いてあるだけなら期待ではない。

## Purpose

Define and implement the governance-side packet registry/transport layer so org join knows where each required repo's gov-package-output packet comes from and how freshness is pinned.

Parent phase issue: #80

## Scope

This is an issue for a future governance implementation PR. Do not open or implement the PR from this issue alone.

## Requirements

- Define packet registry input shape or accepted equivalent.
- For each required repo, record packet source kind.
- Record `repoId`.
- Record `sourceRepo`.
- Record `sourceRev` or immutable equivalent.
- Record `packetPath` or packet artifact locator.
- Record `packetDigest`.
- Record `producerRev`.
- Record freshness rule.
- Record whether source is fixture, local checked path, flake package output, CI artifact, or pinned repo artifact.
- Missing packet source must be diagnosable.
- Unpinned packet source must fail closed.
- Stale sourceRev must be diagnosable by D3.
- Packet registry must not depend on hidden local state.
- Packet registry must be deterministic and stable sorted.
- D2 must feed D3/D4 without doing org admission itself.

## Done when

- Registry/transport shape is defined in governance implementation.
- Clean fixture maps governance/adrs required repos to pinned packet sources.
- Missing packet source fixture fails or yields stable diagnostic for D3.
- Unpinned source fixture fails.
- Registry output includes enough information for provenance-aware org join.

## Not done when

- Org join implicitly guesses packet paths.
- Packet source is mutable without digest/rev pinning.
- Registry relies on hidden local filesystem state.
- Missing packet source can pass.
- PR claims final gate, branch protection, downstream rollout, or active-only admission.

## Evidence required in child PR

- Registry schema/path.
- Transport reader/tool path.
- Clean registry fixture.
- Missing source fixture.
- Unpinned source fixture.
- Example registry output.
- Check/selftest command.

## Child PR comment template

```text
Child PR: governance#<number>
Phase issue: #80 / D2
Requirement: packet registry / transport / pinning
Delta removed: org join no longer has ambiguous packet source lookup
Evidence: <registry path / fixtures / check output>
Boundary: registry/transport only; no final admission/gate/cutover claim
```

## Purpose

Define and implement the governance-side packet registry/transport layer so org join knows where each required repo's gov-package-output packet comes from and how freshness is pinned.

Parent phase issue: #80

## Scope

This is an issue for a future governance implementation PR. Do not open or implement the PR from this issue alone.

## Requirements

- Define packet registry input shape or accepted equivalent.
- For each required repo, record packet source kind.
- Record `repoId`.
- Record `sourceRepo`.
- Record `sourceRev` or immutable equivalent.
- Record `packetPath` or packet artifact locator.
- Record `packetDigest`.
- Record `producerRev`.
- Record freshness rule.
- Record whether source is fixture, local checked path, flake package output, CI artifact, or pinned repo artifact.
- Missing packet source must be diagnosable.
- Unpinned packet source must fail closed.
- Stale sourceRev must be diagnosable by D3.
- Packet registry must not depend on hidden local state.
- Packet registry must be deterministic and stable sorted.
- D2 must feed D3/D4 without doing org admission itself.

## Done when

- Registry/transport shape is defined in governance implementation.
- Clean fixture maps governance/adrs required repos to pinned packet sources.
- Missing packet source fixture fails or yields stable diagnostic for D3.
- Unpinned source fixture fails.
- Registry output includes enough information for provenance-aware org join.

## Not done when

- Org join implicitly guesses packet paths.
- Packet source is mutable without digest/rev pinning.
- Registry relies on hidden local filesystem state.
- Missing packet source can pass.
- PR claims final gate, branch protection, downstream rollout, or active-only admission.

## Evidence required in child PR

- Registry schema/path.
- Transport reader/tool path.
- Clean registry fixture.
- Missing source fixture.
- Unpinned source fixture.
- Example registry output.
- Check/selftest command.

## Child PR comment template

```text
Child PR: governance#<number>
Phase issue: #80 / D2
Requirement: packet registry / transport / pinning
Delta removed: org join no longer has ambiguous packet source lookup
Evidence: <registry path / fixtures / check output>
Boundary: registry/transport only; no final admission/gate/cutover claim
```

Parent: #99

## Purpose

Close the actual compiler-to-worker handoff. The queue row produced by the real `cmd/hq` acceptance path must become exact canonical `instruction.v1` input without hidden worker defaults or target-specific interpretation.

## Contribution to parent

| generation | contribution |
|---:|---|
| scope | Connects the real `Vim -> hq` output to `hq-worker`. |
| product | Preserves `hq` as meaning-free while making the accepted row executable downstream. |
| system | Removes the fixture-only gap between compiler and worker contracts. |
| organization | Gives editor/compiler and worker owners one explicit handoff. |
| business/meta | Reduces integration ambiguity, key-person knowledge, and DD risk. |

Directly closes parent acceptance criterion:

- actual `cmd/hq` accepted output becomes exact canonical `instruction.v1` input without hidden worker defaults.

## Current gap

The merged compiler path emits an `accepted.instruction` envelope/queue intent. The merged worker validates canonical `instruction.v1`. Both boundaries are correct independently, but the actual conversion/handoff is not yet proven end to end.

## Required design

Prefer one of these designs, in order:

1. `hq` appends the accepted candidate's inner canonical instruction object unchanged;
2. a separate pure envelope-to-`instruction.v1` adapter performs an explicit versioned conversion.

The worker must not infer missing identity, version, target, operation, timestamp, policy, or payload fields from target-specific defaults.

## Scope

- define the accepted envelope to canonical instruction mapping;
- make the mapping pure and target-neutral;
- use the real `cmd/hq` binary in proof;
- feed the resulting queue row to the real worker validator/dry-run path;
- preserve preview/no-append behavior.

## Non-scope

- process execution;
- concrete target adapters;
- accepted decision authority;
- remote queue or SSOT promotion.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A real `cmd/hq --accept --queue` invocation produces a row that is accepted as exact `instruction.v1`, or produces a versioned envelope that a pure explicit adapter converts to exact `instruction.v1`.
- [ ] No worker-side hidden default supplies required canonical fields.
- [ ] The selected instruction payload is preserved without semantic rewrite.
- [ ] Complete/context/draft remain side-effect free.
- [ ] Accept without explicit queue creates no durable row.
- [ ] One acceptance creates exactly one canonical worker input row.
- [ ] Invalid or incomplete accepted envelopes fail closed with `validation.v1` evidence.
- [ ] Linux proof passes.
- [ ] Windows proof passes for the official Windows hq/worker binaries.

## Destructive cases

The issue is not complete if any succeeds:

1. worker invents target/op/version/id/timestamp fields;
2. compiler embeds target CLI semantics;
3. preview appends a row;
4. one acceptance creates zero or multiple worker input rows;
5. a hand-written replacement fixture is used instead of actual hq output;
6. accepted output validates only after target-specific mutation;
7. queue intent is described as accepted decision authority.

## Evidence

- actual hq input/output transcript;
- exact queue row artifact;
- canonical validation result;
- negative incomplete-envelope fixture;
- Linux and Windows CI artifacts;
- digest/equality proof between accepted inner instruction and canonical row.

## Dependencies

- #32-#40
- #41-#48
- #72-#74

Blocks:

- #81
- parent #99 closure

## Merge condition

Merge only when the actual built compiler output, not a replacement fixture, enters the canonical worker path without adding execution meaning to `hq`.

Parent: #37

## Purpose

Prove that the `hq-source-jsonl` adapter can consume a representative hq source JSONL fixture and normalize it into completion candidates.

Why this contributes: it keeps the auto-complete package directly connectable to the hq modeling/control-plane work without adding a custom editor-specific path.

## Current gap

The source adapter exists, but there is no dedicated fixture proving compatibility with hq-style source rows.

## Required work

- Add `test/fixtures/hq.source.jsonl` with representative hq source rows.
- Include at least command vocabulary, targetRef-like values, schema/key suggestions, and queue/source identifiers.
- Add a checker or Go test that loads the fixture through `adapters/source/hq-source-jsonl`.
- Assert normalized candidate fields and deterministic rank.
- Assert the adapter handles optional fields without silently changing semantics.

## False-positive prevention

The adapter must fail if it cannot map hq rows into meaningful completion candidates.

## False-negative prevention

The fixture should include only stable hq row shapes and explicitly mark optional fields.

## Done when

- CI proves hq source rows become normalized provider candidates.
- At least one hq candidate appears in LSP completion output when configured.
- Failure output identifies the bad hq row and violated expectation.

## Purpose

Make the ui repo-map artifact builder explicitly accept projection artifacts produced by ops.

## Scope

- Accept ops-produced `repoMap.projection.v1` JSON as external input.
- Record provider, path, source digest, and bundled source copy as evidence.
- Preserve fixture fallback and legacy compatibility where already supported.
- Keep generated artifacts non-authority.

## Done

- Ops projection fixture renders through the existing repo-map path.
- Manifest records source digest/provider/path.
- Invalid projection input fails clearly.
- Docs state that ui reads projection and does not build accepted model state.

## Scope-achievement declaration

This issue is complete only when all of the following are true:

- Purpose lineage: directly closes the ops-to-ui handoff for editor-to-queue-to-ui.
- Core/port/adapter: projection normalization/validation is pure view core; projection input is a port; file/artifact reading is adapter.
- Pure/effect split: projection compatibility checks are pure; reading external files and writing manifests/source copies are adapter-only.
- False-positive exclusion: valid ops projection artifacts must be accepted and rendered.
- False-negative exclusion: malformed, stale, authority-bearing, non-projection source-model, or digest-mismatched inputs must fail.
- Authority boundary: external projection input is read-model evidence only; ui does not generate or accept model authority.
- Repo cleanliness: ui reads projection artifacts but does not implement ops projection builder or admission.

## Non-goals

- Do not generate projection from source model in ui.
- Do not write queue or ledger.
- Do not change ops runtime.

## Checks

- ops projection external input check.
- invalid input failure check.
- valid/malformed FP-FN projection fixtures.
- Existing repo-map external-input checks pass.

## Depends on

- #127
- roccho-dev/ops#43

## Why this matters

This is the ops-to-ui handoff: ops creates the projection, ui only reads and renders it.

specification.instruction: Read only the complete literal body, including HTML comments, tables, formulas and templates. Decide whether it contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract: a rule, expected or acceptable condition, responsibility, functional capability, input/output mapping, interface purpose, or condition or limitation of use. A stated expected-outcome caption or interface text declaring an action's purpose can qualify. No formal specification label, generality, adoption, implementation, must-word or future tense is required. Distinguish the role of the relationship being stated. Declaring what a function does or what condition applies counts; merely describing what happened, is happening, used to happen or regularly happens in observed execution does not by itself declare a specification. A performed configuration, measured value, comparison or causal explanation does not supply an unstated applicable contract. These are role distinctions, not rules excluding particular headings, formats, tenses or words: a report may also contain a genuine specification, and an ordinary capability statement can declare one without requesting a change. Read each statement in context; one qualifying declaration anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when used to declare the specification, but not when displayed only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'This dial sets the sampling interval' declares a function; 'I turned the dial and the reading changed' alone reports an observation. A request or a subject's goal alone does not establish this specification role. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. It declares the relationship itself; merely reporting a performed action, observed configuration or value, observed result, or a causal explanation of an observed event does not by itself establish that role. A genuine declaration still counts inside a report, quotation or template when the body uses it to declare that relationship.
options.no: The complete body contains no statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; observations elsewhere do not cancel a genuine declaration.

request.instruction: Read only the complete literal body, including HTML comments, tables, formulas and templates. Decide whether it contains at least one genuine request for an action, answer, submission, improvement or remedy, or explicitly presents an action or state as a subject's intended goal or need. Count indirect requests and actual conditional reporting or submission directions, including directions carried by a template or HTML comment whether or not the requested information has been supplied. No addressee, stated reason, fully identified final goal, solution, adoption or implementation is required. Distinguish a relationship presented as a target or request from wording that only locates the circumstances of a reported event or explains a necessary response to it. An incident, inability, missing feature, risk, complaint, category or recipient mention alone does not declare the desired opposite or request its correction. Merely explaining what was necessary to obtain an observed result or work around it does not by itself declare an intended goal. Do not exclude a genuine goal or request merely because it appears within a report or a subordinate clause; do not infer one solely from modality, tense, a heading, mention, imperative form or question mark. A specification or expected caption alone does not establish this request or subject-goal role. One qualifying statement anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when the body uses it to make an actual request or goal declaration, but not when shown only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'I need a cost estimate before ordering the materials' declares a goal or need; 'The estimate arrived late, so I postponed the order' alone reports an event and response. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. This includes actual reporting or submission directions before the requested information is supplied. Merely naming a category or recipient, reporting an incident or inability, or explaining a necessary workaround does not itself establish this role.
options.no: The complete body contains no genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; a report or subordinate clause does not cancel an actual request or goal.

## Problem

The repository setting `can_approve_pull_request_reviews=false` forbids `GITHUB_TOKEN` from creating PRs, while three merged effect workflows call `gh pr create` after pushing their handoff branch:

- `author-dev-jev-api.yml`
- `project-dev-jev-api.yml`
- `project-dev-rent-tunnel.yml`

The author workflow has never run. For envs#24, dispatch would spend the one-shot input, push the ciphertext branch, then end RED at PR creation.

## Decision needed

Choose one repository-wide contract:

1. workflows stop successfully after pushing and reporting the exact branch/head; the authenticated owner opens the PR, which triggers normal `check`; or
2. Actions PR creation is explicitly allowed and its review/CI semantics are defined.

Do not normalize a failed run as PASS. Do not change only the OCI target while leaving shared Cloudflare/rent semantics ambiguous.

## Boundary

Blocks clean Effect 2 completion for envs#24. This Issue authorizes no setting change, workflow edit, credential use, dispatch, ciphertext, Cloudflare projection, handoff or deploy. Evidence: roccho-dev/adrs#460 comment 5900288482.

{"body":"## Current recovery report — 2026-10-11 JST

OCIからGitHubへ接続できない状態を、既存の共有WSLC session内だけで一時復旧しました。**現在の通常通信はPASS、恒久修正・再起動後の復帰は未証明**です。

### 観測と変更

- 対象：既存 `wslc-cli-resta` / `windows-own`。container ID・image・3 named volumesは変更なし。
- OCI側のinterface・default route・DNS・gateway到達は正常でした。
- 親WSLC Linux VMにはconnected routeが3本だけあり、IPv4/IPv6のdefault routeがありませんでした。親のGitHub宛route-getも `Network is unreachable`。

```text
wslc --session wslc-cli-resta system session run /usr/sbin/ip route add default via 192.168.0.1 dev eth0
```

この値は今回の実測に対する一時的なoperational validationです。過去の意図したgatewayが判明したとは主張せず、repoや起動処理へ固定値として追加していません。

### 実際の正例・保存境界

- 親VM：default 1本＋元のconnected 3本を読戻し、他のroute変更0。
- 正規OCI UID1000：`github.com` / `api.github.com` のTCP443と、既存repo-owned CA・検証有効のTLS1.3が両方成功。
- 既存repo-local bindingのnative Git `ls-remote` 成功。
- 既存GH認証で `roccho-dev` / id `40359643` とrepository accessを確認。新しい認証・token/keyコピーなし。
- OCIのroute/DNSは同一、SSH2223は同じUID0・inode3758で維持。container/image/mounts/host2223 bindingも同一。
- Rootによる操作と、別の固定Wセッションによる独立readbackが一致。3人の人間による承認とは扱っていません。
- container/session/Windows restart・disconnect・再作成0、NAT/firewall/interface/DNS/TLS policy変更0、既存認証ツール内部のcredential利用以外の私的読み取り・複写0、Jev/model呼出し0。既存の他4containerは操作前からexitedで、その状態を保持。

### CLI transportの観測

同じ親VMのreadonly `ip` で、通常pipe経路は `ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE` が断続的に発生しました。完全な出力後に非0となった例も保持し、成功へ昇格していません。同じWSLC directargvを既存host PTY transportで実行すると正常終了し、復旧操作も一度だけexit0。その後のkernel・TCP/TLS・native Git/GHを独立に照合しました。Linux session-run自体はnoTTYのままです。Windows上の開発やnetwork cmdlet実行はありません。

### 未解決と次の責務

- なぜdefault routeが失われたか：UNKNOWN。特定のupstream bug/VPN/host再起動を原因と断定しません。
- 起動・復帰時に正しい経路を得る既存WSLC/host-owner経路のreadback、再発防止・再起動試験：未実施。
- 今回の1行を万能helper/daemonやhard-coded gatewayとして常設しません。
- Cloudflare・windows#8/#14の実装/配備変更には踏み込んでいません。
- 通信復旧 ≠ Appsの図生成品質PASS ≠ 全ソースpush済み。Appsの未push2-file candidateのnative publicationは別途照合します。

Issueは再発原因・正規の復帰保証が未完のためOPENで残します。
<!-- voice-ui-wslc-egress-recovery-20261011-v1 -->
"}

Parent: roccho-dev/adrs#540
Phase: 1
Related current provider work: #22
Consumer counterpart: roccho-dev/ops Phase 1 child

## 目的

envsが実際に提供する capability / target / slot / projection / receipt を、ops側requirementと機械的に照合できる最小の provision projection として公開する。

契約意味のSSOTはADRSのまま。envsのprojectionはADRSの再定義ではなく、提供実体の機械可読な投影とする。

```text
ADRS contract
   ↓
envs implementation
   ↓
provision projection + receipt
   ↓
ops exact diff
```

## 最小境界

Phase 1でopsが照合できればよい項目だけを安定して出す。

- ADRS ref
- capability
- target
- slot / binding
- projection/readback identity
- receipt
- exact envs SHA

secret値、secret値hash、第二の契約意味、consumer固有判断は出さない。

## 既存との関係

#22はprovider handoffの偽陽性を防ぐ具体的な証拠/readback修正として残す。

本Issueは、その実体を含むenvs提供面を **opsがexact diff可能な形へ投影する共通境界** だけを所有する。#22を複製・置換しない。

## 完了

- envsが提供しているものだけがprovisionに現れる
- 未実証のtarget/receiptを提供済みにしない
- stale receipt/revisionを現行提供として扱わない
- 同じADRS refに対するcapability/target/slotをopsからexact比較できる
- provisionがADRSのsemantic SSOTにならない

Phase 2のgovernance全体化はadrs#540側で扱う。

## 開発継続・偽陽性是正（2026-10-07 JST）

Userは、既存契約で足りる本実装へ追加ADRS/CUE/採択手続を必須化した判断を偽陽性と明示した。現在の偽陽性ポリシー修正、CUE利用などの課題と具体的な是正は [governance#215](https://github.com/roccho-dev/governance/issues/215) に記録する。P/R/Wは実装変更repoのIssue・PRで議論・実装・検証し、未完了時に不必要な中断をしない。追加ADRS#543/#544を本Issueの新しい完了gate又は必須入力にしない。実際のscope・証拠・secret境界は保持する。

{"body":"## Purpose

Detect observed package surfaces from repo reality and compare them with packet package rows. This closes the escape where a package disappears from the packet and therefore avoids final join.

## Post-merge state

After attached PRs merge:
- observed package inventory is generated from repo reality.
- declared packet package rows are compared against observed surfaces.
- missing, duplicate, or undeclared package surfaces can be reported by later findings.

## Completion audit impact

Contributes to:
- `packageAudit`: observed package inventory input.
- `packageInventoryDigest`: observed package set digest.
- `completionCertificate.packageInventoryDigest`.

## Merge blockers

Do not merge child PRs when:
- the detector trusts packet rows as the only source of package truth.
- observed packages can disappear without a finding path.
- the detector is hardcoded to one fixture only.
- the PR claims final gate or branch protection authority.

## Required evidence

- detector source path.
- clean fixture with observed equals declared packages.
- dirty fixture with an observed package absent from declared packet rows.
- CI/check proving detector output is stable.
- PR comment linking this issue and the removed escape.

## Boundary

This issue produces observed inventory evidence only. It does not itself decide final admission."}

## Purpose

Detect observed package surfaces from repo reality and compare them with packet package rows. This closes the escape where a package disappears from the packet and therefore avoids final join.

## Post-merge state

After attached PRs merge:
- observed package inventory is generated from repo reality.
- declared packet package rows are compared against observed surfaces.
- missing, duplicate, or undeclared package surfaces can be reported by later findings.

## Completion audit impact

Contributes to:
- `packageAudit`: observed package inventory input.
- `packageInventoryDigest`: observed package set digest.
- `completionCertificate.packageInventoryDigest`.

## Merge blockers

Do not merge child PRs when:
- the detector trusts packet rows as the only source of package truth.
- observed packages can disappear without a finding path.
- the detector is hardcoded to one fixture only.
- the PR claims final gate or branch protection authority.

## Required evidence

- detector source path.
- clean fixture with observed equals declared packages.
- dirty fixture with an observed package absent from declared packet rows.
- CI/check proving detector output is stable.
- PR comment linking this issue and the removed escape.

## Boundary

This issue produces observed inventory evidence only. It does not itself decide final admission.

state.body:
## Current-state declaration

```text
kind: ui.architecture.current.v1
id: semantic-map-editor-core-current-v2
status: current
lww: true
implementationOwner: roccho-dev/ui
baseCommit: 6622f9887d65ea0c297c4b7c35ee5ef21030a89d
authority: non-authority UI implementation contract
```

本IssueはUIのpurpose、final affected tree、invariants、requirement changesのcanonical ownerである。実装計画・進捗・個別PR記録は#209へ置き、本Issueと二重管理しない。

Current OPS consumer cutover: roccho-dev/ops#377

## Superseded layouts

- 旧本文およびissuecomment-5609549804の4-package treeをcurrent implementation layoutとする記述はsuperseded。
- 直前の`semantic-map-editor-core-current-v1`は責務分離原則を維持するが、本v2の単一`./host` exportとdev-server 404閉包で置換する。
- 4-package案自体は否定しない。採用できるのは旧`semantic-map`・旧runtime・旧exportを同一cutで全退役できるatomic refactorだけ。

## Exact evidence

```text
GitHub base commit: 6622f9887d65ea0c297c4b7c35ee5ef21030a89d
GitHub base tree:   12dad52dec81f69292ae510b25585c01ff5bcdaf
local proof head:   f3e3abdf4c59d43596a22a9bc519af065774a08e
local proof tree:   594a9f29747e797270f8abf571a4a8fe6b2684dd
OPS consumer cutover: roccho-dev/ops#377
```

ローカルproofのkeyboard-centered commands、Active frame cells、selection、Undo/Redo、create/edit/delete/nudge、map/time移動、pointer selection・edge connect/reconnectは維持対象である。ただしローカル`packages/graph-editor`のnpm maxGraph、UndoManager、selection、direct cell mutationはownerとして採用しない。

## One current architecture

```text
apps/artifact-shell
  = one browser/runtime composition root

packages/semantic-map/editor-core
  = renderer-neutral logical editor owner

packages/semantic-map/renderer-maxgraph/MaxGraphAdapter
  = SurfacePort implementation only

packages/semantic-map/domain + projection + protocol
  = semantic mutation/reduce/project implementation used only through editor core

@roccho/ui-publication ./host
  = Node/browser共通のpure host contract

scripts/serve-static.mjs
  = one UI dev server implementation

root `npm run dev`
  = one UI development entry command
```

## Exact editor-core interface

`packages/semantic-map/editor-core/index.js`だけをpublic editor ownerとする。

```text
createSemanticMapEditorCore({
  semantic,
  layout,
  revision,
  ports: {
    surface: SurfacePort,
    document: DocumentPort,
    authority: AuthorityPort
  }
}) -> EditorCore

EditorCore.dispatch(command)
EditorCore.acceptGesture(gesture)
EditorCore.replaceInput(input)
EditorCore.snapshot()
EditorCore.subscribe(listener)
EditorCore.destroy()
```

### SurfacePort

```text
surface.render({ scene, selection, activeFrame, presentation })
surface.onGesture(handler)
surface.destroy()
```

許可gestureは次だけ。

```text
selection.changed
relation.connect
relation.reconnect
camera.changed
activation.requested
```

maxGraph selection modelはcore selectionのmirrorであり、logical ownerではない。maxGraph UndoManagerは使わない。adapterはdomain operationを発行しない。

### DocumentPort

```text
document.requestEdit(request)
document.commit({ expectedRevision, semantic, layout, operations })
document.reload(request)
document.renderChrome(viewModel)
```

### AuthorityPort

```text
authority.authorize({ intent, stateHash })
  -> { allowed, code, reason }
```

Port欠損時はmutation/commitをdenyする。keyboard、component、pointer、artifact module、handoffの全mutationはcore gateを通る。read-only runtimeはadapter handler差替えではなくAuthorityPortでfail closedにする。

## Sole state ownership

| State／decision | One owner |
|---|---|
| logical selection | `EditorCore` |
| active map/time frame | `EditorCore` |
| commands and key binding meaning | `editor-core/commands.js` |
| undo/redo history | core/domain layer exposed only through `EditorCore` |
| mutation normalization/application | core → existing domain operations/store |
| read-only/edit/commit permission | `AuthorityPort` evaluated by core |
| scene projection | existing renderer-neutral `SemanticProjector`, invoked by core |
| physical maxGraph cells/selection | adapter mirror only |
| camera mechanics | adapter, mirrored as presentation telemetry through core |
| accepted business/policy meaning | outside UI |

`artifact-module.js`、`handoff.js`、`review.js`、authoring/runtime、package runtimeから`.adapter`、`.graph`、`.store`の直接read/writeをなくす。composition file `authoring/main.js`だけがPort実装をconstructし、以後はcore APIを渡す。

## Atomic reconnect

```text
ReconnectRelation {
  relationId,
  from,
  to
}
```

1 gestureは1 operation、1 history entry、1 deterministic resultである。delete+connectへ分解しない。

## Formal call graph

```text
artifact-shell/index.html
  -> artifact-shell entry/shell-core
  -> render-semantic-map/engine.mjs
  -> services[ui.package.execute]
  -> packages/semantic-map/runtime.js
  -> authoring/main.js                         # composition only
       -> new MaxGraphAdapter(container)       # SurfacePort
       -> createDocumentPort(...)
       -> createAuthorityPort(...)
       -> createSemanticMapEditorCore(...)

keyboard/component
  -> EditorCore.dispatch
  -> authority.authorize
  -> domain/layout operation
  -> core history/selection/frame state
  -> SemanticProjector.project
  -> surface.render
  -> existing MaxGraphAdapter.render

maxGraph pointer
  -> typed gesture emit
  -> EditorCore.acceptGesture
  -> authority.authorize
  -> ConnectRegions | ReconnectRelation | selection update
  -> project
  -> MaxGraphAdapter.render
```

`packages/semantic-map/runtime.js`は`authoring/pages/embed.html` iframeを作らず、正式artifact-shell surfaceへdirect mountする。

## Canonical semantic/layout split

```text
semantic-map-editor-document/1
├─ semantic: semantic-map-envelope/3
└─ layout: semantic-map-layout/1
```

Semantic ownerはnode/relation IDs、label/kind、relation endpoints、semantic transitions。Layout ownerはcanvas、map/time frame identity/title、frame visibility、subject geometry、edge route/display intent。

旧schema 3を黙って変換しない。同じcell IDのlabel、edge endpoints、meaningがframe間で矛盾する場合は`E_SCHEMA3_SEMANTIC_DRIFT`で停止する。意味が一意なfixtureだけ、semantic union＋frame layoutへ一回変換する。恒久fallbackは残さない。

## One UI publication and one pure host export

UIは1つのcontent-addressed npm archiveだけを生成する。

```text
@roccho/ui-publication
├─ package.json
├─ manifest.json
├─ host/
│  ├─ index.mjs
│  ├─ document-codec.mjs
│  ├─ control-graph.mjs
│  └─ publication-manifest.mjs
└─ public/
   └─ artifact-shell + one maxGraph browser closure
```

`package.json`は`./host`を`host/index.mjs`へexportする。

### `./host` public API

```text
canonicalizeDocument(input) -> canonical UTF-8 text
parseControl(text) -> records
connectControl(records) -> connected control graph
validateControl(text) -> connected control graph
publicationManifest() -> frozen manifest value
```

`./host` closureはDOM、maxGraph、Node built-ins、network、filesystemをimportしない。document canonicalizationとcontrol validationはNode／browserで同じmodule bytesを使う。OPSはartifact-assemblyが生成したrelative shimだけをimportする。

`publication-manifest.mjs`はpublication build時に生成し、tracked sourceにしない。payload manifestは自己参照するmanifest projectionをdigest対象から除外し、最終npm archive SHA-256がarchive全bytesを一意に固定する。

Identity:

```text
source = exact UI commit + tree + dependency lock
payload manifest = sorted path + sha256
archive identity = sha256(npm-tgz bytes)
```

生成物はtemp／CI artifactだけ。tracked runnable generated HTML、generated registry、source bundleをbuild inputにしない。

## One dev/server/runtime path

```text
one command: npm run dev
one server implementation: scripts/serve-static.mjs
one process: build/watch/serve
one served root: fresh temp UI publication
one browser entry: publication index.html
```

### Served-path closure

`serve-static.mjs`はfresh temp publicationのmanifestからexact allowlistを構築し、そのallowlistだけを配信する。

```text
GET /              -> allowlisted /index.html
GET /<allowlisted> -> 200
GET /<anything else> -> 404
```

filesystem fallback、repository-root resolution、source-tree resolutionは禁止する。次は同じserverから要求しても必ず404。

```text
/apps/artifact-shell/index.html
/index.source.html
/packages/semantic-map/authoring/pages/embed.html
/packages/semantic-map/authoring/pages/app.html
/packages/semantic-map/authoring/entry.js
/tests/fixtures/**/index.html
/tests/fixtures/**/*.js
/examples/**/dist/index.html
/packages/**/*.js
/scripts/serve-static.mjs
```

encoded traversal、symlink escape、manifest未記載fileも404。`/index.html`のbody digestはfresh temp publication manifestのentryと一致し、旧root `index.html` bytesとは一致してはならない。

browser testsも`npm run dev -- --port 0 --ready-file ... --mode check`だけを起動し、同じpublication entryを使う。

## Final affected tree

Unlisted existing paths remain unchanged。`K=keep`, `M=modify`, `N=new`, `R=retire after blockers`, `D=do not carry/delete generated source`。

```text
ui/
├─ package.json                                             M
├─ flake.nix                                                M
├─ ci.intent.v1.jsonl                                       M
├─ scripts/serve-static.mjs                                 M
├─ .github/workflows/
│  ├─ a2ui-adapter-artifacts.yml                            M
│  ├─ nix-flake-check.yml                                   M
│  ├─ final-ci-consumer.yml                                 M
│  └─ semantic-map-gesture-review-join.yml                  R
├─ apps/artifact-shell/
│  ├─ index.html                                            K/M formal source template only
│  ├─ src/shell-core.mjs                                    K/M
│  ├─ src/services.mjs                                      M
│  ├─ src/publication.mjs                                   M
│  ├─ src/host/
│  │  ├─ index.mjs                                          N
│  │  └─ control-graph.mjs                                  N/M behavior migrated from local policy-ui
│  ├─ scripts/build-publication.mjs                         M
│  ├─ capabilities/render-semantic-map/{manifest,engine,fixtures} M
│  └─ generated/capability-registry.mjs                     D temp/CI output only
├─ packages/
│  ├─ core-port/**                                          K no graph responsibility
│  ├─ graph-editor/**                                       D local behavior migration only
│  ├─ policy-ui/**                                          D local behavior migration only
│  └─ semantic-map/
│     ├─ editor-core/{index.js,core.js,commands.js,ports.js,workspace-codec.js} N
│     ├─ domain/{domain-store.js,operation.js}               M
│     ├─ protocol/**                                         M
│     ├─ projection/**                                       M
│     ├─ schemas/semantic-map-layout.schema.json             N
│     ├─ renderer-maxgraph/{adapter.js,index.js}             M
│     ├─ renderer-maxgraph/{shapes.js,theme.js}              K
│     ├─ authoring/main.js                                   M composition only
│     ├─ authoring/document-port.js                          N
│     ├─ authoring/{artifact-module.js,handoff.js,review.js,runtime.js} M core API only
│     ├─ authoring/entry.js                                  R
│     ├─ authoring/pages/**                                  R
│     ├─ runtime.js                                          M direct mount
│     ├─ vendor/maxgraph/**                                  K sole maxGraph implementation
│     └─ tests/{editor-core,workspace-codec,adapter-port,reconnect-relation}_test.mjs N
└─ tests/ui-runtime/
   ├─ architecture.mjs                                      N
   ├─ browser.py                                            N
   ├─ mutations.mjs                                         N
   └─ mutations.json                                        N
```

## Deterministic gates

| Gate | Primary failure |
|---|---|
| core is on every formal editor path | `E_CORE_ROUTE_MISSING` |
| core imports no DOM/maxGraph/Node runtime | `E_CORE_RENDERER_IMPORT` |
| adapter owns no selection/history/mutation | `E_ADAPTER_STATE_OWNER` |

relation.connect

  -> surface.render
