state.body:
### Describe the bug

`clang` from `llvmPackages_21` (21.1.8) on `x86_64-linux` emits ELF relocatable objects in which some `STT_SECTION` symbols have `st_shndx = SHN_UNDEF`. Relocations that go through those section symbols then fail to link with lld, which prints the nameless section symbol as an empty undefined symbol:

```
ld.lld: error: undefined symbol: 
>>> referenced by obj.c:208 (aws-lc/crypto/obj/obj.c:208)
>>>               7ac4c9359514b807-obj.o:(aws_lc_0_46_0_OBJ_sn2nid) in archive .../libaws_lc_sys-b474c0aa794f516b.rlib
```

`llvm-readelf -W -s` on the object (`aws-lc/crypto/obj/obj.c` from the `aws-lc-sys` 0.46.0 crate, 53 section symbols, 12 of them undefined, interleaved with the healthy `.text.*`/`.bss.*`/`.rodata.*` ones):

```
    44: 0000000000000000     0 SECTION LOCAL  DEFAULT    29 .text.create_object_with_text_oid
    45: 0000000000000000     0 SECTION LOCAL  DEFAULT   UND <?>
    46: 0000000000000000     0 SECTION LOCAL  DEFAULT    33 .text.aws_lc_0_46_0_OBJ_create
    47: 0000000000000000     0 SECTION LOCAL  DEFAULT    35 .text.obj_next_nid
    48: 0000000000000000     0 SECTION LOCAL  DEFAULT   UND <?>
    ... (45, 48, 51, 54, 57, 60, 63, 66, 69, 72, 76, 79 are UND)
llvm-readelf: warning: unable to get section index for symbol with st_shndx = 0x0 (SHN_UNDEF)
```

403 relocations reference those symbols: 336 from `.rela.debug_info`, 17 `.rela.debug_loc`, 14 `.rela.debug_ranges`, 5 `.rela.eh_frame`, 5 `.rela.debug_line`, and the ones in code that lld trips on, e.g. 10 in `.rela.text.aws_lc_0_46_0_OBJ_create`, 4 in `.rela.text.aws_lc_0_46_0_OBJ_sn2nid`, 4 in `.rela.text.aws_lc_0_46_0_OBJ_ln2nid`:

```
0000000000000028  0000004200000002 R_X86_64_PC32          0000000000000000 <?> - 4
000000000000005e  0000004200000002 R_X86_64_PC32          0000000000000000 <?> - 4
```

The same LLVM 21.1.8 from an earlier nixpkgs-unstable, Debian's clang 21.1.5, gcc 16.2 from the same nixpkgs revision, and the darwin `clang` of the same revision all emit a correct object for the same source and flags. `zig cc` (zig 0.16.0, which links nixpkgs' `libclang`) emits the same defect for `aarch64-linux` (2 of 53 section symbols undefined, 32 relocations against them, `R_AARCH64_ADR_PREL_PG_HI21`/`R_AARCH64_ADD_ABS_LO12_NC` in `OBJ_create`/`OBJ_sn2nid`/`OBJ_obj2nid` and the `.debug_*` sections), so cross builds through zig are affected too.

### Steps To Reproduce

This is the invocation that produced the broken object, captured from the failing build with `CC_ENABLE_DEBUG_OUTPUT=1 cargo build --release -vv` (the `cc` crate compiling AWS-LC for `aws-lc-sys` 0.46.0; `-gdwarf-4 -fno-omit-frame-pointer` come from a Cargo release profile with `debug = "line-tables-only"` and `-Cforce-frame-pointers=yes`), rewritten to run by hand:

```sh
bad=github:NixOS/nixpkgs/8edc0c72e3a38faf5434e40d1f19431125fe4b30
nix shell "$bad#llvmPackages_21.clang" "$bad#llvmPackages_21.llvm"
curl -sL https://static.crates.io/crates/aws-lc-sys/aws-lc-sys-0.46.0.crate | tar xz
d=$PWD/aws-lc-sys-0.46.0
clang -O3 -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -fPIC -gdwarf-4 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -m64 \
  --target=x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu -std=c11 \
  -I"$d/generated-include" -I"$d/include" -I"$d/aws-lc/include" \
  -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -pthread -ffile-prefix-map="$d=" \
  -D_XOPEN_SOURCE=700 -DBORINGSSL_IMPLEMENTATION=1 -DBORINGSSL_PREFIX=aws_lc_0_46_0 \
  -DAWS_LC_STDALIGN_AVAILABLE=1 -DAWS_LC_BUILTIN_SWAP_SUPPORTED=1 -DHAVE_LINUX_RANDOM_H=1 \
  -c "$d/aws-lc/crypto/obj/obj.c" -o obj.o
llvm-readelf -W -s obj.o | grep -c 'SECTION.*UND'
```

On the object the failing CI build produced this is 12 (of 53 section symbols). At the good revision (`b3da656039dc7a6240f27b2ef8cc6a3ef3bccae7` in place of the hash above) the build emits a clean object and the count is 0.

**Caveat: I have not managed to reproduce this standalone, and I only have a GitHub Actions runner to try it on.** In the one attempt I could make at the bad revision, in the same devenv shell the failing build runs in:

- the command above, minus `-D_XOPEN_SOURCE=700` and `-pthread` (my mistake), did not compile (`pthread_rwlock_t` undeclared), so the exact flag set went untested;
- `clang -O3 -fPIC -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -g` (DWARF 5 instead of 4), the same without `-g`, `-O3 -fPIC -g`, and `-O0 -fPIC -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -g` on the same `obj.c` each gave 0 undefined section symbols (of 51, 43, 14 and 66), once each;
- a throwaway `cargo init && cargo add aws-lc-sys@0.46.0 && cargo build --release` (no debug info, so no `-gdwarf-4`) gave 0 of 43 for `obj.o` — and only that one of the crate's objects was checked;
- a 10-line C file with `static` data and a `switch` gave 0 in every variant; gcc 16.2 on `obj.c` gave 0 of 55.

The sibling lld bug (#571232, below) was nondeterministic — a different count on every run — so a single clean compile proves little; the next things to try are the command above in a loop, and checking every `*.o` of a full `cargo build` under a profile with debug info.     45: 0000000000000000     0 SECTION LOCAL  DEFAULT   UND <?>

    47: 0000000000000000     0 SECTION LOCAL  DEFAULT    35 .text.obj_next_nid
    48: 0000000000000000     0 SECTION LOCAL  DEFAULT   UND <?>

  --target=x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu -std=c11 \
  -I"$d/generated-include" -I"$d/include" -I"$d/aws-lc/include" \
  -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -pthread -ffile-prefix-map="$d=" \
  -D_XOPEN_SOURCE=700 -DBORINGSSL_IMPLEMENTATION=1 -DBORINGSSL_PREFIX=aws_lc_0_46_0 \
  -DAWS_LC_STDALIGN_AVAILABLE=1 -DAWS_LC_BUILTIN_SWAP_SUPPORTED=1 -DHAVE_LINUX_RANDOM_H=1 \

Decide whether it contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract: a rule, expected or acceptable condition, responsibility, functional capability, input/output mapping, interface purpose, or condition or limitation of use. A stated expected-outcome caption or interface text declaring an action's purpose can qualify. No formal specification label, generality, adoption, implementation, must-word or future tense is required. Distinguish the role of the relationship being stated. Declaring what a function does or what condition applies counts; merely describing what happened, is happening, used to happen or regularly happens in observed execution does not by itself declare a specification. A performed configuration, measured value, comparison or causal explanation does not supply an unstated applicable contract. These are role distinctions, not rules excluding particular headings, formats, tenses or words: a report may also contain a genuine specification, and an ordinary capability statement can declare one without requesting a change. Read each statement in context; one qualifying declaration anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when used to declare the specification, but not when displayed only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'This dial sets the sampling interval' declares a function; 'I turned the dial and the reading changed' alone reports an observation. A request or a subject's goal alone does not establish this specification role. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. It declares the relationship itself; merely reporting a performed action, observed configuration or value, observed result, or a causal explanation of an observed event does not by itself establish that role. A genuine declaration still counts inside a report, quotation or template when the body uses it to declare that relationship.
options.no: The complete body contains no statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; observations elsewhere do not cancel a genuine declaration.

request.instruction: Read only the complete literal body, including HTML comments, tables, formulas and templates. Decide whether it contains at least one genuine request for an action, answer, submission, improvement or remedy, or explicitly presents an action or state as a subject's intended goal or need. Count indirect requests and actual conditional reporting or submission directions, including directions carried by a template or HTML comment whether or not the requested information has been supplied. No addressee, stated reason, fully identified final goal, solution, adoption or implementation is required. Distinguish a relationship presented as a target or request from wording that only locates the circumstances of a reported event or explains a necessary response to it. An incident, inability, missing feature, risk, complaint, category or recipient mention alone does not declare the desired opposite or request its correction. Merely explaining what was necessary to obtain an observed result or work around it does not by itself declare an intended goal. Do not exclude a genuine goal or request merely because it appears within a report or a subordinate clause; do not infer one solely from modality, tense, a heading, mention, imperative form or question mark. A specification or expected caption alone does not establish this request or subject-goal role. One qualifying statement anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when the body uses it to make an actual request or goal declaration, but not when shown only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'I need a cost estimate before ordering the materials' declares a goal or need; 'The estimate arrived late, so I postponed the order' alone reports an event and response. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. This includes actual reporting or submission directions before the requested information is supplied. Merely naming a category or recipient, reporting an incident or inability, or explaining a necessary workaround does not itself establish this role.
options.no: The complete body contains no genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; a report or subordinate clause does not cancel an actual request or goal.

<!-- Please search existing issues to avoid creating duplicates -->
<!-- Please attach logs to help us diagnose your issue -->

- Copilot Chat Extension Version: n/a, Agent Host with the Copilot provider (bundled `@github/copilot-win32-x64` 1.0.84-4)
- VS Code Version: 1.138.0 (7debcd0e2acdea1c52de81bf9ee1620444407dda)
- OS Version: Windows 11 (10.0.26200)
- Feature (e.g. agent/edit/ask mode): Agent Host chat, `create_session` tool (`relationship: "currentSession"`)
- Selected model (e.g. GPT 4.1, Claude 3.7 Sonnet): Claude Opus 5.5, reasoning effort xhigh, 1M context (`long_context`)
- Logs: `session.start` events from `~/.copilot/session-state/<id>/events.jsonl`, quoted below

An agent that works through a list of tasks by starting one chat per task with `create_session` can choose each chat's model, but not its reasoning effort or context tier. The agent host already supports both per chat: `_createSession` reads them from `model.config.thinkingLevel` and `model.config.contextTier`, and users can set them in the model picker. The tool doesn't expose either.

Passing `model` also loses the caller's reasoning effort:

- Without `model`, `create_session` uses `getCreationDefaults(chat).model`, the calling chat's whole model selection, so the new chat gets the caller's effort and tier.
- With `model`, it sends only `{ id: model.id }`, so the new chat starts with no reasoning effort, which means the model's default.

`create_chat` goes through the same code, and `independent` sessions are also created with `model: { id }` only.

Steps to Reproduce:

1. In an Agent Host chat, select Claude Opus 5.5 with reasoning effort xhigh and the 1M context.
2. Have the agent call `create_session` with `relationship: "currentSession"` and no `model`. The new chat's `session.start` has `"selectedModel":"claude-opus-5.5","reasoningEffort":"xhigh","contextTier":"long_context"`.
3. Have it call `create_session` again with `model: "claude-opus-5.5"`. The new chat's `session.start` has `"selectedModel":"claude-opus-5.5","contextTier":"long_context"` and no `reasoningEffort`.

Expected: a way to set the reasoning effort and context tier of each new chat, and passing `model` shouldn't silently reset the effort.

Suggestion: optional `reasoningEffort` and `contextTier` inputs on `create_session` and `create_chat`, validated against the chosen model the way the model picker does. When they're omitted, keep the caller's values if the chosen model supports them.

- Cloud automations are only supported in private repositories for now.

- Turn on `chat.automations.cloud.enabled`.
- Use a private GitHub repository where you can safely create and run automations.

- Follow the run from the Automations view and open it in VS Code.
- Continue the conversation with a follow-up request.
- On GitHub, open the same automation run and send another message in that chat.

Explore moving between both surfaces. Verify that VS Code stays updated with messages and status changes made on GitHub, opens the correct run, and lets you continue the same conversation.

## Part 2: Create a cloud automation through AI chat

- Start a new AI chat and ask it to create a cloud automation for the private repository.
- Describe the automation naturally and let the AI ask for any missing details.

"}

<!-- Please search existing issues to avoid creating duplicates -->
<!-- Please attach logs to help us diagnose your issue -->

- Copilot Chat Extension Version: Not recorded; reproduced with the Copilot SDK agent-host experience.
- VS Code Version: Insiders; source investigation and fix based on main at 341e0fa9346520e7a6a09803a80c5ecd3027f3cb (1.143.0 development sources).
- OS Version: Windows (exact OS build not recorded).
- Feature (e.g. agent/edit/ask mode): Agent-host chat with filesystem sandboxing enabled.
- Selected model (e.g. GPT 4.1, Claude 3.7 Sonnet): Reproduced with gpt-6-astra; the failure is in confirmation UI handling.
- Logs: Relevant runtime excerpts, with request identities omitted:

```text
Read confirmation: approved=true, selectedOptionId=save-sandbox-path
Write confirmation: approved=true, selectedOptionId=undefined
Rejecting invalid sandbox path grant response
Permission response: result=reject
```

Steps to Reproduce:

1. Enable agent sandboxing and choose a directory outside the sandbox's writable paths.
2. Ask the agent to create a text file in that directory, for example a file in Downloads, with simple text content.
3. When the pending file-edit preview asks to add the path to user sandbox settings and retry, click Allow.
4. Compare with approving a read-access request: the read approval saves its sandbox setting successfully.

### Expected

The explicit Allow choice saves the offered read/write grant to user sandbox settings and grants access for the pending SDK request, allowing the write to proceed inside the sandbox.

### Actual

The write is rejected with `Permission denied by host policy`. The read/write settings update is not reached. The completion event contains `result.kind: denied-interactively-by-user` and `decisionSource: host_policy`, despite the user approving the prompt.

### Root cause

The edit-preview path in `stateToProgressAdapter.ts` supplies legacy `options: ['Allow']` to `ChatModifiedFilesConfirmationSubPart`. That component builds its buttons from these labels rather than `confirmationMessages.customOptions`, returning `selectedButton: 'Allow'` instead of the protocol ID `save-sandbox-path`.

`AgentHostSessionHandler` resolves the choice by option ID. The label does not match, so `selectedOptionId` is undefined and the settings-save branch is skipped. `CopilotAgentSession.respondToPermissionRequest` then correctly rejects an approval that did not explicitly select the sandbox-path grant action.

Read confirmations use the shared custom-option renderer and preserve the option ID. The write UI should do the same, retaining approval/denial IDs and kinds without weakening host sandbox validation.

{"body":"
Summary

VS Code's context management for custom OpenAI-compatible models is currently very poor in long-running conversations, especially when multiple MCP servers, tools, and extensions are enabled.

I am using a DeepSeek V4.1 Flash model through the OpenCode inference endpoint, configured through my model/provider setup. The model is declared in VS Code with the appropriate context-window, input-token, and output-token settings for the intended 1,000,000-token context configuration.

A fresh conversation initially works correctly. However, after using the model for some time, requests start failing with HTTP 400 "context_length_exceeded". This occurs even though the model's context-related fields are explicitly configured and the problem did not occur before I added several additional MCP servers and extensions.

Importantly, I can reproduce this with the Local Harness, so this does not appear to be limited to the Copilot Agent Host.

The current experience is extremely frustrating. VS Code's context budgeting, tool handling, and overflow prevention are not reliable enough for serious long-context agent workflows. The application should manage the context it constructs, account for its own instructions and registered tools, and avoid sending requests that exceed the effective context limit of the selected endpoint.

Environment

- VS Code: Latest Stable release at the time of reporting
- Harness: Local
- Model: "opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free"
- API endpoint observed in the error: "https://opencode.ai/inference/v1/chat/completions"
- API format: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions
- Model configuration: Explicit context-window, input-token, and output-token limits
- Integrations: Multiple MCP servers and extensions, including official/maintained integrations using the supported VS Code and MCP interfaces

I did not introduce custom prompt-building code or deliberately use non-standard MCP implementations to reproduce this issue.

Actual error

The request fails after approximately 25 seconds with this response:

HTTP 400
code: context_length_exceeded
type: invalid_request_error

Your request resulted in more tokens than this model's maximum context length allows.
Please reduce the length of the messages or run compaction.

The endpoint rejects the request, but the response does not identify the effective context limit, the estimated size of the submitted prompt, or which part of the constructed request caused the overflow.

Steps to reproduce

1. Configure an OpenAI-compatible custom model in VS Code with explicit context-window and input/output token limits.
2. Select the model in the Local Harness.
3. Start a new conversation and confirm that ordinary requests work.
4. Enable several additional MCP servers and extensions that contribute tools or instructions.
5. Continue working in the same conversation, allowing its message history and tool results to accumulate.
6. Eventually, requests fail with HTTP 400 "context_length_exceeded".
7. Start a fresh conversation. It works again temporarily, but the failure returns after the conversation grows.

This suggests that the issue is associated with accumulated context and the aggregate payload assembled for requests, rather than an immediate authentication or basic connectivity failure.

Previously, the same setup worked before I introduced the additional MCP servers and extensions.

Expected behavior

VS Code should reliably manage context for custom models and long-running agent sessions.

Specifically:

- Respect configured model capabilities and distinguish the total context window from the separate input and output limits.

4. "#323266 — Add on/off toggles for MCP servers, tools, agents, skills, instructions, and plugins" (https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/323266)
   Describes context bloat caused by extensions and other customizations contributing tools and instructions, with insufficient granular control.

5. "#323758 — Agent tools picker restores default tools after deselection, causing unwanted tool payloads" (https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues/323758)
   Documents a regression in which deselected tools remained in the actual request, increasing the payload unexpectedly.

These issues indicate that model-limit propagation, tool registration, context budgeting, and overflow handling have all caused problems in related VS Code workflows. The current report adds a reproduction involving the Local Harness, a long-running BYOK conversation, additional official/maintained MCP integrations, and an actual "context_length_exceeded" response from the endpoint.

Requested action

Please investigate the Local Harness request-construction and context-management pipeline for custom OpenAI-compatible models.

The objective is not to force a model to accept more tokens than its endpoint supports. It is to ensure that VS Code correctly uses the available model metadata, accounts for all content it adds to requests, compacts or reduces context when necessary, and clearly explains any effective context-limit mismatch.

Long-context and tool-enabled agent workflows should not require users to manually reduce configured capacities or repeatedly restart conversations to work around unreliable context management.

ytnef through 2.1.2 Heap Out-of-Bounds Read via DecompressRTF ytnef through 2.1.2 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in DecompressRTF() in lib/ytnef.c that never validates uncompressedSize for uncompressed RTF streams. Attackers can supply a crafted winmail.dat TNEF attachment with a malicious PT_BINARY MAPI property to crash ytnefprint or libytnef callers and leak adjacent heap memory.

本問はEだけ：本文が実現すべき状態を一つでも宣言しているか。完成状態の表・責務・式も宣言である。Goal等の見出しだけでYesにしない。本文にそのような期待がなければNo。実施済みと書いてあるだけなら期待ではない。

Decide whether it contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract: a rule, expected or acceptable condition, responsibility, functional capability, input/output mapping, interface purpose, or condition or limitation of use. A stated expected-outcome caption or interface text declaring an action's purpose can qualify. No formal specification label, generality, adoption, implementation, must-word or future tense is required. Distinguish the role of the relationship being stated. Declaring what a function does or what condition applies counts; merely describing what happened, is happening, used to happen or regularly happens in observed execution does not by itself declare a specification. A performed configuration, measured value, comparison or causal explanation does not supply an unstated applicable contract. These are role distinctions, not rules excluding particular headings, formats, tenses or words: a report may also contain a genuine specification, and an ordinary capability statement can declare one without requesting a change. Read each statement in context; one qualifying declaration anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when used to declare the specification, but not when displayed only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'This dial sets the sampling interval' declares a function; 'I turned the dial and the reading changed' alone reports an observation. A request or a subject's goal alone does not establish this specification role. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. It declares the relationship itself; merely reporting a performed action, observed configuration or value, observed result, or a causal explanation of an observed event does not by itself establish that role. A genuine declaration still counts inside a report, quotation or template when the body uses it to declare that relationship.
options.no: The complete body contains no statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; observations elsewhere do not cancel a genuine declaration.

request.instruction: Read only the complete literal body, including HTML comments, tables, formulas and templates. Decide whether it contains at least one genuine request for an action, answer, submission, improvement or remedy, or explicitly presents an action or state as a subject's intended goal or need. Count indirect requests and actual conditional reporting or submission directions, including directions carried by a template or HTML comment whether or not the requested information has been supplied. No addressee, stated reason, fully identified final goal, solution, adoption or implementation is required. Distinguish a relationship presented as a target or request from wording that only locates the circumstances of a reported event or explains a necessary response to it. An incident, inability, missing feature, risk, complaint, category or recipient mention alone does not declare the desired opposite or request its correction. Merely explaining what was necessary to obtain an observed result or work around it does not by itself declare an intended goal. Do not exclude a genuine goal or request merely because it appears within a report or a subordinate clause; do not infer one solely from modality, tense, a heading, mention, imperative form or question mark. A specification or expected caption alone does not establish this request or subject-goal role. One qualifying statement anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when the body uses it to make an actual request or goal declaration, but not when shown only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'I need a cost estimate before ordering the materials' declares a goal or need; 'The estimate arrived late, so I postponed the order' alone reports an event and response. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. This includes actual reporting or submission directions before the requested information is supplied. Merely naming a category or recipient, reporting an incident or inability, or explaining a necessary workaround does not itself establish this role.
options.no: The complete body contains no genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; a report or subordinate clause does not cancel an actual request or goal.

Prior to 0.145.0, openapi3filter.ValidationHandler uses the routers/legacy router, which passes an unsupported or non-canonical HTTP method for an existing static path to openapi3.PathItem.GetOperation. specification.instruction: Read only the complete literal body, including HTML comments, tables, formulas and templates. Decide whether it contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract: a rule, expected or acceptable condition, responsibility, functional capability, input/output mapping, interface purpose, or condition or limitation of use. A stated expected-outcome caption or interface text declaring an action's purpose can qualify. No formal specification label, generality, adoption, implementation, must-word or future tense is required. Distinguish the role of the relationship being stated. Declaring what a function does or what condition applies counts; merely describing what happened, is happening, used to happen or regularly happens in observed execution does not by itself declare a specification. A performed configuration, measured value, comparison or causal explanation does not supply an unstated applicable contract. These are role distinctions, not rules excluding particular headings, formats, tenses or words: a report may also contain a genuine specification, and an ordinary capability statement can declare one without requesting a change. Read each statement in context; one qualifying declaration anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when used to declare the specification, but not when displayed only as an illustration. ZoneMinder failed token handling bypasses web authentication ZoneMinder is a free, open source closed-circuit television software application. In versions 1.34.0 through 1.36.38, the web interface mishandles failed token authentication in web/includes/auth.php. validateToken() returns false when a token is malformed or has an invalid signature, but the caller assigns that value to the global $user variable; because web/index.php tests isset($user), boolean false is treated as a present user and the normal login redirect is skipped. This can dispatch views that rely on the outer authentication gate, including the zones view, which accepts an attacker-selected monitor ID and discloses monitor and zone metadata without an independent permission check. Permission helpers receive the false user value and deny privileged operations, so unauthorized state changes have not been established. This vulnerability is fixed in version 1.36.63, where conversion to ZM\User objects causes invalid token state to fail before view dispatch. Later defense-in-depth changes explicitly leave $user unset after failed token validation and reject non-ZM\User values at the web authentication gate.
### References - [https://github.com/ZoneMinder/zoneminder/security/advisories/GHSA-23fj-frfw-hmcr](https://github.com/ZoneMinder/zoneminder/security/advisories/GHSA-23fj-frfw-hmcr) (`x_refsource_CONFIRM`) - Decide whether it contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract: a rule, expected or acceptable condition, responsibility, functional capability, input/output mapping, interface purpose, or condition or limitation of use. A stated expected-outcome caption or interface text declaring an action's purpose can qualify. No formal specification label, generality, adoption, implementation, must-word or future tense is required. Distinguish the role of the relationship being stated. Declaring what a function does or what condition applies counts; merely describing what happened, is happening, used to happen or regularly happens in observed execution does not by itself declare a specification. A performed configuration, measured value, comparison or causal explanation does not supply an unstated applicable contract. These are role distinctions, not rules excluding particular headings, formats, tenses or words: a report may also contain a genuine specification, and an ordinary capability statement can declare one without requesting a change. Read each statement in context; one qualifying declaration anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when used to declare the specification, but not when displayed only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'This dial sets the sampling interval' declares a function; 'I turned the dial and the reading changed' alone reports an observation. A request or a subject's goal alone does not establish this specification role. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. It declares the relationship itself; merely reporting a performed action, observed configuration or value, observed result, or a causal explanation of an observed event does not by itself establish that role. A genuine declaration still counts inside a report, quotation or template when the body uses it to declare that relationship.
options.no: The complete body contains no statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; observations elsewhere do not cancel a genuine declaration.

request.instruction: Read only the complete literal body, including HTML comments, tables, formulas and templates. Decide whether it contains at least one genuine request for an action, answer, submission, improvement or remedy, or explicitly presents an action or state as a subject's intended goal or need. Count indirect requests and actual conditional reporting or submission directions, including directions carried by a template or HTML comment whether or not the requested information has been supplied. No addressee, stated reason, fully identified final goal, solution, adoption or implementation is required. Distinguish a relationship presented as a target or request from wording that only locates the circumstances of a reported event or explains a necessary response to it. An incident, inability, missing feature, risk, complaint, category or recipient mention alone does not declare the desired opposite or request its correction. Merely explaining what was necessary to obtain an observed result or work around it does not by itself declare an intended goal. Do not exclude a genuine goal or request merely because it appears within a report or a subordinate clause; do not infer one solely from modality, tense, a heading, mention, imperative form or question mark. A specification or expected caption alone does not establish this request or subject-goal role. One qualifying statement anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when the body uses it to make an actual request or goal declaration, but not when shown only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'I need a cost estimate before ordering the materials' declares a goal or need; 'The estimate arrived late, so I postponed the order' alone reports an event and response. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. This includes actual reporting or submission directions before the requested information is supplied. Merely naming a category or recipient, reporting an incident or inability, or explaining a necessary workaround does not itself establish this role.
options.no: The complete body contains no genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; a report or subordinate clause does not cancel an actual request or goal.

SoX through 14.4.2 Heap Out-of-Bounds Write via MS ADPCM WAV Decoding SoX through 14.4.2 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in lsx_ms_adpcm_block_expand_i() in src/adpcm.c, triggered by an odd samplesPerBlock value in the WAV fmt chunk. Attackers can supply a crafted MS ADPCM WAV file to sox or any libsox consumer to write a partially controlled 16-bit sample past the heap buffer allocated by wav_ms_adpcm_fmt().

body内の各文を、望ましい状態の宣言と、実際に起きたことの報告に分けて読んでください。EとOは同時にyesでも構いません。Eは文書の主題や多数決ではなく存在判定です。具体的な要求文・完成条件・目標文が一文でもあれば、残りが全部作業報告でもE=yesです。例えば「利用者に完了を通知すること」は期待ですが、「利用者に通知した」は実施報告であり期待ではありません。Goal・Acceptanceという見出しそのものは期待文ではなく、その下に過去の実施報告しかなければE=noです。表・数式・役割が完成状態の対応を定義する場合も期待です。Oでは実測の引用・確認状況一覧・本文内HTMLコメントの作業メモも数えますが、架空の試験入力・条件付きの例は数えません。許容を表す「〜でもよい」や仮定・可能性だけを述べる文は、現状の報告ではありません。例えば「点検は後日でもよい」は許容条件ですが、「点検はまだしていない」は現在の状態の報告です。O=yesにするには、本文が現実にそうだと主張している箇所が必要です。与えられたbody全体だけを対象に判断し、そこにない現状を推測しないでください。
本問はEだけ：本文が実現すべき状態を一つでも宣言しているか。完成状態の表・責務・式も宣言である。Goal等の見出しだけでYesにしない。本文にそのような期待がなければNo。実施済みと書いてあるだけなら期待ではない。

NetSurf libnsbmp through 0.1.7 Out-of-Bounds Read via bmp_decode_mask NetSurf libnsbmp through 0.1.7 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in bmp_decode_mask() that allows attackers to read one byte past the image buffer by supplying crafted ICO files. FluidSynth through 2.6.1 Out-of-Bounds Write via SoundFont Modulator Destination FluidSynth through 2.6.1 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that allows attackers to corrupt heap and stack memory by supplying unvalidated SoundFont modulator destination values. Attackers can craft an SF2 file with PMOD/IMOD destinations of 63 to 255 that, when loaded and played, write past the voice generator array and updated_gen_bit, causing memory corruption and crashes.

tinytag: Infinite loop when parsing certain M4A files containing invalid atoms tinytag is a Python library for reading audio file metadata. From 2.0.0 until 2.3.0, an M4A file containing a sub-atom with a size of zero inside a ---- atom can cause the metadata parser to stop advancing through the input. The custom-field atom traversal repeatedly processes the malformed location, causing an infinite loop and denying service to a program that reads the crafted file. This issue is fixed in version 2.3.0.

tinytag: Infinite loop when parsing certain M4A files containing invalid atoms tinytag is a Python library for reading audio file metadata. From 2.0.0 until 2.3.0, an M4A file containing a sub-atom with a size of zero inside a ---- atom can cause the metadata parser to stop advancing through the input. The custom-field atom traversal repeatedly processes the malformed location, causing an infinite loop and denying service to a program that reads the crafted file. This issue is fixed in version 2.3.0.

A specification or expected caption alone does not establish this request or subject-goal role. One qualifying statement anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when the body uses it to make an actual request or goal declaration, but not when shown only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'I need a cost estimate before ordering the materials' declares a goal or need; 'The estimate arrived late, so I postponed the order' alone reports an event and response. Decide whether it contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract: a rule, expected or acceptable condition, responsibility, functional capability, input/output mapping, interface purpose, or condition or limitation of use. A stated expected-outcome caption or interface text declaring an action's purpose can qualify. No formal specification label, generality, adoption, implementation, must-word or future tense is required. Distinguish the role of the relationship being stated. Declaring what a function does or what condition applies counts; merely describing what happened, is happening, used to happen or regularly happens in observed execution does not by itself declare a specification. A performed configuration, measured value, comparison or causal explanation does not supply an unstated applicable contract. These are role distinctions, not rules excluding particular headings, formats, tenses or words: a report may also contain a genuine specification, and an ordinary capability statement can declare one without requesting a change. Read each statement in context; one qualifying declaration anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when used to declare the specification, but not when displayed only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'This dial sets the sampling interval' declares a function; 'I turned the dial and the reading changed' alone reports an observation. A request or a subject's goal alone does not establish this specification role. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. It declares the relationship itself; merely reporting a performed action, observed configuration or value, observed result, or a causal explanation of an observed event does not by itself establish that role. A genuine declaration still counts inside a report, quotation or template when the body uses it to declare that relationship.
options.no: The complete body contains no statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; observations elsewhere do not cancel a genuine declaration.

request.instruction: Read only the complete literal body, including HTML comments, tables, formulas and templates. Decide whether it contains at least one genuine request for an action, answer, submission, improvement or remedy, or explicitly presents an action or state as a subject's intended goal or need. Count indirect requests and actual conditional reporting or submission directions, including directions carried by a template or HTML comment whether or not the requested information has been supplied. No addressee, stated reason, fully identified final goal, solution, adoption or implementation is required. Distinguish a relationship presented as a target or request from wording that only locates the circumstances of a reported event or explains a necessary response to it. An incident, inability, missing feature, risk, complaint, category or recipient mention alone does not declare the desired opposite or request its correction. Merely explaining what was necessary to obtain an observed result or work around it does not by itself declare an intended goal. Do not exclude a genuine goal or request merely because it appears within a report or a subordinate clause; do not infer one solely from modality, tense, a heading, mention, imperative form or question mark. A specification or expected caption alone does not establish this request or subject-goal role. One qualifying statement anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when the body uses it to make an actual request or goal declaration, but not when shown only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'I need a cost estimate before ordering the materials' declares a goal or need; 'The estimate arrived late, so I postponed the order' alone reports an event and response. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. This includes actual reporting or submission directions before the requested information is supplied. Merely naming a category or recipient, reporting an incident or inability, or explaining a necessary workaround does not itself establish this role.
options.no: The complete body contains no genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; a report or subordinate clause does not cancel an actual request or goal.

LibRaw through 0.22.2 Heap Out-of-Bounds Read via parseNikonMakernote ShotInfo LibRaw through 0.22.2 contains a heap-based out-of-bounds read in LibRaw::parseNikonMakernote() that allows attackers to read past a short ShotInfo buffer. Declaring what a function does or what condition applies counts; merely describing what happened, is happening, used to happen or regularly happens in observed execution does not by itself declare a specification. Merely explaining what was necessary to obtain an observed result or work around it does not by itself declare an intended goal. Do not exclude a genuine goal or request merely because it appears within a report or a subordinate clause; do not infer one solely from modality, tense, a heading, mention, imperative form or question mark. A specification or expected caption alone does not establish this request or subject-goal role. One qualifying statement anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. This includes actual reporting or submission directions before the requested information is supplied. Merely naming a category or recipient, reporting an incident or inability, or explaining a necessary workaround does not itself establish this role.
options.no: The complete body contains no genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; a report or subordinate clause does not cancel an actual request or goal.

Testing #342409

Run the command `MCP: Open User Configuration`, it opens the legacy location (VS Code user data)

It should instead open a quick pick with all valid user locations for that harness.
- It should make the legacy location as 'legacy'
- It should have the recommended option first
- It should also show non existing files, marked as 'not existing' and offer to create them when selected
- it should have an option 'Open MCP customizations' entry or header action that opens the MCP page

It would be nice if the command is also mentioned or available in the chat customization dialog.

Nautilus: nautilus: arbitrary file deletion via trash symlink A flaw was found in Nautilus. When a removable drive or disk image is unmounted or ejected, Nautilus prompts the user to empty the trash without verifying whether the trash directory paths are symbolic links. An attacker can exploit this flaw by tricking a user into mounting a crafted storage volume and confirming the prompt to empty the trash, leading to the arbitrary deletion of files accessible to that user.
### References - https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/CVE-2026-111802 (`x_refsource_REDHAT`, `vdb-entry`) - [RHBZ#2554410](https://bugzilla.redhat.com/show_bug.cgi?id=2554410) (`x_refsource_REDHAT`, `issue-tracking`) - https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/nautilus/-/merge_requests/2179 ## Affected packages - `nautilus` ([pull requests](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pulls?q=sort%3Aupdated-desc+is%3Apr+nautilus+in%3Atitle+-%3E+in%3Atitle)) - 50.2.2@master - 49.4@release-25.11 - 50.3.1@release-26.05 ## Affected package maintainers @jtojnar, @bobby285271, @thunze, @nekowinston, @theCapypara # Next steps - Start here if this is your first security issue: [Triaging and fixing security issues](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/pkgs/README.md#triaging-and-fixing) - Backports are usually needed: [Backporting security fixes](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#how-to-backport-pull-requests)

ssldump Heap Buffer Overflow in FAN/1 X.509 Fingerprint Formatting The fanx_fingerprint function in ssl/sslxprint.c of ssldump allocates a heap buffer for formatting FAN/1 X.509 certificate fingerprints. The allocation size is computed as strlen(b64) + strlen(hex) + 31, but the format string "fan1:x509:server:passive:%s:sha256:%s" contains 33 fixed characters in addition to the two variable-length fields and a null terminator, requiring strlen(b64) + strlen(hex) + 34 bytes. This miscalculation results in a 3-byte heap-based buffer overflow on every invocation of the function with valid inputs. The overflow occurs because sprintf writes the full formatted string into the undersized heap buffer without bounds checking. An attacker who can supply a crafted pcap file containing a TLS X.509 certificate to a user running ssldump with FAN/1 fingerprinting enabled (for example with the -j -N options) can trigger the overflow. The resulting heap corruption may lead to denial of service through a crash or, in a worst-case scenario, arbitrary code execution in the context of the user running ssldump. [Nixpkgs security tracker issue](https://tracker.security.nixos.org/issues/NIXPKGS-2026-3096) ## [CVE-2026-110752](https://tracker.security.nixos.org/suggestions/by-id/56260) ([NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-110752))
Text::CSV_XS versions before 1.65 for Perl allow memory exhaustion by allocating one entry per index of an RFC 7111 selector in fragment Text::CSV_XS versions before 1.65 for Perl allow memory exhaustion by allocating one entry per index of an RFC 7111 selector in fragment. fragment expands a row= or col= selector into an array with one element per selected index before it reads any data, and it does not clamp an explicit end column in a cell= selector to the row. Only the syntax and order of the ranges are checked, so row=1-400000000 on a two-line file allocates 400 million elements. Gitify before 7.10.0 Login CSRF via Missing OAuth State Validation Gitify before 7.10.0 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows remote attackers to bind a victim's client to their account because performGitHubWebOAuth() omits OAuth state validation. libspatialite through 5.1.0 Integer Overflow in WKB Geometry Parsing libspatialite through 5.1.0 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in the WKB point and vertex count size guard of ParseWkbLine and related parsers in gg_wkb.c, allowing out-of-bounds reads. specification.instruction: Read only the complete literal body, including HTML comments, tables, formulas and templates. Decide whether it contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract: a rule, expected or acceptable condition, responsibility, functional capability, input/output mapping, interface purpose, or condition or limitation of use. A stated expected-outcome caption or interface text declaring an action's purpose can qualify. No formal specification label, generality, adoption, implementation, must-word or future tense is required. Distinguish the role of the relationship being stated. Declaring what a function does or what condition applies counts; merely describing what happened, is happening, used to happen or regularly happens in observed execution does not by itself declare a specification. A performed configuration, measured value, comparison or causal explanation does not supply an unstated applicable contract. These are role distinctions, not rules excluding particular headings, formats, tenses or words: a report may also contain a genuine specification, and an ordinary capability statement can declare one without requesting a change. Read each statement in context; one qualifying declaration anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when used to declare the specification, but not when displayed only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'This dial sets the sampling interval' declares a function; 'I turned the dial and the reading changed' alone reports an observation. A request or a subject's goal alone does not establish this specification role. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. It declares the relationship itself; merely reporting a performed action, observed configuration or value, observed result, or a causal explanation of an observed event does not by itself establish that role. A genuine declaration still counts inside a report, quotation or template when the body uses it to declare that relationship.
options.no: The complete body contains no statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; observations elsewhere do not cancel a genuine declaration.

request.instruction: Read only the complete literal body, including HTML comments, tables, formulas and templates. Decide whether it contains at least one genuine request for an action, answer, submission, improvement or remedy, or explicitly presents an action or state as a subject's intended goal or need. Count indirect requests and actual conditional reporting or submission directions, including directions carried by a template or HTML comment whether or not the requested information has been supplied. No addressee, stated reason, fully identified final goal, solution, adoption or implementation is required. Distinguish a relationship presented as a target or request from wording that only locates the circumstances of a reported event or explains a necessary response to it. An incident, inability, missing feature, risk, complaint, category or recipient mention alone does not declare the desired opposite or request its correction. Merely explaining what was necessary to obtain an observed result or work around it does not by itself declare an intended goal. Do not exclude a genuine goal or request merely because it appears within a report or a subordinate clause; do not infer one solely from modality, tense, a heading, mention, imperative form or question mark. A specification or expected caption alone does not establish this request or subject-goal role. One qualifying statement anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when the body uses it to make an actual request or goal declaration, but not when shown only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'I need a cost estimate before ordering the materials' declares a goal or need; 'The estimate arrived late, so I postponed the order' alone reports an event and response. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. This includes actual reporting or submission directions before the requested information is supplied. Merely naming a category or recipient, reporting an incident or inability, or explaining a necessary workaround does not itself establish this role.
options.no: The complete body contains no genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; a report or subordinate clause does not cancel an actual request or goal.

request.instruction: Read only the complete literal body, including HTML comments, tables, formulas and templates. Decide whether it contains at least one genuine request for an action, answer, submission, improvement or remedy, or explicitly presents an action or state as a subject's intended goal or need. Count indirect requests and actual conditional reporting or submission directions, including directions carried by a template or HTML comment whether or not the requested information has been supplied. No addressee, stated reason, fully identified final goal, solution, adoption or implementation is required. Distinguish a relationship presented as a target or request from wording that only locates the circumstances of a reported event or explains a necessary response to it. An incident, inability, missing feature, risk, complaint, category or recipient mention alone does not declare the desired opposite or request its correction. Merely explaining what was necessary to obtain an observed result or work around it does not by itself declare an intended goal. Do not exclude a genuine goal or request merely because it appears within a report or a subordinate clause; do not infer one solely from modality, tense, a heading, mention, imperative form or question mark. A specification or expected caption alone does not establish this request or subject-goal role. One qualifying statement anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when the body uses it to make an actual request or goal declaration, but not when shown only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'I need a cost estimate before ordering the materials' declares a goal or need; 'The estimate arrived late, so I postponed the order' alone reports an event and response. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. This includes actual reporting or submission directions before the requested information is supplied. Merely naming a category or recipient, reporting an incident or inability, or explaining a necessary workaround does not itself establish this role.
options.no: The complete body contains no genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; a report or subordinate clause does not cancel an actual request or goal.

request.instructions:
body内の各文を、望ましい状態の宣言と、実際に起きたことの報告に分けて読んでください。EとOは同時にyesでも構いません。Eは文書の主題や多数決ではなく存在判定です。具体的な要求文・完成条件・目標文が一文でもあれば、残りが全部作業報告でもE=yesです。例えば「利用者に完了を通知すること」は期待ですが、「利用者に通知した」は実施報告であり期待ではありません。Goal・Acceptanceという見出しそのものは期待文ではなく、その下に過去の実施報告しかなければE=noです。表・数式・役割が完成状態の対応を定義する場合も期待です。Oでは実測の引用・確認状況一覧・本文内HTMLコメントの作業メモも数えますが、架空の試験入力・条件付きの例は数えません。許容を表す「〜でもよい」や仮定・可能性だけを述べる文は、現状の報告ではありません。例えば「点検は後日でもよい」は許容条件ですが、「点検はまだしていない」は現在の状態の報告です。O=yesにするには、本文が現実にそうだと主張している箇所が必要です。与えられたbody全体だけを対象に判断し、そこにない現状を推測しないでください。
本問はEだけ：本文が実現すべき状態を一つでも宣言しているか。完成状態の表・責務・式も宣言である。Goal等の見出しだけでYesにしない。本文にそのような期待がなければNo。実施済みと書いてあるだけなら期待ではない。

specification.instruction: Read only the complete literal body, including HTML comments, tables, formulas and templates. Decide whether it contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract: a rule, expected or acceptable condition, responsibility, functional capability, input/output mapping, interface purpose, or condition or limitation of use. A stated expected-outcome caption or interface text declaring an action's purpose can qualify. No formal specification label, generality, adoption, implementation, must-word or future tense is required. Distinguish the role of the relationship being stated. Declaring what a function does or what condition applies counts; merely describing what happened, is happening, used to happen or regularly happens in observed execution does not by itself declare a specification. A performed configuration, measured value, comparison or causal explanation does not supply an unstated applicable contract. These are role distinctions, not rules excluding particular headings, formats, tenses or words: a report may also contain a genuine specification, and an ordinary capability statement can declare one without requesting a change. Read each statement in context; one qualifying declaration anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when used to declare the specification, but not when displayed only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'This dial sets the sampling interval' declares a function; 'I turned the dial and the reading changed' alone reports an observation. A request or a subject's goal alone does not establish this specification role. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. It declares the relationship itself; merely reporting a performed action, observed configuration or value, observed result, or a causal explanation of an observed event does not by itself establish that role. A genuine declaration still counts inside a report, quotation or template when the body uses it to declare that relationship.
options.no: The complete body contains no statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; observations elsewhere do not cancel a genuine declaration.

request.instruction: Read only the complete literal body, including HTML comments, tables, formulas and templates. Decide whether it contains at least one genuine request for an action, answer, submission, improvement or remedy, or explicitly presents an action or state as a subject's intended goal or need. Count indirect requests and actual conditional reporting or submission directions, including directions carried by a template or HTML comment whether or not the requested information has been supplied. No addressee, stated reason, fully identified final goal, solution, adoption or implementation is required. Distinguish a relationship presented as a target or request from wording that only locates the circumstances of a reported event or explains a necessary response to it. An incident, inability, missing feature, risk, complaint, category or recipient mention alone does not declare the desired opposite or request its correction. Merely explaining what was necessary to obtain an observed result or work around it does not by itself declare an intended goal. Do not exclude a genuine goal or request merely because it appears within a report or a subordinate clause; do not infer one solely from modality, tense, a heading, mention, imperative form or question mark. A specification or expected caption alone does not establish this request or subject-goal role. One qualifying statement anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when the body uses it to make an actual request or goal declaration, but not when shown only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'I need a cost estimate before ordering the materials' declares a goal or need; 'The estimate arrived late, so I postponed the order' alone reports an event and response. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. This includes actual reporting or submission directions before the requested information is supplied. Merely naming a category or recipient, reporting an incident or inability, or explaining a necessary workaround does not itself establish this role.
options.no: The complete body contains no genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; a report or subordinate clause does not cancel an actual request or goal.

request.instructions:
body内の各文を、望ましい状態の宣言と、実際に起きたことの報告に分けて読んでください。EとOは同時にyesでも構いません。Eは文書の主題や多数決ではなく存在判定です。具体的な要求文・完成条件・目標文が一文でもあれば、残りが全部作業報告でもE=yesです。例えば「利用者に完了を通知すること」は期待ですが、「利用者に通知した」は実施報告であり期待ではありません。Goal・Acceptanceという見出しそのものは期待文ではなく、その下に過去の実施報告しかなければE=noです。表・数式・役割が完成状態の対応を定義する場合も期待です。Oでは実測の引用・確認状況一覧・本文内HTMLコメントの作業メモも数えますが、架空の試験入力・条件付きの例は数えません。許容を表す「〜でもよい」や仮定・可能性だけを述べる文は、現状の報告ではありません。例えば「点検は後日でもよい」は許容条件ですが、「点検はまだしていない」は現在の状態の報告です。O=yesにするには、本文が現実にそうだと主張している箇所が必要です。与えられたbody全体だけを対象に判断し、そこにない現状を推測しないでください。
本問はEだけ：本文が実現すべき状態を一つでも宣言しているか。完成状態の表・責務・式も宣言である。Goal等の見出しだけでYesにしない。本文にそのような期待がなければNo。実施済みと書いてあるだけなら期待ではない。

body内の各文を、望ましい状態の宣言と、実際に起きたことの報告に分けて読んでください。EとOは同時にyesでも構いません。Eは文書の主題や多数決ではなく存在判定です。具体的な要求文・完成条件・目標文が一文でもあれば、残りが全部作業報告でもE=yesです。例えば「利用者に完了を通知すること」は期待ですが、「利用者に通知した」は実施報告であり期待ではありません。Goal・Acceptanceという見出しそのものは期待文ではなく、その下に過去の実施報告しかなければE=noです。表・数式・役割が完成状態の対応を定義する場合も期待です。Oでは実測の引用・確認状況一覧・本文内HTMLコメントの作業メモも数えますが、架空の試験入力・条件付きの例は数えません。許容を表す「〜でもよい」や仮定・可能性だけを述べる文は、現状の報告ではありません。例えば「点検は後日でもよい」は許容条件ですが、「点検はまだしていない」は現在の状態の報告です。O=yesにするには、本文が現実にそうだと主張している箇所が必要です。与えられたbody全体だけを対象に判断し、そこにない現状を推測しないでください。
本問はEだけ：本文が実現すべき状態を一つでも宣言しているか。完成状態の表・責務・式も宣言である。Goal等の見出しだけでYesにしない。本文にそのような期待がなければNo。実施済みと書いてあるだけなら期待ではない。

Declaring what a function does or what condition applies counts; merely describing what happened, is happening, used to happen or regularly happens in observed execution does not by itself declare a specification. A performed configuration, measured value, comparison or causal explanation does not supply an unstated applicable contract. These are role distinctions, not rules excluding particular headings, formats, tenses or words: a report may also contain a genuine specification, and an ordinary capability statement can declare one without requesting a change. Read each statement in context; one qualifying declaration anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when used to declare the specification, but not when displayed only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'This dial sets the sampling interval' declares a function; 'I turned the dial and the reading changed' alone reports an observation. A request or a subject's goal alone does not establish this specification role. Do not consult external content.

body内の各文を、望ましい状態の宣言と、実際に起きたことの報告に分けて読んでください。EとOは同時にyesでも構いません。Eは文書の主題や多数決ではなく存在判定です。具体的な要求文・完成条件・目標文が一文でもあれば、残りが全部作業報告でもE=yesです。例えば「利用者に完了を通知すること」は期待ですが、「利用者に通知した」は実施報告であり期待ではありません。Goal・Acceptanceという見出しそのものは期待文ではなく、その下に過去の実施報告しかなければE=noです。表・数式・役割が完成状態の対応を定義する場合も期待です。Oでは実測の引用・確認状況一覧・本文内HTMLコメントの作業メモも数えますが、架空の試験入力・条件付きの例は数えません。許容を表す「〜でもよい」や仮定・可能性だけを述べる文は、現状の報告ではありません。例えば「点検は後日でもよい」は許容条件ですが、「点検はまだしていない」は現在の状態の報告です。O=yesにするには、本文が現実にそうだと主張している箇所が必要です。与えられたbody全体だけを対象に判断し、そこにない現状を推測しないでください。
本問はEだけ：本文が実現すべき状態を一つでも宣言しているか。完成状態の表・責務・式も宣言である。Goal等の見出しだけでYesにしない。本文にそのような期待がなければNo。実施済みと書いてあるだけなら期待ではない。

Decide whether it contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract: a rule, expected or acceptable condition, responsibility, functional capability, input/output mapping, interface purpose, or condition or limitation of use. A stated expected-outcome caption or interface text declaring an action's purpose can qualify. No formal specification label, generality, adoption, implementation, must-word or future tense is required. Distinguish the role of the relationship being stated. Declaring what a function does or what condition applies counts; merely describing what happened, is happening, used to happen or regularly happens in observed execution does not by itself declare a specification. A performed configuration, measured value, comparison or causal explanation does not supply an unstated applicable contract. These are role distinctions, not rules excluding particular headings, formats, tenses or words: a report may also contain a genuine specification, and an ordinary capability statement can declare one without requesting a change. Read each statement in context; one qualifying declaration anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when used to declare the specification, but not when displayed only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'This dial sets the sampling interval' declares a function; 'I turned the dial and the reading changed' alone reports an observation. A request or a subject's goal alone does not establish this specification role. Do not consult external content.

A request or a subject's goal alone does not establish this specification role. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. Merely explaining what was necessary to obtain an observed result or work around it does not by itself declare an intended goal. A specification or expected caption alone does not establish this request or subject-goal role. One qualifying statement anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when the body uses it to make an actual request or goal declaration, but not when shown only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'I need a cost estimate before ordering the materials' declares a goal or need; 'The estimate arrived late, so I postponed the order' alone reports an event and response. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one genuine request or declaration of a subject's intended goal or need of the kind defined in the instruction. This includes actual reporting or submission directions before the requested information is supplied. - VS Code Version: 1.142.0
- OS Version: container: Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS (aarch64) (macOS: 27.0.1)

## What happens

`code -w` in the integrated terminal waits until I close the file's tab, then exits. That's how it's supposed to work.

If I add `-g file:line`, the command never exits when I close the tab.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open a terminal in VS Code in the browser with `code serve-web`.
2. Run `code -w README.md`. A tab opens. Go on and close it. The command exits. Works correctly
3. Run `code -w -g README.md:1`. A tab opens. Go on and close it. The command keeps running. Doesn't work.

## Expected

Step 3 should exit when the tab is closed, like step 2.

## Why it matters

Tools that open VS Code as an editor and wait for it hang forever. For example, pressing ctrl+g in Claude Code runs `code -w -g file:line` and gets stuck.

## Setup

- VS Code 1.142.0 (commit 6d62b1d5dace93a33b3a6d3eca1317bd5e15bcb1)
- Browser version (`code serve-web`), used as a PWA in Google Chrome on macOS
- VS Code server runs on Linux (aarch64) in a dev container
- The `code` command is the remote CLI: `~/.vscode/cli/serve-web/<commit>/bin/remote-cli/code`

## Only in the browser version

The same steps work correctly in:

- desktop VS Code on macOS
- desktop VS Code with dev container extension and "attach to running container"

The problem only happens in the browser version (`code serve-web`).

Decide whether it contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract: a rule, expected or acceptable condition, responsibility, functional capability, input/output mapping, interface purpose, or condition or limitation of use. A stated expected-outcome caption or interface text declaring an action's purpose can qualify. No formal specification label, generality, adoption, implementation, must-word or future tense is required. Distinguish the role of the relationship being stated. Declaring what a function does or what condition applies counts; merely describing what happened, is happening, used to happen or regularly happens in observed execution does not by itself declare a specification. A performed configuration, measured value, comparison or causal explanation does not supply an unstated applicable contract. These are role distinctions, not rules excluding particular headings, formats, tenses or words: a report may also contain a genuine specification, and an ordinary capability statement can declare one without requesting a change. Read each statement in context; one qualifying declaration anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when used to declare the specification, but not when displayed only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'This dial sets the sampling interval' declares a function; 'I turned the dial and the reading changed' alone reports an observation. A request or a subject's goal alone does not establish this specification role. Do not consult external content.

options.yes: The complete body contains at least one statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. It declares the relationship itself; merely reporting a performed action, observed configuration or value, observed result, or a causal explanation of an observed event does not by itself establish that role. A genuine declaration still counts inside a report, quotation or template when the body uses it to declare that relationship.
options.no: The complete body contains no statement presented as a specification or operative contract of the kind defined in the instruction. Answer no only for absence throughout the body; observations elsewhere do not cancel a genuine declaration.

request.instruction: Read only the complete literal body, including HTML comments, tables, formulas and templates. Decide whether it contains at least one genuine request for an action, answer, submission, improvement or remedy, or explicitly presents an action or state as a subject's intended goal or need. Count indirect requests and actual conditional reporting or submission directions, including directions carried by a template or HTML comment whether or not the requested information has been supplied. No addressee, stated reason, fully identified final goal, solution, adoption or implementation is required. Distinguish a relationship presented as a target or request from wording that only locates the circumstances of a reported event or explains a necessary response to it. An incident, inability, missing feature, risk, complaint, category or recipient mention alone does not declare the desired opposite or request its correction. Merely explaining what was necessary to obtain an observed result or work around it does not by itself declare an intended goal. Do not exclude a genuine goal or request merely because it appears within a report or a subordinate clause; do not infer one solely from modality, tense, a heading, mention, imperative form or question mark. A specification or expected caption alone does not establish this request or subject-goal role. One qualifying statement anywhere is sufficient and observations elsewhere do not cancel it. Quoted or hypothetical text counts when the body uses it to make an actual request or goal declaration, but not when shown only as an illustration. Synthetic contrast: 'I need a cost estimate before ordering the materials' declares a goal or need; 'The estimate arrived late, so I postponed the order' alone reports an event and response. Do not consult external content.

Merely naming a category or recipient, reporting an incident or inability, or explaining a necessary workaround does not itself establish this role.

request.text:
{"body":"### Describe the feature or problem you’d like to solve

Follow on from #14739

Currently, the hourly Dependabot triage workflow starts its generated `agent` job even when its deterministic worklist is empty.

The pre-flight step correctly found that #14716 had already been assessed, produced an empty worklist, and caused zero model invocations.

```shell
$ tmp=$(mktemp -d); gh aw audit 39137237820 --repo cli/cli --artifacts usage,agent -o "$tmp" >/dev/null; run_dir=$(find "$tmp" -type f -name audit.json -exec dirname {} \; | head -1); grep -E 'PR #[0-9]+: (already assessed|needs assessment)|Work list:' "$run_dir/workflow-logs/3_agent.txt" | sed -E 's/^.*Z //' | tail -2; jq '{working_set:.working_set}' "$run_dir/usage/activity/summary.json"; rm -rf "$tmp"
```

```text
PR #14716: already assessed at 35c2bf381bb42655fb40ec8ebf2e0a0548ef7543, skipping
Work list: 0 PR(s) -> /tmp/gh-aw/dependabot-worklist.json
{
  "working_set": {
    "cumulative_input_tokens": 0,
    "peak_input_tokens": 0,
    "invocations": 0
  }
}
```

However, `gh-aw` records the job as started before its harness observes the noop. The daily guardrail then treats the empty accounting file as unknown and applies the `max-ai-credits` fallback.

Five consecutive no-work runs were each counted as `1000` AIC, which exhausted the `5000` daily guardrail.

```shell
$ gh run view 39141727797 --repo cli/cli --log | grep -E 'Computed run AIC.*(39137237820|39132745345|39128819878|39124342426|39120364428)|Completed AIC inspection window' | sed -E 's/^activation[[:space:]]+UNKNOWN STEP[[:space:]]+//'
```

```text
[daily-workflow-aic] Computed run AIC: {"runId":39137237820,"aic":1000,"reason":"max_ai_credits_fallback"}
[daily-workflow-aic] Computed run AIC: {"runId":39132745345,"aic":1000,"reason":"scan_cache"}
[daily-workflow-aic] Computed run AIC: {"runId":39128819878,"aic":1000,"reason":"scan_cache"}
[daily-workflow-aic] Computed run AIC: {"runId":39124342426,"aic":1000,"reason":"scan_cache"}
[daily-workflow-aic] Computed run AIC: {"runId":39120364428,"aic":1000,"reason":"scan_cache"}
[daily-workflow-aic] Completed AIC inspection window: {"currentAIC":5000,"threshold":5000,"exceeded":true}
```

The generated workflow marks execution as started immediately before entering the harness [here](https://github.com/cli/cli/blob/fa92838bef95fe4a29c1587693885d5e9bdb6cf1/.github/workflows/dependabot-triage.lock.yml#L938-L948). The harness can then exit without invoking the model.

### Proposed solution

Split scheduling and agent execution into separate workflows.

An ordinary GitHub Actions workflow should run hourly and perform the existing PR listing, CI readiness, and assessed-head checks. It should dispatch `dependabot-triage` with its existing `pr_number` input only when a PR needs assessment.

The expected output for this issue is:

* No agentic workflow run is created when no Dependabot PR needs assessment.
* Each ready, unassessed Dependabot PR is dispatched for triage.
* The existing once-per-head-SHA behaviour remains unchanged.
* The `max-daily-ai-credits` guardrail remains enabled for genuine agent runs.

### Additional context

Lowering `max-ai-credits`, reducing the schedule frequency, or raising the daily limit would reduce the impact, but none fixes the false accounting path.

The underlying `gh-aw` behaviour should still be reported upstream. This repository-side split prevents that behaviour from blocking Dependabot triage while preserving the guardrail."}
